We investigate the effectiveness of Dialogflow in creating a voice-enabled web accessibility solution and enhancing user experience and accessibility on the web.Our comparative analysis with existing methods demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach in improving customer interaction and satisfaction. Integrating Dialogflow with TTS and STT technologies provides a comprehensive solution for enhancing web accessibility, ensuring that all users, regardless of their abilities, can access and interact with web content effectively. This research contributes to the advancement of web accessibility and provides insights for future developments in this field.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Hybrid FSO/RF DF Relayed Satellite Communication Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In contemporary communication networks, ensuring reliable and high-speed data transmission is imperative. This research paper introduces an innovative strategy to tackle communication challenges in demanding environments, with a specific focus on enhancing the effectiveness of using HAPS as a decode and forward Relay system employing a Hybrid Free- Space Optical (FSO) and Radio Frequency (RF) approach. In modern communication networks, the imperative of reliable and high-speed data transmission is paramount across various applications. The hybrid FSO/RF network is engineered to address inherent weaknesses in both Free-Space and Radio Frequency communication technologies. Through the incorporation of a Decode and Forward relay, the proposed system establishes a versatile backbone, thereby elevating overall system reliability. This approach seeks to facilitate efficient communication in scenarios where conventional systems might encounter limitations. To gauge the performance of the system, mathematical expressions are formulated for both outage probability and Bit Error Rate. These expressions serve as quantitative benchmarks for evaluating the dependability and precision of the proposed communication system. The paper underscores the importance of the hybrid approach in navigating challenges prevalent in satellite communication within demanding environments. The Decode and Forward relay is explored as a pivotal component contributing to the system's adaptability and dependability. The derived mathematical expressions offer a thorough analysis of the system's performance under diverse conditions, presenting valuable insights for researchers and practitioners in the realm of communication networks.

articleTitle: Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Control of HVAC System in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The rise in the popularity of vehicles has led to the need for dependable heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems in vehicle to ensure that passengers are comfortable and that the vehicles perform well. HVAC systems ensure passenger comfort, manage energy usage, and maximise vehicle range. A promising approach called Type 2 Fuzzy Logic Control (T2- FLC) is introduced to enhance HVAC system performance by controlling temperature and air distribution. Implementing T2-FLC involves system architecture, fuzzy inference mechanisms, membership functions and rule-based design. Additionally, T2- FLC has been explored for its ability to handle uncertainty and imprecision better than Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC) in HVAC systems. T2-FLC helps regulate HVAC parameters like temperature, humidity and air quality while focusing on energy efficiency and passenger comfort. This advancement in HVAC control strategies is particularly beneficial, for vehicles.

articleTitle: A System of IoT Devices to prevent Overloading and Underloading of Railway Wagons
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The ever-increasing demand for railway freight transportation necessitates improved operational efficiency and safety. However, underloading and overloading of wagons pose significant challenges, leading to inefficiencies and safety hazards. This research work presents a novel IoT based system to tackle this issue. The proposed system employs weight sensors strategically placed under wagons. These continuously monitor the load in real-time, capturing valuable data on weight distribution and total cargo mass. Leveraging an IoT network, the collected data is transmitted to a central monitoring system. This system analyses the weight data and identifies any deviations from permissible loading limits, including both underloading and overloading. For effective analysis, it is imperative that the load sensors undergo thorough calibration to mitigate the likelihood of errors. Ensuring the precise calibration of every load sensor utilized for research is paramount to mitigating potential disruptions. Upon detecting such anomalies, the system triggers automated alerts. The real-time monitoring and intelligent management of wagon load offered by this IoT system provides a multifaceted solution. It not only enhances the safety by preventing accidents caused by improper loading but also optimizes operational efficiency by ensuring wagon utilization and reducing unnecessary delays. Thus, contributing significantly to a safer and more efficient railway freight transportation system.

articleTitle: Medical Diagnostic System using Embedding JADE in jCOLIBRI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Case-based reasoning (CBR) methodology presents a foundation for a new technology of building intelligent computer-aided diagnoses systems. This Technology directly addresses the problems found in the traditional Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques, e.g., the problems of knowledge acquisition, remembering, robustness and maintenance. This paper discusses the CBR methodology, the research issues and the technical aspects of implementing intelligent medical diagnoses systems. It develops a celebrative framework of MAS-CBR to criticize the medical problem to get the best treatment against dengue disease. This paper also embedding the framework of JADE and jCOLIBRI to improve the quality of decision- making in the medical diagnosis field.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 2-Pole Linear Induction Motor Using Ansys
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A type of special electrical machine that transforms electrical energy into mechanical energy for translational motion is the linear electric motor. For use in actuation and transportation systems, linear motors (LM) are incredibly efficient drive systems. There are three primary advantages of linear induction motors. First, during the assembling process, there are no magnetic attraction forces to deal with. Secondly, extended journey distances are achievable. Thirdly, their ratings for continuous force and acceleration are exceptionally high. This work proposes the theoretical and 3D ANSYS Model Design and analysis of a 2-pole, single-side, single-layer winding of a linear induction motor. Thrust characteristics, induced voltages, flux linkages, and current waveforms are analyzed by applying a three-phase ac voltage. Through ANSYS Model Analysis calculations, the linear induction motor's output characteristics and static magnetic field are analyzed.

articleTitle: Enhanced Metal Sheet Quality Control Using CNN and SVM Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study introduces an innovative approach to detecting and classifying defects in large metal sheets by combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with Support Vector Machines (SVM). The research focuses on four specific types of flaws: wavy edges, one-sided wavy edges, coil breaks, and central buckles. The proposed hybrid model delivers remarkable results, achieving an overall accuracy of 99% across all defect types. It consistently surpasses 96% in accuracy, recall, and F1-scores for each defect category, demonstrating its reliability and effectiveness. With macro, weighted, and micro averages all reaching 97.01%, the model exhibits a wellbalanced performance. This outstanding accuracy and consistency underscore the potential of integrating CNNs with SVMs for robust quality control in metal sheet manufacturing.

articleTitle: Real Time Hand Gesture Recognition and Human Computer Interaction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The technique of establishing the process of interaction between human and computer technology. The mouse is excellent invention in HCI (Human Computer Interaction) technology. Though wireless or bluetooth mouse technology is not completely device free. A bluetooth mouse has the requirement of battery power and connecting dongle. Presence of extra devices in a mouse increases the difficulty to use it. The purpose is to study if such menus, with practice, could support the development of autonomous gestural command sets. In this paper, we use hand gesture captured by web-cam instead of mouse, for natural and intuitive human-computer interaction. A palm detection model and hand landmark model. The result shows that this system can operate well so we can interact with computer using hand gesture instead using mouse.

articleTitle: A Resonance Based Inductive Wireless Power Transfer System for Charging Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) has a significant influence on marine applications due to its endurance and effectiveness in performing challenging missions. Since most AUVs employ batteries as prime energy storage, their underwater mission time is limited. Moreover, they need to be hauled out of the water for recharging batteries prior to every mission, which is a time consuming and tedious process. Hence, recharging AUV batteries underwater using a wireless power transfer technology is a feasible and secure option to overcome the aforementioned limitation. In this paper, a resonance based inductive power transfer system for wireless charging of AUVs has been developed. Further, the performance of wireless charging system is validated through simulation in MATLAB/Simulink platform and verified through preliminary experimentation carried out in a 1 kW laboratory scale hardware prototype. The experimental results in saline water environment showcase a power transfer efficiency of 85-86% considering a gap of 3 cm between primary and secondary coils.

articleTitle: Conversion of Traditional Cycle into a Low-cost E-Cycle with Battery Level Indicator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: There is an increasing need for environment friendly transportation options, hence the conversion of traditional cycle into Electric-cycle grabs the attention and importance. When converting a classical cycle into e-cycle, by re-fitting the electric motor with the battery system. It has various advantages i.e., on environment, health and make convenient and better transportation option. An Electric motor, controller, battery pack, throttle, and sensor system are the main components of the Classical e-cycle conversion. The motor is usually placed on rear or front wheel but, in this instance is positioned on the back wheel. The Battery pack increase the overall efficiency and provide required power for motor movement. A controller controls how the power flows between the motor, battery and user interface. Sensor decides the amount of support given to the rider e.g., torque or cadence sensor. E-cycle possess the remarkable ability to elongate the distance covered during daily commutes, rendering them an alluring alternative those who are depends on fueled vehicle. It plays an important role in mitigating the effect of urban pollution, promotes healthier and more dynamic lifestyle. E-cycle are made from old bicycle, which save resources and reduce waste. It may rise as indigenous manufacturing environment which significantly add value to our economy at global level. In conclusion, the conversion of traditional bicycles into e-cycles represents a promising trust for sustainable urban transportation. It eliminates the gap between conventional cycling and electric mobility, offering an easy and environmentally friendly mode of transportation. The transformation of bicycles into e-cycles not only for the reach of cycling but also promotes health, well-being, and a more sustainable future for urban environments. This technology is best to serve in terms of sustainability which overall has various implication towards the human wellbeing.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement Using Three Phase Three Wire Shunt Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The use of harmonic polluting loads is increasing and is creating power quality issues in the grid. The presence of harmonic pollution causes communication line interference, equipment damage, and losses in power production. Thus, increased harmonics problems necessitate focus while there are numerous tools available for reducing the impact of harmonics. In this paper a three-wire, three-phase, shunt active power filter that operates using unit template control algorithm is proposed to mitigate the harmonic distortion in the in the grid. The suggested shunt active power filter control algorithm easily maintains a self-supporting DC bus. The PWM switching signals are generated by the Current Controller. The passive power filter is also implemented for comparison purpose. The MATLAB/Simulink environment is used to implement the control strategy. The simulation results show that the shunt active power filter significantly reduces harmonics as compared to a passive power filter.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture: IoT-Enabled Precision Environmental Monitoring and Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research work delves into the contemporary challenges faced by agriculture and proposing solutions through automation. The development of an Internet of Things (IoT) system adept at accurately sensing and monitoring environmental conditions is facilitated by the integration of advanced sensors, Node MCU, Blynk, and other pertinent technologies. The methodology of the research also emphasizes on the utilization of a diverse array of sensors, including the NPK sensor, to precisely ascertain Nitrogen, Phosphorous, and Potassium levels crucial for optimizing crop efficiency. The incorporation of Node MCU ESP8266 facilitates signal acquisition and management, while the Blynk program enables remote access to real-time sensor data and facilitates the operation of a responsive water pump for irrigation optimization. This prototype demonstrates a significant enhancement in farming precision, productivity, and efficiency. By leveraging real-time sensor data and remote-control capabilities through Blynk, the system offers operational flexibility, enabling proactive decision-making in agricultural management. This forward-thinking and user-friendly approach to agricultural planning heralds a promising future for precision farming methodologies.

articleTitle: Optimizing Customer Experience in Online Shopping: A Hyperparameter Tuning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: After buying a product, the majority of buyers don't leave reviews, ratings, or comments, which makes it difficult for any e-commerce site to function. If a business can forecast whether a customer will like or dislike a product, it can use that information to suggest other comparable products and make decisions about whether or not to sell a certain product. This study's main goal is to forecast customer happiness with a product, which may be done by projecting the review rating that a client will provide after making a purchase. Using our dataset, we evaluate each classifier's performance using hyper parameter tuning procedure. Grid Search CV method is used with five machine learning algorithms— Naive Bayes , Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and Gradient Boost Decision Tree (GBDT) to find the customer satisfaction . The results showed that, GBDT outperforms the rest of the model with highest accuracy of 86.57. While both random forest and logistic regression perform reasonably well, but GBDT is more resilient to outliers.

articleTitle: Design of RF Energy Harvester for 3.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The process of capturing and transforming electromagnetic waves into useful electrical power is known as radio frequency (RF) energy harvesting used in wearable technology, IoT, remote sensing, and various other applications where changing batteries is difficult. This research proposes a unique radio frequency energy harvester operating in the n78 (3.5 GHz) 5G frequency spectrum. The circuit employs a Delon Voltage Rectifier as a rectifier multiplier, and the Schottky Diode HSMS-2852 is utilized to operate as a rectifier. LC impedance matching is used to enhance the harvester's circuit performance, such as conversion effectiveness and resultant voltage. The rectifier is simulated with the Advanced Design System (ADS) software. The rectifier exhibits optimal performance at 1.5 kΩ load impedance,. The model's results show a maximum efficiency of 44.54% and a resultant voltage of 1.16 V with 10 dBm RF power at 3.5 GHz input frequency.

articleTitle: An Embedded-based Feature Selection Deep Learning Architecture for Alzheimer’s Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Aging is associated with many health problems, including Alzheimer’s Disease (AD). Currently, there is no cure for AD, and treatment decreases progression to some extent, Early AD detection may enhance the efficiency of existing therapies. A classification model using deep learning (DL) was created to establish an association between AD and DNA methylation based on the dataset collected from the GEO Omnibus database. The model was processed, quality controlled, normalized, and analyzed downstream. The most successful feature selection technique using embedded filter functions was chosen to be the final classification model after four strategies were tried. Testing compared the accuracy of the generalized improved Deep Recurrent Neural Networks model with other classification models such as CNN, RNN, and DRNN. As per the research findings, the Improved DRNN approach achieves more accurate classification and performs better than the other three models.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Autonomous Smart Agri UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This project presents a fast plan regarding drones & the tactic to make that technology into economical and portable use in numerous functions like Defense grade operations, fireplace sensing, management and business, industrial applications and agriculture lands, forest areas etc. unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) like drones had revolutionized in the modern era of flight. they assist humans in new profound ways. In our current technological era, unmanned aerial vehicles, or drones, which have been rapidly expanding since the 20th century, have played a significant role. In This study, we present the use of drones to help agricultural and urban vegetation management approaches. The selection of materials for the structure relies on weight, forces working on it and the mechanical properties. A smart innovative modern tech provides a solution for precision-based seed sowing in agriculture. It can also be used for all types of seeds. The motive is to develop a drone that is capable of dispersing all types of seeds in re-vegetation fields with potential for re-vegetation. The sowing flowrate is controlled by the parameters of the triggering mechanism. After completing the task, the copter can return to the launch position / pad automatically with help of satellite position system which is detectable by it. Trials have shown that, the suggested strategy works properly and precisely enough to meet the requirements for crop and plant culture set out by the experts. We can control the sowing rate by the triggering nozzle mechanism in various operation. The proposed agriculture UAV will reduce the waste / minimize the overflow of the seeds.

articleTitle: Dynamic Fire Detection and Alerting Using Image Processing for Drone Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, a technique has been proposed for a dynamic fire detection system based on Python opencv image processing. On the one hand, consider the system consists of a quadcopter/drone equipped with a mobile phone having the IP webcam app for live video streaming, and the drone is controlled autonomously using a PC, dedicated software like mission planner. On the other hand, another PC with a Python algorithm is used for the processing of the video image to detect fire. The dynamic approach consists in capturing the live stream webcam and detecting any fire presence in the video frame with the HAAR cascade classifier dataset and all this in real-time. After takeoff of the drone, the area mapping is done through waypoints on the Mission planner. A second PC (fire control) is used to start the live stream, detect fire and make decisions. The webcam IP address is fed into the algorithm to extract the video frame. The frame is in RGB format and with the help of the pre-trained model along with the threshold parameters used; the algorithm can detect fire in the live streaming coming from the drone’s camera. Once the fire is detected, the frame becomes stable for some time so the operator sitting in the control room can keep track of the event happening. Functionality is added to the code to track some specific pixels (red, blue, and white) in the fire-detected region and display approximate temperature values based on preset thresholds of these colors. Since it is very difficult to measure the temperature on the image without using a thermal camera and this logic is a novel one. Also, logic is used to capture a fire incident into a frame .jpg image and send it with an email as an attachment to the concerned fire department after a 6s delay. The attachment image is a very important and unique feature as it reveals to the fire department the type of incidents that occurred and even the area if the camera is good enough.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IoT Based Vehicle Emergency Relieve System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: There are many accidents occurring every minute as a result of population growth. These traffic mishaps never seem to be predicted. In certain cases, the majority of accidents may not be appropriately reported in a timely manner to the closest ambulance services. Typically, emergency services are not readily available and are deficientin delivering prompt care and first aid, which may result in a few minutes' difference in death. Therefore, it is necessary to create a system that addresses each of these issues and SOS is capable of overcoming the delay time brought by directly informing the family members of the victim with the help of an app so that they can take immediate action and help their family members in that situation. In this paper an IoT based emergency relieve system is proposed for vehicles. The benefits of this system are that their family members of injured will directly informed and immediate action can be taken by them by informing the concerned emergency services. This system does not consist of many sensors due to which it is not so much complex, easy to install and cost effective.

articleTitle: Design And Power Optimization of ALU Using Adiabatic Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study delves into the integration of adiabatic logic into ALU design, aiming to boost energy efficiency without compromising performance. Traditional ALUs employing CMOS technology often exhibit substantial power consumption due to transistor count. We compare a conventional CMOS-based ALU, consuming 56. 68 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> units of power, with an adiabatic logic-based ALU, which consumes only 4.076 x 10-9 units of power, illustrating a significant reduction. Adiabatic logic operates on the principle of energy recovery, recycling consumed energy back into the power supply to mitigate overall power consumption. Our study looks at different adiabatic logic designs and how well they work to minimize power loss without sacrificing functionality and gives a remarkable reduction in the power. The results show that adiabatic logic can be used to create ALU designs that are energy-efficient, which makes it an interesting area for low- power VLSI circuit research which helps in the designing of a high computing systems. With low-power solutions becoming increasingly necessary in contemporary VLSI circuits, this research advances our understanding of how well adiabatic logic can improve energy efficiency in ALU designs.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Satellite Formation Flight using Non-convex Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents a path generation strategy for satellite formation flying based on model predictive control (MPC). The strategy aims to compute suboptimal trajectories by solving a nonconvex optimization problem, enabling the system of satellites to achieve formation flying in advance to reaching the desired end states. It utilizes a combination of centralized architecture to achieve precise formation flying and ensures the desired formation is maintained during position transitions. By leveraging Kronecker's product, the strategy incorporates the dynamics of all satellites into a unified matrix, allowing for generalization to systems with any number of satellites.

articleTitle: Design and Development of IoT based Agricultural vehicle for Crop and Weed Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the development and implementation of IoT-enabled unmanned vehicle system that enables seam-less user-vehicle interaction, real time monitoring and control. Emphasizing novel control mechanisms, the vehicle employs Raspberry Pi as a central control framework. The Raspberry Pi controls and uses DC motors, pi camera, a pump, a robotic arm and seeding modules to control vehicle movement, monitor crops, remove weeds, and perform various required applications all of which responds accordingly to the user. The prototype is successful in providing field visuals, removing weed plants and other required activities. Further research is underway to explore additional system functionalities and optimizing user interface, underscoring the vehicle’s expansive scope and its evolving contributions to the agriculture field. It’s a great step towards the future, where smart technology plays a key role in meeting the global food demand while preserving the environment.

articleTitle: Augmented Speech Emotion Recognition Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is a technology used to analyze emotions from spoken language. These systems aim to classify a speaker's emotional state by analyzing subtle vocal characteristics like pitch, tone, and rhythm. However, background noise and distractions can significantly reduce the accuracy of emotion detection by SER systems. The Wiener filter acts as a digital noise-canceling tool, specifically targeting speech signals corrupted by environmental noise. Mel- frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) enhance the speech features. The work revolves on increasing the feature count followed by exercising feature selection using the filter method. Select- K best provides the stage for the application of four chosen machine learning (ML) models namely SVM, Random Forest, Decision Tree, and KNN. Random Forest outperforms other models in its performance. The work is an elementary analysis on ML to explore the need of other high end DL architectures like CNN, RNN and LSTM for SER. Work is in progress to port the most accurate algorithm to an embedded platform like Raspberry Pi for integration with IoT.

articleTitle: Automated Landslide Detection using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Landslides pose significant threats to human life, infrastructure, and the environment, making timely detection crucial for effective disaster management. This research paper introduces a novel approach to landslide detection utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in conjunction with ensemble learning techniques. Leveraging the inherent capabilities of CNNs to extract discriminative features from remote sensing imagery, multiple CNN models are trained and aggregated into an ensemble. Through extensive experimentation on diverse satellite imagery datasets, the effectiveness of the ensemble model is evaluated against standalone CNNs and traditional methods. Results demonstrate that the ensemble approach outperforms individual CNN models and baseline methods regarding accuracy and robustness across varying environmental conditions, enhancing landslide detection capabilities and contributing to more effective disaster management strategies. Our Model achieves 95% Precision, 91% Recall, and 93% f1-score which makes it better than all comparative methods. After classification, we make predictions through GUI by uploading images, in which we are using the Nepal dataset.

articleTitle: Metal-Gate/High-k CGAA FET with Strain-engineering for both high speed switching and low-power applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A novel n-type nanowire cylindrical gate-all-around field-effect transistor (n-CGAA FET) with a strained channel and enhanced high-κ metal gates (HKMGs) aims to move beyond the 2 nm technological node. The strained channel in the n-CGAA FET is built with strain-SiGe encased in a strained silicon structure, as well as a tungsten gate and a high-k gate stack, which replace the traditional polysilicon gate and silicon channel. This novel architecture provides excellent control over short-channel effects. In addition, a comprehensive examination of device performance is performed and presented. The proposed integration technique shows great promise for use in high-speed, low-power devices.

articleTitle: An Effective Approaches for Auto Bill Generator System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In an era of increasing retail expansion where time is of the essence, the need for streamlined and accurate billing systems has become paramount. Moreover, In recent years, the retail industry has witnessed significant technological advancements aimed at enhancing customer experiences and operational efficiency. Manual billing processes, although traditionally relied upon, are inherently time-consuming and this inefficiency underscores the necessity for automated solutions. This study presents an innovative Auto Bill Generator (ABG) System that integrates Computer Vision (CNN) and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to revolutionize traditional billing procedures in retail environments. By leveraging CNN algorithms for item detection via camera input and IoT-enabled weight sensors for item verification, the ABG system aims to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Rigorous testing demonstrates significant improvements in billing accuracy and speed compared to manual methods, underscoring the practicality and effectiveness of automated billing systems. The ABG system offers a viable solution to optimize retail operations, ultimately leading to enhanced customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Approach for Energy Management of Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Plug in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs) have garnered attention for their ability to decrease greenhouse gas emissions and reduce reliance on fossil fuels. The effectiveness of energy management strategies is crucial, in optimizing the performance and enhancing the driving experience of PHEVs. When analyzing PHEVs, this study investigates the area of uncertainty and unpredictability within driving conditions and driver behavior. While fuzzy logic control (FLC) relies on inputs and outputs which are vulnerable to uncertainties in real world scenarios. Type two fuzzy logic control (T2-FLC) embraces higher levels of uncertainty by factoring in fuzziness in both input and output variables. As a result, T2-FLC offers adaptable control in dynamic and uncertain settings. A comparative analysis between FLC and T2-FLC applied to a PHEVs energy management system is presented in this paper. The findings indicate that although both FLC and T2-FLC demonstrate energy management capabilities T2-FLC surpasses FLC in handling uncertainties and dynamic variations thereby enhancing energy efficiency and prolonging battery life. T2- FLC exhibits adaptability to changing driving conditions facilitating transitions, between operational modes and optimal utilization of available energy resources. The results of T2-FLC helps to researchers for automotive industry to reduce carbon footprint of environment.

articleTitle: Machine Learning in Action: Supervised Learning Models for Classifying Credit Card Fraud
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Financial institutions face a relentless battle against fraudulent credit card transactions. Machine learning (ML) offers a promising approach for tackling this challenge. This paper explores six supervised machine learning models (Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest, Naive Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), XGBoost, and LIGHT GBM) for detecting credit card fraud using a benchmark dataset. We explore the impact of dimensionality reduction with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and data balancing with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) on imbalanced class distributions. The assessment relies on metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results indicate that Random Forest demonstrates the best overall performance, especially when paired with GAN-based data balancing techniques. This study highlights the importance of addressing class imbalance and exploring dimensionality reduction techniques for enhancing credit card fraud detection capabilities.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving AI: Leveraging Federated Reinforcement Learning in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Organizing computing distributed resources in conjunction with machine learning algorithms in the age of big data is critical. This paper presents the FRL approach that combines Federated Learning and Reinforcement Learning to address problems in scale, speed, and data privacy. The overall framework of the Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) model bestows the use of distributed computing at different agents to train a standard RL model. This framework guarantees data privacy utilizing differential privacy and secure multi-party computation (SMPC). Quantitative analysis proves the proposed FRL framework retrieves a better result than a standard RL strategy implemented in the central controller. In the 100th episode of the study, the authors’ FRL framework had better results than the centralized RL approach in autonomous navigation, resource management and game-playing. Thus, the FRL framework gained a total benefit of 95 cumulative. 6, 98. 4, and 98. 3, and the rewards obtained for the centralized RL approach were 90. 5, 92. 0, and 93. 8, respectively. Also, there was lower communication overhead about the generic FRL framework, where the assessment was recorded at 33. At the same time, 100 parameter exchanges were performed; the decentralized RL method was measured at 6 units, while the centralized RL method was measured at 41. 3 units. The joint plot analysis established that the traditional FRL framework training strategy offers quicker convergence and heightened model robustness, as the collaborative training approach provides. The heatmap visualization confirms the enhancement of the capability to control the communication overhead.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling For Diabetes Disease In Healthcare Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Diabetes mellitus poses a global health challenge, requiring early and precise diagnosis for effective management. Conventional methods often lack early detection and accuracy. Integration of predictive modeling, leveraging AI and machine learning, promises to revolutionize diabetes diagnosis. By utilizing data-driven insights, it enhances accuracy and efficiency, enabling proactive interventions. This paper highlights traditional method limitations and predictive modeling's potential. The proposed multi-layered system architecture encompasses data acquisition, pre-processing, core modeling, and ethical considerations, culminating in a user-friendly interface. By exploring machine learning algorithms, like Neural Networks, SVM and KNN, and through ethical aspects, this study aims to advance diagnostic capabilities, improve patient outcomes, and streamline healthcare procedures, emphasizing accuracy, interpretability, and ethical integrity.

articleTitle: Employing Machine Learning to Detect Cross-Site Scribing Attacks with Understandable Artificial Intelligence Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: XSS attacks allow malicious scripts to be inserted into websites that unsuspecting users view, posing a serious security concern for online applications. Finding and blocking XSS attacks is the most crucial step in online application security. This study introduces ML methods like K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN) and Random Forest to detect XSS attacks. Developers and security analysts may use our AI-generated detection insights to understand the model's judgments. We preprocess incoming data by extracting valuable properties from HTTP requests and answers. Such characteristics include URL attributes, HTTP headers, and content properties. We train KNN and RF classifiers on labeled data using a dataset of known XSS and benign queries. These extracted features help trained algorithms distinguish real and fraudulent searches. We simplify models via decision tree visualization and feature significance analysis. We can better understand how the models anticipate and identify the most relevant XSS detection properties using these approaches. Developers who understand the models' decision-making process and patterns may optimize system performance. We evaluate our technique by comparing KNN and RF classifier efficiency on real-world datasets. Both classifiers identify XSS attacks well, although RF has greater recall and accuracy than KNN. Developers may improve web application security and analyze XSS attacks using our approach's understandable insights.

articleTitle: Stochastic Sentiment Analysis for Trading Signals Based on Financial News Headlines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research project focuses on leveraging natural language processing (NLP) techniques to predict stock price movements based on Reuters News. The methodology involves data collection and preprocessing, feature engineering through tokenization, and the utilization of Bayesian Convolutional Neural Networks trained using Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics. Historical stock prices are crawled and normalized returns are calculated to enhance the predictive model. The project aims to build a robust connection between Bayesian DNN and stock price prediction by incorporating the sentiment analysis of news headlines. Thinning models are employed for predicting future news sentiments. The implementation is carried out using Python 3, PyTorch, numpy, NLTK, and various crawler tools. The research demonstrates the application of the proposed methodology with backtesting on past news, showcasing promising results. The evaluation of the model reveals a noteworthy classification accuracy of 58.07%, surpassing the critical 50% threshold, positioning it as a valuable tool for market participants. Future work is outlined for further refinement, including the exploration of industry-specific sentiments and the enhancement of stopword lists to improve prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Light Electric Vehicle Battery Performance Analysis with Indian Drive Cycles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The battery lifespan depends on several factors like the battery chemistry, operating temperature, cyclic aging, self-discharge, and usage behaviors. A drive cycle-based analysis is best suited to represent the usage behavior. The performance analysis of Light Electric Vehicle (LEV) batteries with Indian driving cycles has been carried out with a simulation model in this paper, as the drive cycles have a significant influence on EV performance. The Indian urban and Indian highway drive cycles are used to evaluate the battery performance parameters. The discharge current profiles of the Indian drive cycles are generated for Tata Nexon electric vehicle parameters to represent the Indian driving scenario closely. The SOC and battery voltage degradation, battery thermal behavior, and energy consumption are evaluated for the Indian drive cycles using the developed models.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Control of Soft Switching Technique based DC Converters for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research paper is focused on the development of a soft switching technique based non-linear sliding mode controller (SMC) and hysteresis controller in DC buck converters to improve their performance metrics, including rise time, settling time, and delay time. The findings show that the non-linear strategy is more effective in achieving a rapid system response. The soft switching scheme developed using zero voltage switching at the converter's input, reduces the overshoot voltage in the output of the converter circuit. In electric vehicles fast working buck converter circuits ensures reliable and efficient operation improving the overall performance of electrified transportation systems.

articleTitle: Serverless Web Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Nowadays as the technology grows and as the applications are getting advance human work are getting more easier but at the same time the expenses of managing the infrastructure are very costly. So, for that there is a serverless services in which coders just have to manage their code nothing else. Its cloud providers responsibility to take care of that infrastructure. In this research paper, serverless computing is the main term things will revolve around. This is a extent of a microservices architecture used by the cloud providers before and has been introduced in past recent years. This research paper will give importance, benefits of serverless computing through a web application which is serverless. I will be making the serverless web application with the help of different services provided by AWS cloud provider. The services which I will be using includes AWS Amplify, AWS Cognito, AWS S3 bucket, AWS DynamoDB, Code commit, Lamda, API gateway. We also will talk about the technology that brings this concept. Monolithic and Microservices plays the crucial role in this serverless computing. I have also focus on Virtual Machines, and how powerful are they. Also we will see the container based application. I have used virtual machine and containers in my project.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring System for Patient Illness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Healthcare monitoring and observation system has grown to be one of the most essential fields in recent years. For health monitoring there are many existing technologies like Bluetooth, RFID, NFC and WBAN. Lack of medical attention and proper surveillance has resulted in illnesses and death among many individuals. A reliable IOT-based comprehensive health monitoring system has come to rescue. This costeffective efficient alert system can be used with remote monitoring and control. Traditional methods of health monitoring have disrupted huge population and have posed challenges to India’s current health care system. In the traditional practice doctors handle the patient in shifts. Due to the insufficient medical staff for health monitoring may leave patient at times on risk of life. To combat these issues a smart technological system for health monitoring has been proposed. This smart system continuously monitors main vital signs like, BPM, Heart Rate, Body Temperature and SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. This smart device has an alarm which sounds when certain parameters surpass fixed threshold and it has also a SMS Alert system. This alert system informs caretaker or medical professionals to take quick action to save life of patient.

articleTitle: Design of 1×8 Circularly Polarized MIMO Antenna Array for n257 Frequency Bands for 5G Automotive Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the recent technological development of the high-speed network, it is mandatory to have the reliable, secure and uninterrupted connection for various use cases in automotive and commercial industry. Beam Scanning feature of the antennas can ensure the mentioned features for the effective communication. This article presents the compact circularly polarized patch antenna with wide band 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth. Also, the linear array is proposed in the form of multi-input-multi-output configuration. The proposed design resonates in n257 frequency band dedicated for the 5G communications and achieves the gain of 15.2 dBi with 3-dB axial ratio of 700 MHz. The beam scanning feature of the design demonstrates the ±30° beam shift. The performance parameters of the design are suitable for various automotive 5G applications.

articleTitle: Future for Cleaner Environment: A Hybrid Machine Learning Approach for Intelligent Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Intelligent waste management is becoming increasingly vital in addressing the challenges posed by escalating waste volumes and environmental concerns. The standard methods for handling waste are frequently economical and ineffective thus sophisticated technology alternatives must be used. Using the strengths of both convolutional & recurrent neural networks, this research suggests a hybrid machine learning strategy for intelligent trash management. The study highlights the opportunity of machine learning to transform the effective management of waste and also clarifies the shortcomings of traditional approaches through an extensive analysis of current approaches. Specifically, the focus is on RNN-based algorithms for sequential data processing. The experimental evaluation demonstrates the superiority of RNN-based architectures, particularly gated recurrent units (GRU) and bidirectional GRU models, in classifying waste images into distinct categories. These models exhibit robust performance and outperform other RNN and CNN algorithms, validating the efficacy of the proposed hybrid approach.

articleTitle: Deciphering How Country of Origin and Brand Trust Impact Generation Z's Purchasing Choices: A Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Present study investigates into the effect of origin country and brand trust on Generation Z's buying choices. Data is accrued from 200 Generation Z respondents and analysed to discover key insights. Results display a strong correlation among considering the origin country and brand trust and making purchasing choices, along the substantial influence of emblem consider on buying alternatives. The interaction among those factors highlights their joint significance in shaping client perceptions and purchase intentions. Additionally, the examine underscores the position of product best notion and the blended impact of relied on brands and favourable country on purchase goal. The studies methodology involved convenient sampling and information collection through online survey systems, followed by means of statistical evaluation strategies which include comparative analysis, mean calculation, and general deviation calculation. Overall, the findings provide treasured insights for groups seeking to correctly goal Generation Z clients with the aid of understanding and leveraging these influential factors., the findings provide valuable insights for businesses seeking to effectively target Generation Z consumers by understanding and leveraging these influential factors.

articleTitle: On the use of Metal-Only Wideband Reflectarray for X/Ku band Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A single-layer metal only reflectarray antenna is designed. The unit cell consists of a I-shaped metal with a cross-dipole slot on it. The cross-dipole slot element gives multi resonance and hence better phase and bandwidth are achieved. Since no substrate is required for the design of the structure, hence dielectric loss is ignored. The interelement spacing is kept as λ/2 (at 10 GHz). The reflectarray is designed for high gain and wideband application. A circular aperture reflectarray is designed. The diameter of the reflectarray aperture is 300 mm and it contains 314 elements. The aperture efficiency of 40.3% is obtained. The length of the inner cross dipole is varied to obtain the desired phase. A pyramidal horn antenna of 15 dBi gain is used as a feed. The gain of the reflectarray is 26.3 dBi in the broadside direction. The 3-dB gain bandwidth of 41% (10-15.2 GHz) is obtained. The side lobe level is suppressed to -16 dBi. The designed antenna can be used for satellite communication and CubeSat application.

articleTitle: Design of Slotted Substrate Integrated Waveguide Antenna for Ka-band Automotive Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, a slotted multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) antenna is presented for mm wave frequency bands and 5G wireless applications. The proposed design resonates in n257 frequency band dedicated for 5G communication according to 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> generation partnership project (3GPP). The presented antenna design exhibits excellent impedance matching of -29 dB with the gain of about 8.5 dB. Also, the antenna covers required impedance bandwidth of 500 MHz with mutual coupling of about -35 dB. Further, in the context of beamforming feature, the proposed design achieves the ±15° with the progressive phase shift of feeds of the antenna structure and also the design demonstrates the excellent performance in terms of diversity parameters. The proposed design is suitable for various 5G automotive use cases with the calculated data rate according to link budget calculations.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Second Generation Voltage Conveyor using MVF
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the novel design of second generation voltage conveyor (VCII) realization. The proposed circuit is based on class-AB merged voltage follower (MVF) technique which is used in implementation of VCII at output stage. The merged voltage follower is a highly efficient buffer cell commonly used for low power and low voltage. MVF provides the decreased output impedance along with the low power consumption. The applications of the proposed VCII as a filter are also presented. Using 180nm CMOS technology at a low supply voltage of ±0.9V, the proposed VCII results are verified and simulated. By utilizing this proposed circuit, the performance of the filter applications thoroughly analysed and validated.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of Different Machine Learning Algorithms for Crop Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A significant portion of Indians view agriculture as their main source of revenue. Crop production is a significant industry in our nation. Applications of machine learning are changing the data processing and decisioning process that have a significant influence on the world economy. The natural nutrients or physiochemical characteristics of the soil aid in the understanding of the dynamics of the soil ecosystem by the researchers and are essential in assisting farmers in making daily choices. In order to forecast and evaluate soil properties and make better decisions on agricultural soil health management, our work focuses on closely examining and assessing machine learning (ML) methodologies.Machine learning has entered the picture with the introduction of big data technologies and high-performance computers, creating new opportunities for data-intensive research in the interdisciplinary field of agricultural technology. On the other hand, single-component soil property predictions were not as accurate. In the long run, combining these technologies can have revolutionized contemporary agriculture by raising crop yields and reducing waste. Helping someone cultivate crops successfully to obtain a high yield is the aim of this activity. Estimating enhanced crop output through the application of machine learning algorithms, which are utilized in crop yield estimates, is one of the challenging issues facing the agricultural sector. We have implemented the five supervised learning models. Random Forest give the best accuracy score of 97%.

articleTitle: Smart Dining Room Ordering with Sentiment Analysis for Customer Satisfaction: The Intelligent Restaurant Concept
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A good restaurant should provide great food and service, or it must have clean and pleasant dining areas. Ordering in most restaurants involves interacting with the staff. Waiters play a vital role in delivering excellent service and ensuring customer satisfaction. Mistakes in coordination during busy times often lead to unhappy customers. Wait staff commonly make errors in taking orders from diners, impacting the restaurant's reputation and customer satisfaction. As a result, the idea of an Intelligent Restaurant was developed. To address this issue the proposed work utilizes the QR codes situated on each dining table so that customers can conveniently place their orders without any interruptions. The database of restaurant has been created using proposed smart restaurant system. The integration of databases aims to elevate the quality of services provided and enhance the overall dining experience for customers and analyzing sentiments from the reviews received from customers. Moreover, the database is utilized for predictive purposes, particularly in anticipating daily order trends and analyzing sentiments. This predictive technology assists restaurants in effectively managing their inventory levels.

articleTitle: Spoken Language Identification using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A crucial problem in natural language processing is language identification, which has applications in speech recognition, translation services, and multilingual content. The five main Indian languages that are the subject of this study are Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, English, and Gujarati. A Deep Neural Network is introduced in the paper which is specifically made to use Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) for sophisticated language categorization. The suggested architecture of the model, which includes batch normalisation and tightly linked layers, helps it to be adept at identifying complex linguistic patterns. Comparing the research to the source work [18], promising improvements are shown, highlighting the potential of the model in language detection.

articleTitle: Evolutional Study on KNN and K-means Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: We are currently in a technological age when fresh innovations are making human job quick and easy. One of these subjects is machine learning, which enables a machine to carry out tasks in accordance with what it has learned and understood. Machine learning is being utilized to guide a lot of programmers online. These devices can recognize our traditions and preferences in the same way that people do. Machine learning is now applied in a wide range of industries, including finance, medicine, retail, social media, robotics, automation, and game apps. These various sectors employ various algorithms. The objective of the work is a comparison of the KNN and K-means algorithms. They differ from one another marginally, according to the evaluation research. K-means clustering is a tool for organizing data into groups without predefined categories, like sorting a mixed bag of items based on their similarities. Conversely, KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors) is a useful machine learning technique in which fresh instances are classified or predictions are made by the algorithm based on labeled examples. We have also implemented and compared the performance of these algorithms using a real-world dataset.

articleTitle: Integrating Radar and Communication System: A Two-Stage Detection System with Ambient Backscatter for Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The development of communication technology and radar is completely separate from one another. However, the collaboration of the two technologies has promise for paving the way for the requirement of the upcoming technology, including vehicle detection for collision avoidance, data encryption while driving, and other growing technologies. Both civilian and non-civilian applications are quite concerned about data security. This work describes that in order to maintain the low probability of intercept (LPI) by the intruder, symbols that are to be broadcast have been hidden in the ambient backscatter of intra-pulse radar waveform. Then, utilising a two-stage detector that constrains several aspects including multipath and time-reversal approach to increase spatial-temporal focusing in addition to line-of-sight, the system’s performance is evaluated in terms of Bit Error Rate (BER) of the symbols recognised at the receiver.

articleTitle: Smart Fashion Recommendation System using Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The fashion sector is expanding quickly in the digital age, and this means that more sophisticated recommendation systems that improve user experiences and expedite the online purchasing process are required. This work proposes a sophisticated and all-inclusive fashion recommendation system that uses machine learning techniques, specifically Random Forest, to enhance suggestion accuracy and efficiency. Users can choose their preferred fit and style using an interactive interface, which enables the system to offer clothes based on their individual profiles. Moreover, Context-based filtering involves personalizing recommendations to users based on a variety of contextual factors which may include user preferences, current fashion trends, occasion, style, body type and others. As a result of the dynamic recommendation process, the recommendations are constantly improved and grow more specific and well-rounded over time. The outcomes showcase the system's capacity to effectively combine various machine learning algorithms to evaluate a wide range of data sources, including user preferences, item features, and contextual information, to provide individualized recommendations.

articleTitle: Leveraging Generative AI in Creating Innovative and Functional Room Designs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the realm of interior design, using artificial intelligence (AI) to produce aesthetically pleasing and practical space designs has grown in popularity. In this study, we provide a comprehensive interior design approach using state-of-the-art AI models [6]. Our methodology combines state-of-the-art methods such as Diffusion Prior Networks, Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP), and Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to generate beautiful room interior designs and layouts based on textual descriptions. We provide a detailed description of each component, including details on how it functions and how it promotes the overall design process [3]. Through study and experimentation, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our system and its potential applications in revolutionising interior design processes.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient k-Means Clustering Algorithm for WSN using Virtual Grid and Sink Mobility
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Hierarchical based routing is a routing technique that create virtual hierarchy among network sensor nodes. The network is split up into small clusters that effectively increase network lifetime. The traditional clustering algorithms available in literature have some limitations. These algorithms do not consider the self-organized dynamic topology that is present in WSNs. Uneven distribution of cluster heads resulted due to these limitations. This uneven distribution of cluster heads effected the overall network energy consumption. In our work we proposed a virtual grid and sink mobility-based routing scheme with k-means clustering technique for a WSN. It combines the effect of dynamic route adjustment due to sink mobility with k-means technique for cluster head election of each grid cell or cluster. This scheme divides the network into small grid cells and then select cluster head for each grid using k-means algorithm. After initial cluster head selection, a virtual backbone network established and mobile sink moves at a relatively optimal predefined path inside the network. Dynamic routes re-adjustment cost incurred by sink mobility is minimized by virtual backbone network. Proposed scheme enhances the stability of the network and increase the overall lifetime of the sensor network.

articleTitle: Substrate-Dependent Characteristics of AlGaN/AlN/GaN DH-HEMT: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of Dual-Channel (DC) or Dual-Heterostructure (DH) Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.21</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.79</inf>N/AlN/GaN High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMT) using three different substrate materials: Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, GaN, and Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. TCAD simulations are employed to compare the critical device characteristics, including Id (drain current) versus V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf> (gate voltage), Id (drain current) versus V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</inf> (drain voltage), transconductance (gm) versus V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf>, and cutoff frequency (fT) versus V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</inf>. This comparative analysis aims to identify the optimal substrate material for DH-HEMTs based on their electrical performance. The DH-HEMT structure itself incorporates a thin AlN layer sandwiched between AlGaN and GaN layers [1]. This design creates a double channel for electrons, enhancing carrier confinement and potentially leading to superior device characteristics compared to single-channel HEMTs. By exploring different substrate materials, this study seeks to optimize the overall performance of DH-HEMTs for potential applications in high-frequency and power electronics.

articleTitle: Improving Table Tennis Serve Tactics with Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research study aims to analyze the table tennis serve shot tactics with the help of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) coupled with Random Forest (RF) models. The study aims thus to identify patterns and prescribe accurate serving strategies as seen through advanced algorithms. The current study employed a video database of table tennis professional players' match clips with high-quality videos. All the serves observed in the data set were described by information about the type of a serve (topspin, backspin, sidespin, no spin), speed, location, and outcome. Based on the existing literature, the CNN-RF model enhanced performance more significantly than conventional analytical methods. The model also exhibited better general performance results of about 89%, much higher than the 76% obtained through traditional techniques. The CNN-RF model had an accuracy of 0. * for both datasets, along with the precision, recall, and F1-score. 89 each, which highlights that consumers of the proposed approach also exhibit high accuracy in classifying or predicting all tiers of servers. The ROC curve plotted using binary logistic regression was 0. Substantial values of 92 imply that the created model has a sound discriminatory power, achieving the study's goal. The results of the training and validation measures were quite similar, showing the training accuracy of 94% and the validation accuracy fluctuating around 91% after the 20th epoch. The confusion matrix showed that the model did an excellent job correctly classifying service kinds, although mistakes were made.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Assisted Antenna Design for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The performance of 5G networks is significantly influenced by the design and optimization of antenna. Machine Learning (ML) plays a significant role in antenna design by enabling the optimization of antenna parameters and configurations for enhanced performance. In this paper, the optimal design of an antenna using machine learning, specifically designed to operate at 3.5 GHz is presented. The data acquired from the Parametric Analysis (PA) is employed to develop a regression model. Six different ML regression algorithms like K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest, Decision Tree, XG Boost Regression, Ridge Regression and Support Vector Machine (SVM) are employed. Among these, Decision Tree and Random Forest Regression offer minimum mean square error and better predictions. The antenna designed using both PA and ML are compared and analysed. An antenna design based on ML achieves performance comparable to conventional patch antenna and an optimized antenna design based on PA. Moreover, it exhibits 43% reduction in size when compared to the conventional patch antenna.

articleTitle: An Analytical Comparison of Crime Prediction using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Predicting crime rates is a crucial part of public safety, and improving predictive capacities calls for interdisciplinary work. This work uses multi-year datasets from Chicago to investigate the use of machine learning algorithms in crime rate prediction. Five machine learning models (Polynomial Regression, Random Forest, LightGBM, XGBoost, and Linear Regression) are carefully cleaned and analyzed in order to determine how well they predict crime patterns. The results show that XGBoost Regression performs better than the other models, exhibiting better prediction accuracy and data-generalization capabilities. Conventional linear models such as Polynomial and Linear Regression reveal limits in capturing the intricacy of crime data, however LightGBM and Random Forest Regression also demonstrate encouraging results. The study emphasizes the significance of choosing suitable machine learning algorithms for tasks related to crime prediction and points to potential directions for further investigation, such as fine-tuning models and investigating sophisticated algorithms. In general, the results offer significant perspectives to the discipline of criminology, with the goal of augmenting public safety and facilitating the advancement of more efficacious approaches to deterring crime.

articleTitle: Subthreshold Biased Low Noise Amplifier for Low Power Medical Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A low power dissipating low noise amplifier for biomedical application is presented in this paper. The LNA is implemented using standard 0.18 μm CMOS technology and to reduce the power consumption of the LNA, all the transistors are made to work in subthreshold region. Inductive source degeneration cascode topology is used for design of the LNA. To achieve optimum performance at low power dissipation, power constraint simultaneous noise and input matching technique is used. The LNA exhibits an input reflection coefficient (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>) of -15.4 dB, and output reflection coefficient (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">22</inf>) of -15.7 dB. It achieves a noise figure (NF) of 2.37 dB, a gain (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>) of 17.5 dB, a reverse isolation (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>) of -32.4 dB. The proposed design consumes 570 μW of power from a supply voltage of 1 V and achieves good stability with a stability factor (k<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf>) of 2.5.

articleTitle: AI Based Attendance System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In our modern-digital age, monitoring attendance system in education institutions play a pivotal role for insuring accountability, optimizing resource utilization and enhancing efficiency. Methods that are being followed traditionally such as taking attendance Manually are prone to errors, very time-taking, causes lack of scalability. To over come this challenges, our research proposes an innovative AI based attendance monitoring system using Ml is designed to bring a revolutionary change in the way attendance is managed in Education System. This proposed system importance's "State of the art" computer vision techniques, Machine Learning Algorithms and modules of Deep Learning to automate the attendance tracking process. On Integrating cameras installed in universities with advance facial technology, which accurately identifies, record and stores the students attendance without requiring any type of manual intervention. Besides, the system incorporates intelligent features to deal with various scenarios such as occlusions, varying lighting conditions, and facial expressions, ensuring robust performance in real-world environments Through seamless integration with existing student data set and cloud-based platforms, this proposed solution facilitates centralized data management, empowering administrators with actionable insights for strategic decision-making and real time monitoring.

articleTitle: Automatic Number Plate Recognition System using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The system employs video processing technology to detect the image of a vehicle's number plate from a video stream. Subsequently, various algorithms are applied to extract the number from the detected plate. This system can be used at college entrances, cantonment area and other places with strict access restrictions. The system detects the number plate whenever a vehicle passes by, converting it into both images and text. Subsequently, this information is stored in the database for future reference or analysis. This research paper introduces ANPR system which is designed to optimize accuracy, efficiency, and ease of implementation which includes combination of Python programming language, YOLOv8 (You Only Look One-level), and EasyOCR, the proposed system addresses the complexities associated with detection of license plate and recognition in diverse real-world situations. Core of the system lies in the adoption of YOLOv8, an object detection model renowned for its real-time capabilities and high accuracy. EasyOCR, a user-friendly Optical Character Recognition (OCR) library, is seamlessly integrated into the ANPR system. This addition enhances the system's ability to accurately extract alphanumeric information from detected license plates, bridging the gap between detection and recognition phases. Due to this the system ensures efficient noise reduction, image segmentation, and overall improvement in the quality of input images, contributing to the system's reliability. The paper presents an in-depth evaluation of the ANPR system's performance through datasets. Additionally, the research explores potential applications of the ANPR system in real-world scenarios, emphasizing its applicability in traffic management, law enforcement, and security systems.

articleTitle: Human Action Recognition Using Pose-Guided Graph Convolutional Networks and Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Human Action Recognition is pivotal in applications like surveillance and human computer interaction. This model introduces a unique approach combining Pose-Guided Graph Convolutional Networks for feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory networks for both temporal modeling and action classification. The hybrid framework adeptly addresses complex spatial and temporal relationships in human motion data. Pose-Guided Graph Convolutional Network captures features from pose and skeleton data by leveraging inherent body movement structure. Long Short-Term Memory excels in modeling sequences, capturing intricate temporal aspects of actions. Integrating Pose-Guided Graph Convolutional Networks’s spatial insight and Long Short-Term Memory’s classification capabilities, our hybrid model offers a holistic solution for accurate human action recognition and classification. This innovative fusion of Pose-Guided Graph Convolutional Networks and Long Short-Term Memory presents a promising direction, enhancing systems with robustness, accuracy, and comprehensive motion understanding.

articleTitle: Wideband Band Pass Filter For High Band 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this article, a concise wideband bandpass filter (BPF) with the intended passband characteristics and improved edge selectivity is formulated. This study proposes the use of a bandpass filter for 5G applications. The wideband spectrum (21-29 GHz) is the intended target of the filter's construction. The filter is comprised of two quarter-wavelength parallel-coupled line sections operating at an approximate centre frequency of 26.4 GHz. In the middle, between the coupled line sections, a parallel stepped-impedance open-ended stub is loaded. To enhance effectiveness of the filtering process, a Y-shaped stub is integrated into the design. At the pivotal juncture where the coupled line segments meet, a Y-shaped remnant is placed.
