By implementing this alteration, the filter is capable of attaining an increased degree of selectivity in its filtration process. Following the implementation of the filter configuration on an RT/duroid 6002 substrate, HFSS simulation was employed to ascertain the validity of the proposed filter.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Monitoring and Forecasting for Sustainable Adaptive Irrigation System using CatBoost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Agriculture is essential for the expansion of sustainable development. It is the backbone of the global economy, and its success is contingent primarily on the availability of water. The growing population in coming decades is probably going to boost this demand. It is a must to use new strategies that optimizes the water quantity required for irrigation in order to meet this sustainable demand. However, only watering is not sufficient for optimal plant growth. For overall plant health monitoring a data monitoring and estimation for approximating the plant growth is required. With the aid of global and local control, crop productivity can be made and adaptive soil moisture (SM) prediction model can control the required water and nutrients to be supplied to it. Developing the perfect model for SM prediction can be difficult, though, because of the many structural features and climatic variables involved. This work presents an internet of things (IoT) database creation facility and soil moisture forecasting facility using CatBoost algorithm. The IoT integrated sensors are used to monitor the parameters needed for optimal plant health and growth whereas the forecasting model is required for an adaptive irrigation system and increase crop yield to sustain an ever-growing economy.

Author Keywords: Data driven adaptive irrigation management system (DDAIMS)

articleTitle: Towards Smarter Cities: Federated Learning and CNN for Pothole Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: One specific need often associated with the maintenance of urban public assets, including roads, is the identification of potholes as part of maintaining the structures’ reliable, safe condition. This research presents an FL-CNN model that eliminates the limitations of the traditional approaches used for pothole detection. Our technique leverages the feature extraction strength of CNN and the privacy-preserving advantage of FL to enhance detection accuracy without compromising the patients’ data. The CNN-FL model was employed with test results and data collected from various cities containing a broad spectrum of road conditions and circumstances of the environment. The model got an accuracy of 91. 01%, exactness of 92. 1%, while the recall value registered an average of 87. 5%, F1-score of 88. 3%, which also outperforms the original centralized CNN model’s performance. The latter reached an accuracy of 88.5 % and a precision of 85. 3% and the recall capacity of 82. While the Ridge classifier attained the highest accuracy level of 76. 9%, precision of 7%, and an F1-score of 84. 0%. Hence, Federated Learning (FL) enables distributed training models while ensuring the original data does not leave the client’s device. Thus, it guarantees privacy and security. It is also ideal for broad applications that can be carried out in various large metropolitan areas. Additionally, the high evaluation of accuracy and recall shows that the model efficiently identifies potholes with fewer false positives and negatives.

articleTitle: A Novel CNN-based Approach for Pneumonia Detection using Keras and TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Our research paper explores the application of deep learning in pneumonia detection, focusing on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approach implemented with Keras and TensorFlow frameworks. By analysing chest X-ray images, the proposed CNN model aims to automatically identify pneumonia indicators. Extensive experimentation on a substantial dataset demonstrates the effectiveness of the approach, achieving high accuracy and robust performance across various evaluation metrics. The model's ability to accurately distinguish pneumonia cases from normal cases underscores its potential as a valuable diagnostic tool for healthcare professionals. This study highlights the promising role of deep learning techniques in enhancing pneumonia diagnosis and healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Drain Current Characteristic in Sub-10 nm Technology through p+ Pocket Negative Capacitance Double-Gate MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: At transistor-level design minimizing dimensions and lower power consumption are the key parameters that have emerged as intense research topics. This paper presents the design of a p+ pocket Negative capacitance double gate MOSFET with a gate length of 10 nm with help of gate and channel engineering techniques to enhance subthreshold and ON/OFF performance. The double gate MOSFET stands out as a promising transistor option due to its enhanced subthreshold performance, making it particularly well-suited for low-power VLSI design. By employing an oxide layer of dielectric and coating of second oxide with ferroelectric material, can enhance the tunability of negative capacitance, significantly boosting the efficiency of FETs. The addition of a p+ pocket in the MOSFET structure further enhances the performance by modifying the channel properties and facilitating better control over the transistor’s operation also leads to improved barrier subthreshold conduction during the OFF-state of the transistor, while minimally impacting the ON-state current. The proposed device design and performance analysis are conducted through TCAD 2D/3D device simulation software developed by Cogenda.

articleTitle: Case study on Concentrated Solar Thermal system in Dairy Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Concentrated Solar Thermal (CST) system installed in dairy industry is taken for the study. Specifically, CST installed in Madurai and Sholinganallur AAVIN, the Tamil Nadu Cooperative Milk Producers Federation is considered for the analysis. The role of CST in dairy processes are evaluated and the significance of steam generation with CST is discussed. Furthermore, the reduction of furnace oil for steam production and CO2 emission per year is observed and compared. In this CST system, the role of Thermo-electric Generator (TEG) is elaborated and how the large-scale medium temperature in various industrial sectors can be utilized and converted into electric energy is deliberated. Furthermore, the significance of the IoT enabled system is expounded at the end.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Application in PQRS Segment Detection in ECG Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The electrocardiogram is a vital piece of information about a person's health that provides measurements of changes in the cardiovascular system. When using complex software modules to diagnose diseases, the clinical ECG signal is always tainted by power line interference and electromagnetic fields, leading to inaccurate results.Therefore, it's critical to reduce these ECG data acquisition recording inaccuracies in order to perform precise clinical analysis. We are working on an algorithm that will split the data array of three successive ECG signals into three equivalents. The Empirical Mode After decomposing the data matrix and running it through the Independent Component Generation algorithm, we will identify and remove any noisy components using deep learning scheme. To obtain an error-free result of ECG data, we will then apply reverse ICA and EMD features for deep learning.

articleTitle: Ant Lion Optimization Based PID Controller in DC Motor Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the application of Antlion optimization (ALO) tuning approach to obtain the optimal parameters of PID controller to regulate the speed of DC motor. The ALO method was applied to minimize the ITAE objective function to determine the optimal gains of the PID controller, that will drive the system with minimal rising and settling times. The transient and robustness analysis were carried out to determine the effectiveness of the technique. Comparison with various approaches was conducted, effectively resulting in the proposed approach to demonstrate an improved performance. These approaches comprising of ASO-PID, GWO-PID, HHO-PID and SCA-PID are some of the best algorithms used in literature having the best results.

articleTitle: Design of Conformal Antenna for UAVs in 5G Midband for Reliable Coverage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In today’s technological development, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) play a vital role in defense, military purposes, and various civil domains. In UAVs, conformal antennas are in active demand due to their low observability and ability to transform into any shape. In this paper, a conformal antenna was designed to support 5G UAV communication. The proposed antenna has a series-fed design with an even number of dissimilar patches. A novel inset feed is provided between the patches to achieve maximum radiation. The final stage of the patch is designed to allow maximum radiation at 3.13 GHz (mid-band for 5G)with a bandwidth of 33.8MHz. The targeted band’s proposed antenna offers reliable UAV 5G transmission coverage. The antenna performance is analyzed using parameters such as the reflection coefficient (return loss), bandwidths, and E-field and H-field radiation patterns.

articleTitle: Optimizing Solar Energy Harvesting Unveiling The Efficiency Boost With Maximum Power Point Tracking In Battery Charging System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research delves into the synergistic integration of a Cuk converter within a solar-powered battery charging system, employing Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) for optimal energy utilization. The study focuses on the intricate dynamics of a photovoltaic system, emphasizing the impact of the Cuk converter in enhancing the efficiency of energy transfer during battery charging. Lithium-ion batteries, renowned for their energy density and longevity, serve as the primary storage medium. The investigation extends to the state-of-charge (SOC) management of the lithium-ion battery, exploring how MPPT contributes to precise SOC control and improved charging performance. Through comprehensive simulations and analyses, this research illuminates the transformative potential of this integrated approach, providing insights into the future of sustainable energy systems.

Author Keywords: Cuk Converter Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) Photovoltaic

articleTitle: Overconfidence Bias And Trading Volume From Indian Stock Market By Vector Autoregression Testing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Overconfidence means excessive trading which is opposite concept of standard finance based onrationality phenomena and does not support Efficient Market Hypothesis. Therefore, the locus of the study is based on the interaction between trading volume and overconfidence bias. Empirically, daily data is used toprovide link between trading volume and return. The study used VAR Model and concluded that the past market returns influence trading activity of individual investor. Thus, we can conclude that overconfidence investors trade more than the others. The results hold key implication for investors, brokers, and policymakers for taking better trading decision.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Assessment of Green Energy System for Remote Location in Rajasthan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper aims to develop a rural electric energy system design framework and analyze the techno-economic assessment of standalone off grid with Hybrid-renewable Energy system for 13 SAD Satjanda village Sri Ganganagar district, Rajasthan, India by using Homer-Pro software with system has lesser cost of energy with high reliability when compare to individually solar PV system, Wind turbine power system and DG set system. To supply the continuous electric supply to 13 SAD Satjanda village for reliability and optimize design worked by reducing Cost Of Energy (LCOE) and net present cost for different hybrid models comparing outcome obtained by Hybrid model optimization of renewable energy by Homer-Pro software. Finally reduce the transmission power loss to remote village and provide continues supply and reduce carbon emission.

articleTitle: Optimising Electric Vehicle Selection in India: A Hybrid WASPAS and AHP Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: There has been an inclined shift towards the usage of electric vehicles in India due to environmental concerns and government policies of incentives. However, the most challenging issue when it comes to EVs is finding the perfect model out of the many available in the market. In this paper, we show an mathematical approach that involves the MCDA in the process of decision making. More specifically, the Weighted Aggregated Sum Product Assessment (WASPAS) method is used to sort the alternatives to the best choice, and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used to find how much weightage should be given to the criterion. However, by combining of these methods, it is easier to establish a sound evaluation bearing in mind the key factors like price, range, charging time, battery power, and torque.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in System and Software Engineering for Auto Code Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has profoundly impacted system and software engineering by facilitating the automation of complicated tasks, reducing errors, and accelerating the development process. AI-driven tools help enhance efficiency, improve code quality, and promote the generation of more adaptive and innovative software solutions. The present research uses AI-generated tools to explore how AI transforms code synthesis. The study will include a comparative analysis of the performance of manual coding and other automated methods to explore how AI can accelerate code synthesis and make modern web development more competent or effective. It is suggested in the research that with algorithmic and contextual consideration, the quality of code developed by the AI would be higher in most cases than by people due to lower error rates and shorter synthesis. Overall, the central conclusion of the research is that AI plays a crucial role in transforming systems and software engineering. The paper also includes information on ethical dilemmas, robust validation mechanisms, conservative modes, and current research.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Millimeter-Wave-Over-Fiber Transmission Link with Different Photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In optical fiber communication, there is an expo- nential growth in data traffic demand. Hence, there is a need for advanced and efficient signal generation methods that offer a wider frequency range, higher tunability, and lower distortion. These optical fiber networks have long-distance capabilities and high data rates essential for intercontinental connections. This paper investigates the performance comparison of PIN photodetector and avalanche photodetector (APD) in optical fiber communication in terms of quality (Q) factor and eye patterns. The simulation model, utilizing microwave photonics (MWP) technology, implemented in OptiSystem software incorporates a Mach-Zehnder modulator (MZM) for optical signal modulation and a Bessel filter for spectral shaping. Photodetectors are susceptible to noise, which may occur due to thermal noise, shot noise, or dark current, and generate signals with increased bit error rate (BER) and degraded signal quality. To overcome these problems, photodetectors with suitable materials and designs are utilized to improve responsivity and reduce noise levels. A maximum Q factor of 7.6019 and minimum bit error rate of 1.4075 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−14</sup> at 10 Gbps over a 25 km single-mode optical fiber network is obtained in the mm-wave wavelength range. Theoretical analysis of the suggested system is also discussed.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cloud Resources with Elephant Herding Optimization: A Novel Approach for Efficiency and Scalability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Today we all are persisting in a computerised world. Computer and internet together control a great deal of our life environment. Clouds are gaining increasing popularity in the IT world. Cloud computing is offering utility-oriented IT services to user worldwide. Cloud computing domain assist utilization by computerising envisioned assets that can be stipulation kinetically. Scheduling in cloud computing can be done in two ways, platform level where jobs or tasks from several consumers are planned on Realistic Machines for appropriate execution and infrastructure level scheduling where several Realistic machines are planned on physical machines signalized in datacentres. Nowadays optimisations are the trends which are very active in research fields. We had implemented different types of optimisation technique almost in every research field for decades. This paper elaborates one of the optimisation techniques which is swarm-based metaheuristic search method called EHO. This paper describes the EHO technique for task scheduling algorithm over cloud by considering the cost and time optimization factors.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Telemedicine in Disaster Relief Response Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Due to climate change many parts of the worlds are prone to natural disasters. Thus, disaster management is the need of the hour. Effectiveness of Telemedicine in Disaster Relief response management shows the demand for telemedicine in the current time to tackle disasters. This paper investigates the history and evolution of telemedicine, their types, demand, challenges and its prospects. The proposed model, CrisisResponsive E-Health Recovery, places an approach on a concise way to manage disaster in the least time without giving up accuracy. The suggested model has the best response time as compared to the other existing model. Wide implementation of this model will result in better recovery rates in disasters.

articleTitle: Automated AI System for Online Phishing Detection and Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the critical challenge of phishing attacks by using advanced machine learning (ML) approaches to efficiently identify and mitigate malicious websites. Phishing websites betray users by impersonating legitimate entities to extract sensitive information. This paper emphases on developing and implementing a robust ML model capable of differentiating between legitimate and phishing websites through a comprehensive analysis of URL features, website content, and associated metadata. The proposed approach employs a diverse dataset that includes both phishing and legitimate websites, with features extracted using both traditional approaches and innovative methods. Various ML approaches are explored, such as Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines, Random Forest (RF), and Neural Networks. These approaches are evaluated for accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score to determine the most effective model. Feature selection approaches are employed to discover the most significant indicators of phishing activity, improving the model's performance and interpretability. The RF Classifier demonstrated superior performance with an accuracy of 96.6%.

articleTitle: Predicting Heart Disease Holistically: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this study predicting heart disease by harnessing machine learning algorithms. By integrating a diverse array of patient data encompassing demographics, medical history, lifestyle factors, and biomarkers, the model aims to capture the complex nature of cardiovascular health. Utilizing a dataset comprising detailed patient profiles, we employ feature engineering to extract pertinent information and preprocess the data for predictive modelling. Numerous machine learning methods, such as neural networks, decision trees, random forests, and logistic regression, are trained and assessed to identify the most effective predictive model. Furthermore, ensemble techniques are investigated to enhance predictive performance and reliability. The findings illustrate the effectiveness of this comprehensive approach, as the developed model achieves high the precision, sensitivity, and specificity of heart disease prediction. By encompassing a broad spectrum of factors influencing cardiovascular health, this framework provides a robust tool for risk assessment and personalized intervention strategies. This study advances our understanding of predictive analytics in healthcare, equipping clinicians with valuable insights for early detection and proactive management of heart disease.

articleTitle: A 1-Bit Single Layer 16×16 Element Based High Gain Reflectarray Antenna for X Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, a single layer 1 Bit 16×16 Reflectarray antenna operating at 8.1 GHz is proposed. It has a high gain, low cross polarization level. There are two reflecting elements designed for reflection of required phase 0° to 360°. Each element provides one state, which is 0-state and the other one is π-state. Each element has same periodicity and same substrate. The operating bandwidth of the Reflectarray antenna is 8-10 GHz for reception and transmission. The required phase of both state is 180±30° and reflecting magnitude is 1.4 dB. The maximum reflecting gain of the Reflectarray antenna is 31.2 dBi at 8.1 GHz. The direction of the reflecting beam is -10°, and The cross-polarization level is -33 dB.

articleTitle: A Protection of a Transmission Line by Distance Protection Technique in RTDS Environmental
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: India has a vast and complex transmission network that serves electricity to diverse region across the country. This paper aims to propose and demonstrate a simplified protection scheme for a transmission line in a power grid. Real Time Digital simulator (RTDS) is used to simulate the power grid system designed single line transmission network Bus System. This protection scheme is done with the help of RSCAD and RTDS software. Distance protection is done by Series compensated transmission line. This work also emphasizes the use and advantages of an electromagnetic transient-type (EMTP) real-time simulator in the analysis of series compensated systems.

articleTitle: Ransomware Detection And Data Recovery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Attacks using ransomware have become a major cybersecurity concern that is both widespread and constantly changing, causing misery on people, companies, and organizations all over the world. An in-depth analysis of the ransomware detection and data recovery environment is provided in this survey study. It looks at how ransomware has changed over time, examines the many types of ransomware detection techniques, and looks at the most recent developments in data recovery techniques. We examine the advantages and disadvantages of signature-based, behavioral analysis, machine learning, and other detection technologies, illuminating their potency against both well-known and newly discovered ransomware variants. Additionally, we discuss current developments in data recovery techniques, such as backup options, decryption tools, and incident response plans. Through this survey, we hope to give cybersecurity professionals, researchers, and decision-makers a comprehensive picture of the ransomware threat environment as well as the tools and approaches that may be used to effectively battle it.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm-Based Time-Table Creation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Generating timetables is complex optimization process and monotonous task in an educational institution. That's why must meet all rules and restrictions are involved. Often manual scheduling leads to suboptimal allocations, time conflicts and considerable effort. This the project represents an innovative solution complexity of planning in modern, dynamic environments.By integrating genetic algorithms and others ML techniques, application empowers users to generate optimized plans effortless, providing adaptability in response to changing requirements.Genetic Algorithms are a strong subset Machine learning that simulates the process natural selection and evolution find solving complex optimization problems. There are genetic algorithms in this project deployed to address time schedule challenges creation. They offer the ability to create plans that maximize the use of resources while adhering to complex constraints. This approach ensures these schedules evolve iteratively, continuously improvements to better meet the needs of users. The Timetable Creation application is designed to streamline the planning process, accommodating a wide range of constraints and preferences while offering adaptability to changing circumstances.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Effective Hate Speech Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Hate Speech Classification, is an essential aspect of online content management, it involves identifying and classifying objectionable language in order to promote a safer online environment. This research's main goal is to use deep learning techniques to examine and improve the classification of hate speech. In current paper we are introducing a Deep Learning Hybrid LSTM-GRU model. The Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) architectures are combined in this model. We can see improved performance of the suggested Hybrid LSTM-GRU model. The model achieved 99.90% accuracy rate, along with metrics of 99.87%, 99.76%, and 99.88% for precision, recall, and F1 score, respectively. We did a comparative analysis against other approaches like LSTM RNN, TCN+CNN, CNN MLP, and 1D CNN models, and got better results. The proposed model shows a 7% improvement over LSTM RNN as well as it shows improvements over other existing models. The model's well-balanced approach effectively addresses the nuanced challenges associated with hate speech detection in diverse online contexts. The Hybrid LSTM-GRU model showcased improved performance over traditional models and gave better results in classifying online hate speech.

articleTitle: An Effective Hybrid Approach for Housing Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: With a growing student population, the demand for affordable and convenient accommodation near distant colleges has surged. This project involves data analysis and models like k-nearest neighbors, XG Boost and Weighted hybrid method to fulfil the demand of searching online rental services easily with high accuracy. We use a recommendation system to provide the best facilities to the students. Important factors like affordability, safety and easy accessibility are fulfilled by these models. With the help of these models, both students and room providers could benefit and overall room finding experience for college students would be enhanced.

articleTitle: Multiple Sequence Alignment in DNA Using Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the realm of bioinformatics, this study addresses the challenge of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) in DNA, where conventional methods often encounter limitations in handling large-scale genomic data efficiently. To enhance alignment precision and computational efficiency, we propose the application of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, a specialized type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). Trained to capture the intricate sequential dependencies inherent in DNA sequences, our LSTM-based approach is compared against traditional methods, showcasing promising improvements in alignment accuracy and computational efficiency. These initial results highlight the potential of LSTM networks to advance DNA sequence alignment, offering a novel solution to the complexities posed by diverse and evolving genetic information.

articleTitle: Two loop controlled Cuk - Buck Converter for input source power management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A new method for power management that regulates input source power using a two-loop controlled Cuk buck converter. Adding an outside voltage loop and an inner current loop enhances the topology of a typical Cuk buck converter. The outer voltage loop maintains the appropriate output voltage level, while the inner current loop controls the converter's output current. The converter performs better with this dual-loop control method in terms of efficiency, transient response, and stability under a variety of input source situations. The outcomes of the simulation show how well the suggested strategy works to control input source power while preserving steady output voltage regulation. System’s discrete time model is used to control source current and load power to obtain the best possible load allocation to input for each feasible combination of input and output variables. The suggested study addresses the use of RGA theory to improve comprehension of control loop dynamics and the selection of input and output for power management.

articleTitle: Automated Detection and Classification of Motorcycle Number Plate Formats to Improve Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Number Plates are necessary for every vehicle. The format of the Number Plate is defined by the governments. Nowadays, the number plate consists of religion and caste-based images. It also consists of regional languages, slogans and so on. If the students in colleges have these non-standard formats, they stimulate hostility among students. Hence, identifying the nonstandard number plate format is necessary for traffic police and college management. The objective of this research is to identify the non-standard number plates in two-wheelers. Hence, in this paper, Number Plate Format Recognition (NPFR) is proposed for two-wheelers. The format of the number plates is matched and the unformatted ones are identified. A dataset is created for this work from real-time CCTV images. Various experiments are carried out to analyze the proposed method. It is observed that high values of above 97% are achieved for various performance metrics.

articleTitle: A Smart Forest Fire Detection and Notification System using IOT and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, the proposed system presents a two-stage forest fire detection system that first uses a wireless sensor network of MQ sensors and a Node MCU and then a YOLOv8 forest fire detection model to reduce false alarms. The entire process is seamlessly integrated with the Raspberry Pi, which immediately triggers an email notification for quick action upon receiving confirmation of a fire. As the frequency and severity of wildfires continue to escalate, it is imperative that we take swift action to address their devastating impact. The YOLO model was able to achieve an accuracy of 92% with low power and memory consumption on the MCU. The method serves as a demonstration of the potential of combining innovative technologies to solve environmental problems and contributes to the development of effective and proactive fire detection systems using IOT and Machine learning.

articleTitle: IPL Player Valuation: A Data-Driven Approach for Efficient Auctions Using K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research presents a data-driven methodology for determining cricket players’ base prices in the Indian Premier League (IPL) auctions, aiming to streamline the auction process. Utilizing a comprehensive ball-by-ball information dataset covering all IPL matches until 2023, we established a preprocessing pipeline incorporating player performance metrics and auction data from 2014 to 2022. The Runs Above Average (RAA) metric is crucial to player valuation. Employing K-means clustering, we group players based on similar performance attributes (RAA), refining base price determination through Euclidean distance comparison across 14 key attributes. Evaluation metrics reveal a trade-off between accuracy and efficiency, with optimal accuracy at 76.34% achieved at k = 8 with an efficiency of 43.59%. Acknowledging limitations tied to cricket’s dynamic nature and cluster homogeneity assumptions, future research directions propose exploring dynamic clustering models, integrating external factors, and incorporating advanced machine learning techniques. This research introduces a systematic, data-driven approach to IPL player valuation, contributing to enhanced auction process efficiency and providing a valuable tool for informed decision-making by IPL franchises and organizers during player acquisitions.

articleTitle: Contextual Recommendation System: A Revolutionary Approach Using Hadoop, Spark, NLP and LLMs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study presents a novel framework for contextual recommendations on platforms like Wikipedia, integrating Hadoop, Spark, NLP, and LLMs. Leveraging these technologies, the framework aims to enhance user experiences by delivering personalized article suggestions aligned with their current interests. Through scalable data processing, advanced NLP techniques, and LLM-powered semantic understanding, the framework offers a transformative approach to recommendation systems, promising to revolutionize knowledge exploration on digital platforms.

articleTitle: Innovative Serve Shot Analytics in Table Tennis Using CNN-LSTM Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research study presents a new structure comprising CNN and LSTM networks for identifying serve strokes in table tennis. Analyzed in this study were serve shots, a crucial element of games, utilizing a dataset of 10,000 shots grouped into four types: The basic spin, which includes top spin and back spin, side spin and no spin. CNN-LSTM structure unites a potential for extracting the spatial characteristics of images of CNNs and the capability to process the temporal sequence of shots of LSTMs to analyze serve shots efficiently. The proposed model outclassed the existing classifiers with a significantly higher accuracy of 92%. In contrast, the other classifiers like Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, solo CNN, and standalone LSTM have been observed at 82%, 85%, 87%, and 86%, respectively. The average accuracy, recall, and F1-score, presented in the table below, shows how well each serve type was predicted. 92, 0. 92, and 0. 92, respectively. The AUC of all serve kinds was more than 0. 90, indicating the discriminating ability of the test in this regard was quite high. High accuracy and a low time complexity were achieved, with the training and validation curves showing a steadily increasing training accuracy of 92% and a validation accuracy that peaked at 91% by epochs 50. The training loss of the model reduces to 0. 20, and the validation loss is still at 0. 30, meaning that despite the high variance, the model is sufficiently generalized and does not overfit.

articleTitle: Empowering Sustainable Power Systems: Regression-Based Analysis of Building Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Energy conservation is the process of limiting the quantity of energy utilised for sustainable power systems, which can be accomplished by employing efficient energy. Additionally, with the daily need for energy growing, energy conservation has become a major issue in today’s world. Therefore, it is imperative that buildings manage their energy consumption more effectively and prominently. The heating load (HL) and cooling load (CL) of a building are counted as a major portion of loads in structures, just as in an HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) system. Therefore, it is crucial to estimate these loads of a building accurately. In this work, this analysis is performed using XGBoost gradient descent and regularisation techniques to refine predictions and prevent over-fitting for better sustainability. Moreover, SHAP interaction values depicted about the features having an impact-ful predictions relative to average values when compared with existing works.

articleTitle: Acoustic Based Drone Identification and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Drones have emerged as a gadget of the common man these days. Sectors ranging from agriculture, security, home delivery cinema industry, etc. are using drones to optimize their performance in respective domains. Such a wide and easy accessibility of drones have made them accessible to the users for illegal and malicious use as well. Moreover, there are certain areas which are sensitive from a security point of view therefore the entry of drones to such religions is restricted legally. But it is a challenging task to detect intruder drones in a sensitive region. A drone being a significantly small flying object is difficult to visually locate and identify manually. However, there are acoustics, thermal and electromagnetic signatures, which if detected can be used to mark their presence in the nearby region. In this article we have proposed an audio-based model for drone identification which can identify the presence of a drone in the vicinity if humming audio of the drone is found in the acoustics of nature.

articleTitle: U-Net-Driven Advancements in Breast Cancer Detection and Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Breast cancer remains one of the most prevalent malignancies affecting women worldwide, necessitating advancements in diagnostic methodologies to improve patient outcomes. Traditional imaging techniques, while effective, often require enhanced computational tools to assist in accurate diagnosis and treatment planning. In this study, we proposed a novel neural network architecture specifically designed for breast cancer segmentation and classification in ultrasound images. The model features dual-phase encoding and decoding stages, augmented with skip connections and dropout regularization, to optimize feature extraction and reduce overfitting. Evaluation on a comprehensive dataset demonstrates exceptional performance metrics, with an accuracy of 0.9887 and a dice coefficient of 0.9227, affirming the model’s robustness and efficacy in detecting and classifying breast cancer tumors. Collaboration with medical professionals for extensive validation will enhance the model’s interpretability and clinical applicability, ultimately improving early diagnosis and treatment outcomes for breast cancer patients.

articleTitle: Mango Fruit Disease Detection by Integrating MobileNetV2 and Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Mango, a prized fruit in tropical regions, ranks as the third most traded tropical fruit globally, following pineapple and avocado. Despite its economic significance, the quality of mangoes is often compromised by various factors, including diseases. This paper introduces an innovative approach to disease detection in mangoes, departing from traditional Convolutional Neural Networks models. Instead, we propose a hybrid model that incorporates MobileNetV2 for feature extraction, LSTM for capturing feature relationships, and dense layers for accurate disease classification. The model is trained on the MangoFruit-DDS dataset, comprising over 1700 images. To optimize training, the dataset undergoes augmentation and segmentation processes, enhancing the model’s ability to recognize and classify diseases accurately. This novel combination of MobileNetV2, LSTM, and dense layers enables the model to discern intricate patterns and dependencies within the mango data. Our goal is to achieve a higher level of accuracy in disease detection, contributing to improved mango production quality. The proposed hybrid model not only addresses the challenges posed by mango diseases but also underscores the potential of advanced models in agricultural applications. By leveraging the MangoFruitDDS dataset and innovative model architecture, this research aims to advance disease detection capabilities, fostering healthier and more lucrative mango harvests.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based Texture Transfer Between Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Texture transfer is a crucial approach in image processing which enables smooth transfer of textures between images while preserving visual qualities like color fidelity and texture details. This feature is essential for digital art, computer graphics, virtual reality, and textile visualization since it improves visual realism and creative expression. Existing methods frequently use complicated machine learning and AI models, which can be computationally expensive and difficult to apply. To ensure efficient and precise texture transfer, we use fundamental image processing techniques such as color space transformations and luminance matching. Our solution achieves smooth texture integration by matching the brightness of a style card image to a target color card image and incorporating chrominance information. This paper describes our image processing based methodology, from pre-processing to final image synthesis, which provides a computationally efficient and user-friendly alternative to machine learning techniques. The experimental results suggest that the proposed approach is effective and has the potential for a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Effect of Thickness on Dielectric Properties of 3D Printed TPU Substrate For Patch Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Three-dimensional (3-D) printing enables the use of printable materials to fabricate substrates for microstrip patch antennas. Radio frequency (RF) properties of 3-D printed substrates may vary significantly depending on the values of printing parameters used while printing. Therefore, 3-D printed substrates require their RF characterization. This study investigates the effect of substrate thickness on the dielectric constant and loss tangent of 3-D printed Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) substrates with two different thickness: 1.6 mm and 3.2 mm. Characterization results are further experimentally validated through the measurement of resonant frequency of two microstrip patch antennas, which were designed based on the RF characterization results. It has been observed that with the increase in thickness of the substrate the values of the dielectric constant and loss tangent parameters decreased.

articleTitle: Toxicity Unveiled: Understanding Online Conversations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Internet forums enable people to express their opinions and participate in discussions on a range of subjects in the current digital era. But sometimes, this right to free speech can lead to the dissemination of harmful remarks like hate speech, harassment, and other types of damaging material. Ensuring a secure and courteous online space requires identifying and eliminating remarks that are harmful. This research article investigates many approaches to detecting poisonous comments, including classic machine learning techniques like BOW and TF-IDF, and deep learning methods like LSTM. In addition, we explore the performance of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) regressor and decision tree models in categorizing harmful remarks using these variables. Through rigorous research and review, we show that these approaches are effective at recognizing hazardous remarks. Our findings help to build strong models for automated toxic comment detection, promoting healthier online discourse.

articleTitle: Integrated Methodology for Early Glaucoma Diagnosis Using Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research explores a comprehensive methodology to glaucoma discovery using retinal fundus images, aiming to enhance diagnostic precision through advanced machine learning techniques. We begin with a diverse dataset of retinal images, applying bilinear interpolation for resizing, and convert images to greyscale using the Luminosity method to highlight relevant features. Noise is reduced using an adaptive Normalized Least Mean Squares (NLMS) filter, followed by histogram equalization to improve contrast. Feature extraction is accomplished using the method called Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG). These features are then classified with a combined model of ResNet-50 and Multiclass Support Vector Machine (MCSVM). The model’s efficacy is evaluated using precision, accuracy, recall, and F1-score metrics, demonstrating high effectiveness with an 98.66% of accuracy, 98.99% of precision, and 97.87% of recall. Future work will focus on expanding the dataset, integrating multi-modal data, and enhancing model explainability to further improve glaucoma detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Low Cost IoT and ML based Pesticide Level Detection in Fruits and Vegetables
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The escalating usage of pesticides, steroids, and fertilizers pose severe health risks to consumers. Particularly concerning is the infiltration of harmful pesticides into fruits and vegetables further exacerbates existing health conditions, rendering them incurable. Addressing this issue requires a low-cost comprehensive solution to analyze pesticide levels in commonly consumed farm produces. This paper proposes a novel approach utilizing hardware-software co-design integrated with sensors such as temperature, pH, gas, and humidity, etc interfaced with Arduino microcontroller to detect pesticide presence in real-time accurately. The threshold for safe pesticide levels for various farm fresh products is adaptively set by Random Forest Algorithm that aids in identification of pesticides. To leverage IoT technology, data is transmitted to the ThingSpeak server, facilitating easy monitor of agricultural produce quality and safety. So that agricultural products starting from production to sales is streamlined, ensuring high-quality and safe food for consumers. Thus, risk management and traceability throughout the supply chain in real-world testing validates the efficacy of the pesticide detection device, promising a significant step towards safer food consumption.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a Queuing Dynamics Model in a Supermarket to Optimize the Efficiency: Case of Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Queuing theory is a mathematical approach used to analyze waiting lines or queues and to optimize their performances. It has numerous applications in different fields, such as telecommunications, transportation, healthcare, and retail sectors. In this paper, we analyze the data of a supermarket. This research paper focuses on employing Monte Carlo Simulation to evaluate the queuing dynamics and determine the optimal number of servers required to achieve maximum efficiency within the surveyed supermarket. The results serve as a valuable resource for supermarket operators to make data-driven decisions to minimize customer waiting times, optimize staff utilization and improve overall service efficiency. The proposed queuing model and analytical framework can be extended and applied to other retail environments, thus contributing to the advancement of retail queuing theory.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 2×2 Array Antenna for 5G and Ground-Based Navigation Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Modern communication demands antennas with ultra-wide bandwidth, high peak gain, and compact size for enhanced performance across a broad frequency spectrum. This study presents a novel 2x2 array antenna comprising four fractal antenna elements achieved by strategically cutting cylindrical slots of varying radii from edges and the center, alongside additional modifications. The antenna is designed on a Rogers RT-droid 5880 substrate measuring 50 mm by 50 mm, with a height of 1.6 mm and a patch size of 30 mm by 30 mm. Notably, the antenna exhibits a wide bandwidth and features multiple notches around 26.054 GHz, 28 GHz, 30.45 GHz, 32.086 GHz, and 33.312 GHz, achieving a high peak gain of 12.254 dBi. It effectively covers 5G applications within the 24.52 - 34 GHz range, functioning as a multi-band antenna with an ultra-wide bandwidth spanning from 24.52 GHz to 34 GHz. Specifically, it covers 5G millimeter wave bands n257 and n258, along with ground-based navigation frequencies. The antenna's performance was successfully verified through implementation using CST simulation software.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling of Network Structures in a Fuzzy Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In data transmission networks, particularly in large-scale industrial systems, series-parallel designs are often used to maintain reliability and efficiency. A reliable network ensures rapid communication, data transmission, and access to network resources, as well as the prevention of data loss and corruption leaks caused by network failures. The series parallel approach is a generic strategy used in network systems to improve dependability by mixing resources from both series and parallel configurations. In this study, the authors have utilized the techniques of Universal Generating Function and Intuitionistic Fuzzy Sets to evaluate the reliability of a network system. As an example, a data-communication network system with sub-systems; router, switch and computers are designed. The authors model the reliability of the complete system considering a general system of the same and further calculate the fuzzy reliability of the series-parallel arrangement as an application to the above mentioned analytical techniques.

articleTitle: Metaheuristics Approaches Towards Secure and Optimized Routing in IoT: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Metaheuristics are versatile and can be used as a team intelligence solution in today's optimization complex problems. These algorithmic structures offer the capability to find solutions to optimization problems and decentralized algorithms, such as IoT routing and security. IoT is a network composed of objects that can communicate with one another in the IP world. However, this composition of objects presents various challenges, including efficient routing due to the heterogeneous nature of the network and security requirements. Thus, achieving routing security becomes crucial for maintaining the IoT network and prolonging its lifetime. This paper focuses on metaheuristics algorithms by investigating nature-inspired, swarm intelligence and other types of optimization techniques referenced in the literature. The paper also explores routing security and performance attributes associated with metaheuristics algorithms and provides an exhaustive review of secure routing across different heuristics techniques for the robust operation of the IoT network. Additionally, it discusses potential challenges and future directions for integrating metaheuristics solutions in the rapidly evolving IoT landscape.

articleTitle: Enhancing Liver Cancer Diagnosis with Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Diagnosing liver cancer at an early stage is crucial to enhancing the possibility of treatment success and patients' survival rates because it remains a significant global health problem. This paper proposes a new CNN-Transformer model for diagnosing liver cancer from medical photos for better hospital diagnosis. The proposed model integrates feature extraction in the spatial domain with the help of CNNs while combined with the global context-capturing ability of Transformers, meaning that it removes the constraints of single models. Specifically, the hybrid model was trained and tested by a liver cancer image dataset that is available to the public. It was also compared with solo CNN and Transformer devices. The precisions achieved by the hybrid model were 95 per cent. Hence, we achieved an accuracy improvement of 2% and significantly outperformed the CNN (88. 7%) and Transformer (90. 1%) models. The hybrid model got the accuracy and the recall value of 94 per cent. 5% and 96. 0%, respectively. In this regard, the CNN model was established to offer a precision of 89 per cent of its outcomes, compared to an overall increase. 2% and a recall of 87. 5% the Bleu-4 score is 95%, while the Transformer model is 91%. 3 % and the average number of relevant documents recalled was 89—8%. The result evaluated on the chosen F1-score shows the model's obvious effectiveness of 95%. 2% surpassed the score of CNN 88%. It stands for 3 %, and Transformer's score is 90.5%.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Varying Infill Density Thermoplastic Polyurethane Substrate Based Flexible Antennas For IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents design, simulation and fabrication of 3D printed Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) based flexible substrates of two infill densities (100% and 40%), its characterization and then fabrication of Microstrip Patch Antennas (MPAs) on TPU substrates for IoT applications and their comprehensive bending analysis. TPU is a melt processable elastomer having enabling properties such as flexibility, excellent tensile strength, printability which makes it suitable material for fabricating flexible and conformal antennas. Initially, RF characterization of 3D printed TPU substrate of two different infill densities 100% and 40% was carried out using standard ring resonator method for obtaining the dielectric constant (ε<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf>) and loss tangent (tanδ). MPAs were then designed and simulated using ANSYS HFSS and fabricated on these two different infill density substrates. The measured resonance frequencies for 100% and 40% infill density antennas were 2.45 GHz, and 2.46 GHz, respectively. A comprehensive bending analysis was carried out to gauge the suitability of fabricated antennas for IoT applications. The measured results for all fabricated antennas are found to be well in agreement with the results of simulation.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Imputation Techniques Analysis and Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Missing values are a significant problem in data analysis and machine learning applications. This study looks at the efficacy of machine learning (ML)--based imputation strategies for dealing with missing data. K-nearest Neighbours (KNN), Random Forest, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Median/Mean Imputation were among the techniques explored. To address the issue of missing data, the study employs k-nearest neighbors, Random Forests, and SVM algorithms. The dataset’s imbalance is considered, and the mean F1 score is employed as an evaluation criterion, using cross-validation to ensure consistent results. The study aims to identify the most effective imputation strategy within ML models, offering crucial insights about their adaptability across various scenarios. The study aims to determine the best plan for data preprocessing in machine learning by comparing approaches. Finally, the findings help to improve our knowledge and application of imputation techniques in real-world data analysis and machine learning.

articleTitle: eSports on the Rise: A Statistical Odyssey Unveiling the Probability of Growth
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive statistical analysis of the burgeoning field of eSports, with a particular focus on its growth trajectory. Leveraging a variety of quantitative methods, we examine the factors contributing to the rise of eSports and predict its future growth potential. Our findings reveal a strong upward trend, driven by advancements in technology, increased accessibility, and the growing popularity of competitive gaming. We also explore the challenges and opportunities presented by this growth, providing a roadmap for stakeholders in the eSports ecosystem. This research contributes to the understanding of the dynamics of the eSports industry and offers valuable insights for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers.

articleTitle: PAPR reduction techniques for RIS-NOMA and STAR-RIS-NOMA systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) and Simultaneous Transmitting and Reflecting Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (STAR-RIS) are promising technologies for enhancing signal propagation in Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) systems. However, these systems can have high Peak-to-Average Power Ratio (PAPR), leading to inefficiencies in power amplifiers and increased signal distortion. To address this, we explore PAPR reduction techniques, focusing on their application at the base station, where power amplifiers are crucial and at the RIS or STAR-RIS surfaces, where signal distortion due to high PAPR can occur. Our approach considers the impact of channel conditions on PAPR as signals travel from the base station to RIS or STAR-RIS surfaces. PAPR reduction methods that are used in this paper are Partial Transmit Sequence (PTS), Selective Mapping (SLM), Tone Reservation (TR) and a new hybrid technique which is the combination of PTS and TR. From the results, we conclude that the hybrid technique outperforms all other methods employed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approaches to Device-Directed Speech Detection Using Multimodal Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Device-directed speech detection (DDSD) is essential for any speech-based interface and simplifies the utilization of voice-activated systems, especially in areas with high levels of noise interference. This paper studies the enhancement of DDSD (Distributed Denial of Service Detection) with multimodal fusion techniques. These approaches include the combination of the audio and the video feed to increase the detection level. The models were established to predict the baseline, where only the audio or video characteristics were incorporated with an accuracy of 75. 4% and 77. This, in turn, means that their recognition capability is at 8% correspondingly and highlights their limitations in any given environment with high noise levels. When combining audio and video information at the feature level, the accuracy was raised to 85—6% when the data was combined into a unified vector. Freescale also improved its performance by up to 88 percent. , decision-level fusion by achieving an accuracy of 2% from the fused classifiers' decision for each modality. The feature-level fusion technique and decision-level fusion produced the highest accuracy of 92% for the given methodology. The hybrid fusion model also presented outstanding AOC formative accuracy, recall, and an F1 score of 92. 8%, 92. 1%, and 92. Specifically, its performance in moderate noise levels, low noise levels, and interfering voice conditions was 87%, 89%, and 4%, respectively, thereby revealing its ability to cope with diverse noisy environments. The examination of the hybrid model's ROC curve depicted the model's excellent capacity in discriminating between the target customers, with an AUC of 0. 96%.

articleTitle: Classification of Lesions in Brain MR Images using Probabilistic Neural Network Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Classification of medical image forms one of the most important process in computer aided diagnosis and medical image applications. Classification of lesions in Brain MRI classification forms a complicated task due to its high complex and resolution in medical imaging. The proposed work consists of a novel classification method using Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) classifier. The Neural Network (NN) training is done in all the layers of the network. The classification results identifies whether the given image is Normal or Benign or Malignant. PNN classifier is used for its fast speed on training and its simple structure. Finally the classified image is bounded so that the exact region which is detected will be identified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Glycyrrhiza Glabra Phytocompounds using Network Pharmacology for Anti-Alzheimer Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a highly complex and neurodegenerative disease that has clinical symptoms like memory loss along with degrading cognitive functioning. The rise in the prevalence of this diseases in recent years attributed to modern lifestyle by various studies has created a crucial requirement to comprehend AD pathophysiology and create effective treatment plans. The intricacy and difficulty of both the disease and its underlying causes are demonstrated by the fact that over 200 viable medication candidates have failed clinical trials and that the advancement of AD is unaffected by the pharmaceutical techniques produced to date. The central pathophysiology of the disease has shown that AD is characterized by amyloid plaques of β-amyloid peptide. To overcome the complexities associated with AD, scientific investigations have shifted their focus towards the plant compounds resent in the ecosystem. Many plants and their compounds have shown efficacy for treating AD. In this paper we have studied all the phytocompounds of plant Glycyrrhiza glabra, known to contain potential anti- Alzheimers phyto compounds for therapeutic purposes. By utilizing the techniques of network pharmacology combined with molecular docking analysis, this paper provides a potential pathway to find new drugs and modify existing drugs based upon observations made by studying multiple compounds-target interactions.

articleTitle: Hiding Information using Image Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Image steganography is the procedure of concealing confidential information within a picture in a manner that it is imperceptible to human eyes. The word Stego in Greek means ‘cover’ and grafia means ‘writing’ so this can be termed as cover writing. This technique is used to secure data by concealing it from unauthorized access. This research paper's main objective is to provide an overview of image steganography and its techniques. The paper also discusses the advantages and disadvantages of image steganography and its applications. Deep learning algorithms used for this practice can be segregated into branches: Conventional Methods such as LSB replacement, LSB matching, DCT and DWT) and CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) based methods. This paper contains all the clustered procedures, limitations, benefits and barriers faced in advancement of this field.

articleTitle: Campus Ease: Elevating Student Placements and Career Success
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Campus Ease, a student-centric mobile application, is designed to enhance the college experience by addressing various needs throughout the academic journey. Its primary focus is on providing timely career notifications from the college's Career and Professional Development department (CCPD), ensuring that students stay informed about job and internship opportunities. The app further streamlines the application process by sending targeted push notifications to students with pending job registrations, promoting timely actions and facilitating efficient communication with CCPD. One of Campus Ease's key features is its Resource Hub, which empowers students with company-specific resources like past- year papers and mock tests. This resource hub aids in effective preparation for placement opportunities, providing students with valuable tools to excel in their career pursuits. Additionally, the app offers a unique dimension through Alumni Insights, presenting firsthand knowledge from successful alumni interviews categorized by respective companies. This feature enables students to gain valuable insights into career paths, learning from those who have navigated similar journeys. With its multifaceted approach, Campus Ease strives to be a comprehensive platform supporting students in their academic and professional endeavors.

articleTitle: Adaptive control-based Grid connected solar PV system with BESS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the new times distributed generations of renewable energies are particularly required for day-to-day utilization as the natural resources are very nearly annihilation. These renewable energy sources are a generally excellent answer for the worldwide energy issue. The utilization of renewable energy, as indicated by the measurements is around 30% everywhere, from which just 10% comprise of solar PV and wind power. These measurements show that we are lingering behind from extricating the solar power. There are different variables that can be consider responsible for this viz. exorbitant hardware, even we need more innovation to outfit the solar power. Solar power, as most renewable energy sources, is definitely not a consistent power source. We just can use or store it during daytime. We attempt to find the maximum power point (MPP) of the PV cluster and then, at that point, it is provided to the grid. In present work we have utilized Perturb and Observe (P&O) techniques to follow the. The MPPT calculation utilizes the IPV and VPV of the PV cluster and gives the MPP and a VDC, REF. This voltage is then given to the inverter and then, at that point, further to the three-stage grid. In this postulation different currents, for example, inverter current, grid current and load currents are researched.

articleTitle: Exploring Cost Efficiency and Sustainability:Electrical Vehicles v/s Internal Combustion Engine based Vehicles for Four Wheelers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study explores the cost efficiency and sustainability for four-wheeler electric vehicles (EVs) compared to internal combustion engine (ICE) based vehicles. With growing environmental concerns and the rising cost of fossil fuels, there is an increasing interest in EVs as a sustainable alternative to the traditional ICE based vehicles. The research aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the economic and ecological implications of adopting EVs over ICE based vehicles, offering valuable insights for consumers, policymakers, and manufacturers. Preliminary findings indicate that while EVs typically have a higher initial purchase price but they offer significant savings in operational and maintenance costs over time. The conclusions drawn will aid in informed decision-making regarding vehicle purchase and the development of policies to promote sustainable transportation solutions.

articleTitle: Design of High Gain Bidirectional DC-DC Converter with Improved Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Increasing demand for effective renewable energy applications has paved the way for many new innovations in bidirectional DC-DC converters. This study introduces a new bidirectional converter, engineered to provide high voltage gain with reduced devices. Apart from its extensive conversion range, the converter offers continuous input and output current, enhancing its compatibility with the DC bus and storage devices. The converter is a dependable option for high-power applications due to its simple circuit layout and fewer components, which allow it to successfully withstand voltage stress across the active switches. In order to make the system even more scalable, the suggested converter takes advantage of a common grounding architecture. Because it doesn’t need a greater duty cycle to achieve efficiency, the converter is well-suited for use with renewable energy sources. Improved scalability and dependability for use with renewable energy sources are goals of the design process. A comprehensive simulation analysis was conducted utilising the MATLAB Simulink environment to validate the proposed converter architecture. The outcomes are compared to the preexisting topologies. The outcomes show that the suggested converter improves voltage gain even with reduced duty cycles.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Wireless Platooning for Railway Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper provides an overview of the design and implementation of a wireless communication-based platooning system for trains. The system aims to improve train performance, increase safety, and reduce fuel and energy consumption by allowing trains to travel in proximity and communicate wirelessly with each other. By using Radio communication module NRF24L01, trains within the platoon can exchange vital information such as speed, position, and braking signals in real-time. This information sharing facilitates synchronized movements, reduces gaps between trains, and improves overall system efficiency.

articleTitle: Development of an SVM based Intelligent Relay for Fault Identification with LVRT Capability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The integration of renewable energy (RE) sources into modern power grids has significantly increased, driven by the global push for sustainable energy solutions. However, this shift brings challenges related to grid stability and reliability, especially in microgrids with high penetration of photovoltaic (PV) systems. Effective fault identification and Low Voltage Ride-Through (LVRT) capability are crucial for maintaining grid stability during transient disturbances. This paper presents the development of an intelligent relay based on Support Vector Machines (SVM) that incorporates LVRT capability. The SVM is trained using historical fault data to accurately classify various fault types, while advanced control algorithms enable the relay to maintain PV system connectivity during voltage dips. The integration of SVM-based fault detection with LVRT strategies ensures rapid fault identification and robust grid stability, enhancing the reliability and efficiency of microgrids with high RE penetration. This approach not only supports the transition to a more resilient energy infrastructure but also maximizes the utilization of renewable energy, contributing to a sustainable future.

articleTitle: Lane detection using the concept of Deep learning and Digital image processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Lane detection technology plays a pivotal role in enabling autonomous navigation in vehicles. However, existing systems primarily cater to well-structured roads with clear lane markings, rendering them ineffective in scenarios where markings are unclear or absent. This study critically evaluates an existing approach for detecting lanes on unmarked roads, followed by the proposal of an enhanced methodology. Both approaches leverage digital image processing techniques and rely solely on vision or camera data. The primary objective is to derive real-time curvature values to facilitate driver-assistance systems in making necessary turns and preventing vehicles from veering off-road.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of 12/16 Pole Flux Reversal Motor with Different Permanent Magnets using Ansys
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper represents design and analysis of 12/16 pole Flux Reversal Motor (FRM) with permanent magnets mounted on stator pole shoe. In this paper, various permanent magnets are taken to analyze the behavior of torque, induced voltage and flux linkages and other parameters, and a comparison is drawn to analyze the effect of PM in FRM. The rotor of the suggested 3-phase FRM is free of permanent magnet (PM), and this design may increase rotor durability. This design with PM mounted on stator surface will lower consumption in comparison to the permanent magnets on the rotor's surface. The study of this methodology includes a 3-Dimensional (3D) finite element analysis (FEA) to examine the performance and magnetic field distribution of 12/16 FRM. The FEA analyses the motor's performance, including moving torque as well as the magnetic field distribution of the rotor and stator under various circumstances.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Methods of Yoga Pose Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Yoga practice offers numerous health benefits, and the accurate monitoring of yoga poses is pivotal for effective guidance and performance evaluation. This paper introduces a novel deep learning model for real-time prediction of yoga poses from video feeds. Leveraging state-of-the-art techniques in pose estimation, our model demonstrates robustness across diverse datasets, capturing the nuances of varied poses in different environments. We present a comprehensive methodology encompassing dataset collection, preprocessing, and model training, highlighting the model’s adaptability to real-world scenarios. Experimental results showcase the effectiveness of our approach, achieving competitive accuracy metrics. Furthermore, we seamlessly integrate the model into a real-time system, allowing for instant feedback and visualization of predicted yoga poses. This work contributes to the intersection of computer vision and fitness monitoring, fostering advancements in interactive and personalized yoga training. The presented model not only enhances the accessibility of yoga practice but also sets the stage for broader applications in gesture recognition and human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Pioneering Enzyme Classification by Combining EDA with Sequential Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study presents an innovative method for enzyme classification by integrating Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with a Neural Network (NN) framework. Utilizing a dataset of 858,777 annotated amino acid sequences from ten different organisms, the approach predicts enzyme categories in a test set of 253,146 samples, excluding sequences that exceed a predefined length. The preprocessing steps involve removing infrequent amino acids (X, U, B, Z) and addressing amino acids (B, Z) present only in the training set. The Neural Network model, featuring an embedding layer, bidirectional LSTM layers, and a dense output layer, achieves a notable accuracy of 79% on the test data after 20 epochs. The model's performance is further evaluated with a detailed classification report and confusion matrix across 20 enzyme categories. This research highlights the effectiveness of combining EDA with NN techniques in advancing enzyme classification in bioinformatics and molecular biology.
