Future research will focus on incorporating additional features and optimization techniques to further enhance the model's performance.

articleTitle: Developing a Blockchain Framework for Enhancing Security in Food Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel blockchain framework aimed at enhancing security measures within food supply chains. By integrating blockchain technology, the framework seeks to ensure transparency, traceability, and tamper-proof data recording throughout the supply chain. The proposed solution addresses common challenges such as food fraud, contamination, and inefficient recall processes by enabling real-time data access and immutable record-keeping. Through theoretical analysis and practical implementation, the study demonstrates the potential of blockchain to significantly improve the integrity and reliability of food supply networks. The findings suggest that blockchain technology not only strengthens security but also enhances the collaboration and trust among all stakeholders involved.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Segmentation Using UNet with VGG19
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Accurate segmentation of brain tumors from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans is essential for the diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring of patients with brain disorders. This paper presents a novel approach for automated brain tumor segmentation using a hybrid architecture that integrates the VGG19 convolutional neural network as the encoder and the U-Net architecture as the decoder. The VGG19 encoder is utilized for feature extraction, taking advantage of its capability to capture hierarchical features from input images. The U-Net decoder, well-known for its effectiveness in semantic segmentation tasks, refines the segmentation masks by integrating both low-level and high-level features. By combining the strengths of VGG19 in feature extraction and U-Net in spatial localization, our proposed model achieves precise and robust segmentation of brain tumors in MRI images. Extensive experiments are conducted on benchmark datasets to evaluate the proposed approach against state-of-the-art methods. The results demonstrate superior performance in terms of segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency, underscoring the potential of the VGG19-U-Net architecture.

articleTitle: Solution of Economic Load Dispatch by ParticleSwarm Optimization in Renewable Integrated Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Economic allocation of prevalent demand among participating generators is an important aspect for power engineers. It’s a complex optimization problem which involves several constraints to be met at the same time. In this paper the problem of economic load dispatch is investigated for IEEE three generating units. Particle Swarm Optimization technique with time varying acceleration coefficients (PSO-Tvac) is taken as the solution methodology and results are compared with Classical Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO) and other methods implemented on the same test case. Further, modelling has been done for the inclusion of PV based solar generation and wind generation with conventional thermal generation. The saving in fuel cost/day is also reported for the case undertaken. The entire work has been done in MATLAB environment. The results show that PSO and its variants are effective in solving non- linear convex ELD problem.

articleTitle: Chip Design using OpenROAD
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper reports layout design of an 8-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) using OpenROAD platform followed by optimization of the design in terms of design area, power consumption, leakage power and place density. A System on Chip (SoC) is a device that integrates most or all components of an electronic system which include processing unit, memory, input/output devices alongside other components, on a single substrate. An Arithmetic logic unit is a fundamental building block of a microprocessor, which performs arithmetic and logic operations on the operands in computer instruction words. After detailed study of the working of OpenROAD flow scripts, a sample Arithmetic Logic Unit was designed. OpenROAD-flow-scripts were used to obtain the Graphic Data System (GDS) level design from the Register Transfer Level (RTL) level design and the final layout was obtained in the OpenROAD graphical user interface.

articleTitle: An Innovative Approach: Hybrid Firefly Algorithm for Optimal Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the past years, the primary challenge was creating technologies which are able to store huge amounts of data. Today, the focus has shifted towards effectively yoking this abundant data and extracting valuable information. This includes the strategic usage of feature subsets within datasets, rather than relying on the complete feature set. We have proposed a novel feature selection algorithm which is the modified form of the foundational firefly algorithm. We have used simulated dataset for performing experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed feature selection algorithm outperforms state-of-art techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an IoT Based Real-Time Virtual Smart Energy Meter using Labview
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Worldwide energy demand is increasing exponentially. Thus, the need to measure it becomes inevitable to reduce the energy wastage. To that end, proper metering infrastructure is required. This research work proposes the designing and implementation of virtual smart energy meters using LABVIEW to monitor the power and energy consumed by the consumer. In this work, two virtual energy meters have been developed. One is a simulation-based virtual smart energy meter considering two fans, two ACs, eight lights, and one projector as loads. The other is an IoT-controlled real-time virtual smart energy meter. For remote control of physical loads, an IoT-controlled real-time smart energy meter has been proposed by the authors using the BLYNK IoT platform. For data acquisition two current sensors (ACS712), two voltage sensors (ZMPT101B) and an acquisition card (NI USB-6008 ) have been used. For manual control of the load two manual switches and automatic control, one relay module (4 channels) has been considered. For real-time load, two incandescent lamps 100W each are used in this work. The real-time power calculations using the developed virtual smart energy meter have been compared with actual power measured using a hardwired digital energy meter and the results have been in close agreement with those of the digital energy meter with an accuracy of 4% which is within acceptable limits as per IEEE standards.

articleTitle: Optimized Leading Zero Count Structure for Arithmetic Computations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The Leading Zero Counting is an elementary block in floating point arithmetic operations. We present an optimized structure for Leading Zero Count (LZC) operations. Contingent on newly derived Boolean relations for the bits, 8-bit LZC is obtained. LZCs of further bit widths are designed and assessed. We focus on Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) implementations of LZC at 45nm technology and thereby analyzed and compared the results with 3 other existing architectures. The results serve to have significant reductions in the overall power area delay product of the circuits.

articleTitle: SiRNA: A distinctive approach towards cancer Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Addressing the global health burden posed by cancer necessitates the exploration of innovative therapeutic strategies. Small interfering RNA (siRNA) has emerged as a promising role player in cancer treatment owing to its capacity to selectively silence genes implicated in tumorigenesis. This paper presents a thorough examination of the current landscape of siRNA-based cancer therapy, spotlighting its mechanisms of action, delivery methodologies, and clinical utilities. Beginning with an elucidation of the molecular mechanisms driving siRNA-mediated gene suppression and its implications for cancer management, the paper navigates through diverse strategies aimed at augmenting siRNA delivery to cancerous cells, encompassing nanoparticle-based carriers, viral vectors, and chemical modifications. Additionally, the paper scrutinizes clinical investigations probing the efficacy and safety profiles of siRNA-based therapeutics across varied cancer subtypes, accentuating recent breakthroughs and persisting hurdles. Concluding with a discourse on future trajectories and emergent trends in siRNA-based cancer treatment, including personalized medicine initiatives and the innovation of novel delivery platforms, this paper underscores the transformative promise of siRNA in reshaping the landscape of cancer therapy and offers valuable insights into optimizing its translational potential.

articleTitle: Designing of an Active PFC Converter using Boost Topology and Power Train Model for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: With the increase in the population of a country, the number of vehicles is also increasing, which hence increasing the pollution day-by-day, which is a major concern. To minimize the pollution caused by the vehicles, automobile industries started manufacturing non-carbon emissive vehicles which does not use conventional fuel to run, instead rely on other energy sources like solar or wind to store the energy in the batteries and use that energy to run. In this process, the two major aspects to be taken care are of designing the best-suited converters for charging the batteries and running the motor and other auxiliary components in the most efficient manner with the least possible losses, and secondly to ensure proper integration of all the systems of a vehicle like battery management system, power converters, braking system, traction system (motors), etc., to ensure smooth running of the vehicle. This paper describes the best-suited power converter configuration for an electric vehicle, including the power factor correction technique, which is also a major issue, and describes an efficient way of integrating the various EV systems considering all possible factors that affect the integration process.

articleTitle: A CPW Based Elliptical Patch Antenna for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The paper presents CB-CPW planar elliptical shape CST- MWS for both conditions, case I when the antenna is placed in free space and case II, when it is placed on human body phantom (HUGO human body model of VOXEL family) in CST-MWS for SAR analysis. The volume of the simulated CB-CPW patch antenna is 40mm×40mm×1mm. The antenna exhibits the broad side gain of 3.45 dBi in free space at operating frequency of 2.56 GHz. The designed antenna is of elliptical shape with a circular patch at the center. The radius of the central patch is selected in antenna for medical body area network (MBAN) applications. The proposed antenna is resonating frequency at 2.56 GHz of 220 MHz bandwidth. The implemented MBAN antenna design is simulated in such a way that the operating frequency lie within the desired frequency range. The designed elliptical shaped antenna is simulated using the CST MWS 19 software. The radiation efficiency of intended elliptical shaped patch antenna is 88% in free space. According to FCC of United States, the SAR value must fall in range (1.6W/Kg) for the biomedical applications. Thus, SAR is a significant parameter for designing of the biomedical antenna. The simulated SAR value (analysis using HUGO model from VOXEL family in CST) of the designed antenna is within range of safety guide lines issued by the regulatory authorities (FCC & IEEE).

articleTitle: Application of Optimization Techniques for Frequency Stability Improvement in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The paper presents adaptive virtual control strategy for inertia support in the present power network with increased penetration of RES. Owing to low inertia response capabilities of RES frequency degradation manifested. To address abovementioned challenge, modified PSO based PID controller is used to make the HESS participates in inertia support to enhance frequency response. Comparison between conventional PSO and modified PSO was carried out. Frequency is measured at PCC to achieve frequency nadir, settling time and ROCOF after each disturbance.Finaly, simulation of microgrid was carried out in MATLAB to verified control strategy effectiveness.

articleTitle: Role of Machine Learning in the Prediction of Thyroid Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Numerous thyroid disorders impact people throughout the world. Numerous conditions can affect the thyroid gland, such as hyperthyroidism, hypothyroidism, and thyroid cancer. Thyroid illness patients may have excruciating symptoms. Effective classification and machine learning are highly useful in making timely thyroid illness diagnoses. This categorization will affect the patient's timely treatment. An endocrine ailment or condition known as hypothyroidism occurs when the thyroid gland does not generate enough thyroid hormone. Experts in the present system suspect hypothyroidism based on symptoms; it is a scientific investigation. The diagnosis of hypothyroidism can only come from a series of diagnostic tests. To ascertain their thyroid health, some groups need more precise tests. In India, 42 million individuals are estimated to have thyroid illness. The incidence of thyroid disorders has increased in recent years. Hyperactivity and hypothermia are two of the less common symptoms caused by thyroid gland disorders. Many people are diagnosed with thyroid diseases including hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism each year. A shortage of T3 and T4 hormones can result in both hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism. A strategic forecast of thyroid illness is required to ensure that the patient receives appropriate care at the appropriate time, save needless deaths, and minimize medical costs. Using state-of-the-art technology to enhance medical processes for the detection and prevention of thyroid issues is extremely desirable. The information from the UCI repository, Kaggle, and GitHub is used to categorize thyroid illnesses. similar to KNN, Logistic Regression, and Naïve Bayes, these algorithms also yielded results with up to 96% accuracy.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Autonomous Navigation with Cutting-Edge Deep Learning Image Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: As autonomous vehicles continue on the path to widespread integration, enhancing their visual perception and cognition capabilities is imperative for reliable operation in diverse real-world conditions. This paper chronicles the rapid evolution of methodologies powering image recognition within autonomous systems, from traditional handcrafted feature engineering to the current dominance of deep learning. Through an exhaustive literature review, the profound impact of deep neural networks is highlighted, automating hierarchical feature extraction and elevating recognition accuracies beyond human constraints across several standardized benchmarks. However, despite remarkable progress, state-of-the-art models demonstrate fragility when confronted with corner cases, occlusion and adverse weather - warranting extensive real-world validation focused on safety. Moreover, fusion of complementary sensor streams, pioneering cross-modality correspondence techniques, and emphasis on model transparency and scrutiny offer pathways for developing fail-safe recognition capabilities. This research synthesizes developments spanning seminal early systems to modern learning-based paradigms providing perspectives on the innovation landscape driving enhanced environmental perception for self-driving automobiles. By reviewing the state-of-the-art, limitations and open challenges, this paper informs trajectories for continued progress in instantiating reliable computer vision for autonomous vehicles deployed across diverse conditions.

articleTitle: Design of CrossYagi antenna with Azimuth rotator for tracking CubeSat in Low Earth Orbit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A cross Yagi antenna with the feasibility of tracking 3U CubeSat at a height of 450km from earth surface which comes under LEO orbit is proposed and demonstrated in this research paper. The proposed cross Yagi antenna, unlike its available counterparts is designed to operate at 435MHz, obtained the gain of 9.01dBi and is paired with an azimuth rotator to track the CubeSat. The radiation efficiency for the Yagi antenna is achieved as 96.4% which shows as a good performance. Software such as MATLAB and 4nec2 are used to get the simulated results for the proposed antenna. Furthermore, the azimuth rotator is designed. The integration of cross Yagi antenna and azimuth rotator done on Fusion360 presents a holistic solution geared towards improving satellite tracking precision, in line with the requirements of contemporary space exploration and communication systems.

articleTitle: Solar Wireless Electric Vehicle Charger with Cooling Fan Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research presents an advanced solar-powered cooling system seamlessly integrated with IoT functionalities offering a comprehensive solution for enhanced functionality, efficiency, and sustainability. The proposed system comprises a transmitting section incorporating essential components such as a solar panel, voltage regulator, Node MCU, temperature sensor, 12V DC fan, and transmitting coil. Utilizing the temperature sensor, the system dynamically regulates the fan operation, activating it when the transmitting coil’s temperature surpasses a predefined threshold to initiate cooling. Meanwhile, in the receiving section, a diode, potentiometer, and Node MCU collaborate to facilitate seamless wireless communication, enabling remote monitoring and control of critical parameters such as coil temperature and voltage during charging cycles. The development of the user interface is a testament to modern web technologies, with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript being employed to create an intuitive and visually appealing platform for real-time data visualization and system management. Through this integration, the system optimizes energy utilization and bridges the gap between renewable energy sources and smart cooling technologies, this integrated approach not only addresses the pressing need for eco-friendly cooling solutions additionally lays the background for a more environmentally friendly and sustainable future.

articleTitle: Exploring Diabetic Retinopathy Diagnosis: Insights from a Comprehensive Literature Review and Initial Fundus Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This article looks at recent advances in diabetic retinopathy (DR) detection with retinal fundus and optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) pictures. Key studies have investigated a variety of methods, including combining Multiscale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) and Bi-LSTM networks for high accuracy, integrating the Internet of Things (IoT) with deep learning for increased sensitivity, and using Multi-Stream Deep Neural Networks to classify DR severity. Innovations like the PMNPDR system for microaneurysm detection and deep learning ensembles for OCT images have also performed well. Despite these gains, issues like as data transfer latency, model complexity, and reliance on tiny datasets remain. Overall, while current models show great potential, they require further modification and validation to assure their efficacy and applicability in clinical situations.

articleTitle: Blockchain-powered Solutions for Ensuring IoVT Data Confidentiality and Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The Internet of Vehicular Things (IoVT) has revolutionized vehicular networks in the way the data of two or more related networks is exchanged and how traffic is managed in the blink of an eye. However, this breakdown of barriers drastically amplifies the level of connectivity, which has immense security implications. Hence, this research paper proposes a security framework that leverages blockchain technology to solve these challenges. It leverages the decentralized, immutable and transparent nature of blockchain technology. The framework's efficacy rested in analyzing data accuracy, availability interval, transmission rate, and aptitude to fend off attacks. As for the line of data integrity, the indicated system made it impossible to tamper with or make illicit changes to the data. The blockchain processes achieved an average latency of 200ms. Thus, vehicular communications are within the allowable range, ensuring timely information exchange. The framework proved scalable to a large extent, whereby it processed an average of 150 transactions per second, which is particularly important to enable large networks of IoVTs. Moreover, it was proven that the proposed architecture possessed high immunity to different types of attacks, including data control attacks, unauthorized access, and denial of service attacks. There were no successful assault attempts, as the heatmap showed, pointing to the framework having extreme security measures. The training and validation accuracy and the loss graphs depicted improvements in the status of the security model, over time, as reliable and enhanced.

articleTitle: Unveiling Enhanced Model Predictive Control for Power Regulation in Single Phase AC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This article presents enhanced MCP controller for active and reactive power regulation. Constant switching frequency is obtained through optimization of PMW. The regulation of the Dc voltage is achieved by using PI controller. The effectiveness of the adopted optimization technique is confirmed by its validation using Matlab/Simulink environment. This validation demonstrates its sturdy performance and reliability, hence confirming its practical appropriateness for real-world application. The control scheme is a multi-objective; active as well as reactive power from enhanced MCP controller precisely regulated to the required levels, resulting in little deviation and shorten restoration time. In addition, dc voltage was regulated independently.

articleTitle: DGA Based Transformer Fault Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In power transmission network transformer plays an important role, so its protection attains much more attention in order to have fault free supply. When the mineral oil inside the transformer is subjected to high thermal and electrical stress gases are created from the decay of mineral oil. Distinct type of fault creates diverse gases and extractions of these gases from the sample gives helpful data about the state of oil and type of fault. Early identification of fault reduces the failure rate. This work proposed Machine Learning Based Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) technique to diagnose transformer faults. In this work multiple machine learning models are developed and tested using the DGA dataset. Outputs are generated under different Validation schemes. Also the optimization algorithm with feature selection using ANOVA test and hyper parameter tuning using random optimization is proposed and acquired the Validation removes over 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Real-time Fire Detection using Image and Video Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: There has been a rise in the frequency of fire-related calamities all over the globe, which leads to the need for an efficient fire detection system to avoid high losses or fatalities. This paper focuses on real-time fire detection techniques through image and video processing. In particular, this paper is aimed at a color detection approach that uses HSV and YCbCr color models for detecting only fire pixels along with the implementation of fire movement detection approach by comparing consecutive frames from the live feed. Overall, the study contributes to advancing fire detection methodology, highlighting the potential of image processing methods in real-time fire detection systems.

articleTitle: ContactLensIris: A Robust Iris Recognition System based on Integrated Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The popularity of iris-based biometric systems used for authentication systems is increasing day by day and some covariates such as contact lenses, aging, etc. reduce their efficiency. So, this work aims to develop an efficient recognition system that ensures the performance of the proposed system in the presence of contact lenses. This proposed system named ContactLensIris, first enhances image quality using median filter and contrast enhancement. Segmentation is used to separate the iris and pupil and this work uses histogram equalization. Features of the segmented iris image are extracted using ORB, BRISK, and CNN, fuse all these features followed by a fully connected layer, and compute the classification probability for final results. The proposed system is first trained with 70% of the data of NDCLD15 and then the rest 30% is used for testing and validation. The obtained results of the proposed ContactLensIris ensure its effectiveness with 98% CCR and 1.6% EER.

articleTitle: Enhancing VLSI Performance: An Innovative Approach to 3-Parallel Polyphase Odd-Length FIR Filtering with Kogge-Stone Adder and Booth Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel technique towards enhancing VLSI performance as 3-Parallel Polyphase Odd-Length FIR Filtering. Here, the design primarily consists of Kogge-Stone Adder integrated with Booth Multiplier to increase the speed and efficiency of the Kogge-Stone Adder. Traditional FIR filtering has its limitations on power consumption and area optimization. To address the issues, we make use of the architectural features of Kogge-Stone Adder and the computational efficiency of Booth Multiplier by introducing the 3-Parallel Polyphase composition to overcome the issues by increasing the processing speed while maintaining low-power constraints and a small chip area, both of which are critical factors in today’s VLSI applications.

articleTitle: Speaker Recognition for Hindi Language Using Convolution-ResNet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The work presents speaker identification using deep learning. Deep learning-based speaker identification is presented in this paper. The process of recognising a speaker from their uttered words is known as speaker identification. Security, speaker tracking, forensic speaker recognition, surveillance, and authentication are among the uses for speaker recognition technologies. Deep learning for Hindi voice was used in the creation of the system for identifying speakers.. The ResNet-based architecture to extract speaker embeddings. The results of the research can be utilised by the investigator to producer speaker identification Text-dependent speaker verification systems.

articleTitle: Development of the Condition Monitoring System for Battery in Automobiles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: As the electric and hybrid vehicles is becoming increasingly prevalent, the efficiency and reliability of their battery systems are critical factors in their performance and longevity. The battery is one of most critical component of vehicle, this paper presents the development of a condition monitoring system for batteries in automobiles. Using the proposed system, the current state of battery is analyzed from the degradation in its efficiency in compare to its pristine state. Therefore, the developed system will aid in increasing the condition based replacement of battery in order to improve the reliability and serviceability of vehicle. Furthermore, the same set-up can also be used to benchmark the quality of batteries provided by different manufacturers.

articleTitle: Robust Cattle Disease Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The existence of diseases in cattle offers many challenges in the practice of cattle rearing, not only in productivity but also in profitability. This paper examines the feasibility of employing a blend of CNN and SVM in persistently diagnosing cow diseases. This proposed model incorporates the ability of CNNs in feature extraction and SVMs in classification to boost the performance of illness diagnosis. The collection contains photos of affected cows with mastitis, foot and mouth disease, and bovine respiratory disease. These photographs were collected from veterinary clinics, farms, and internet sources. The preprocessing steps performed on the dataset were scaling and normalization with data augmentation techniques such as rotation, flipping, and contrast correction on the images. The developed hybrid model CNN-SVM reached the accuracy of classification 95%, which is significantly higher than compared to the classical ones (75%), or only CNN (88%) and only SVM (84%). Based on the results, the accuracy rate was 94%, the recall rate was 95%, and The F1 score was 94. 5%. The examination of the accuracy matrix led to the identification of high sensitivity and specificity of the model for all the identified illness groups. Further, the AUC-ROC values were steadily high all the time, indicating that the model has the best performance in classification between the classes. This paper has demonstrated that the CNN and SVM integrated approach is solid and efficient when classifying cattle diseases. This approach constitutes a stable and flexible instrument for diagnosing diseases in real time in agriculture.

articleTitle: Deep Transfer Learning based Speech Recognition for Low Resource Hindi Language
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) stands out as a pivotal technique, steadily gaining prominence by facilitating seamless communication between humans and technology. Due to a shortage of substantial speech datasets for model training, ASR systems for most languages lack acceptable performance, despite achieving human-like performance for a limited number of languages. In this study, we leverage the Hugging Face ecosystem to fine-tune state-of-the-art Whisper Speech architecture to showcase the efficacy of transfer learning technique in ASR tasks, yielding momentous enhancements in accuracy and performance compared to conventional training methods. Our findings underscore the potential of transfer learning to advance ASR technologies and provide insights for future research endeavors in this dynamic domain.

articleTitle: Front-End Designing and Implementation of Vedic Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research introduces a novel approach to designing and implementing a high-speed Vedic multiplier utilizing the Urdhva Triyakbhyam Sutra. Employing Vivado 22.2 and Verilog as primary tools, our objective was to engineer a multiplier optimized for speed and efficiency. The initial phase commenced with the development of a 2×2 stage, which seamlessly scaled up to a 16×16 multiplier while maintaining consistent performance and scalability. Integration of partial product stages was facilitated through the utilization of Carry Look Ahead Adders (CLAs), enhancing overall efficiency. Through extensive comparative analysis, our multiplier demonstrated a notable reduction in delay and efficient resource utilization. Notably, it exhibited commendable power efficiency, showcasing its suitability for diverse applications. This implementation marks a significant stride in the realm of arithmetic computation, underscoring our commitment to advancing computational capabilities.

articleTitle: Investigating Transient and Steady State Stability of IEEE-9 Bus System for Integrating Renewable Energy Using Real-Time Digital Simulator
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: With the modernization and advancement in technology, the magnitude of power required is enhanced exponentially. This escalated power requirement introduces transients in the system which must be controlled for a stable power system operation. This paper explores the change in the magnitude of power flow during and after the implementation of renewable sources of energy which plays a critical role in the stability enhancement of power systems during transient and steady-state conditions. The method proposed is validated on the IEEE 9 bus system for analyzing the effect of renewable integration and load variation on system transient and steady-state stability and deterioration of the voltage profile of the system. This paper also explores the effect of integrated wind generators and solar generation on the improvement of the voltage and frequency profile of the test system during variable loading. In this research, a Real-Time Digital Simulator (RTDS) with a Phasor Measurement Unit (PMUs) is employed to display the voltage and frequency profiles of the network. To validate the results obtained from the proposed method suitable comparison with ieee-9 bus data is performed and discussed.

articleTitle: Blockchain Empowerment: Revolutionizing IoT Device Security with Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The term "Internet of Things" (IoT) refers to the coordination of a sizable number of recognizable, globally interconnected, and accessible physical items. The Internet of Things was required to safeguard device communication. For its gadgets, security, and authentication are crucial. For data security and authentication, many apps are employed. This paper presented work based on the ethereum blockchain network for registration and data authentication of IoT devices. The data is authenticated by using the public key and the time stamp of the transactions. The Ethereum blockchain, smart contracts, and wallet are all used in this paper. Ethereum wallet serves as the backend and is used to deploy transactions. Through transactions, smart contracts are written and deployed on the Ethereum blockchain. Functionality for registration and authen-tication is provided through smart contracts. Through the web, the user and smart contract can communicate. The environment for developing smart contracts is running on an Ethereum virtual computer.

articleTitle: ICU Monitoring Using Zynz Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the realm of modern healthcare, the effective monitoring of patients within Intensive Care Units (ICUs) is of paramount importance to ensure timely interventions and optimal outcomes. The integration of advanced technologies, such as Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) and System on Chip (SoC) architectures, has revolutionized the landscape of medical monitoring systems, offering unprecedented levels of performance, flexibility, and scalability. This abstract presents the design and implementation of an ICU Monitoring System utilizing Zynq architecture, a hybrid FPGA and ARM SoC platform, developed within the Xilinx Vivado software environment. In conclusion, the ICU Monitoring System utilizing Zynq architecture within Xilinx Vivado software represents a significant advancement in the field of medical monitoring technology. By leveraging the inherent strengths of FPGA-based SoC platforms, the system offers unparalleled levels of performance, flexibility, and integration, enabling healthcare providers to deliver proactive and personalized patient care in ICU environments. The successful implementation of the system underscores the transformative potential of advanced hardware and software technologies in enhancing healthcare delivery and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Integrating AES-GCM, ECC, and Steganography for Enhanced Confidential Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the modern world of information and technology, the prime requirement is highly secure data communication against the cyber threat. Efficient data communication should support all principles of information security: confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, authorization, and key management. This paper attempts at integrating three robust cryptographic techniques, viz., AES-GCM, ECC, and steganography for developing a secure mechanism for data transfer. Other research objectives also examine the establishment of combined effectiveness techniques in safeguarding CIAAA and the management of keys to key management processes. Among the anticipated outcomes is an additional improvement in data security that would provide blanket, advanced coverage for modern information security practice.

articleTitle: Redefining ECG Detection using CNN Autoencoder Approach through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research delves into the application of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Autoencoders for anomaly detection in electrocardiogram (ECG) data, leveraging the PTB Diagnostic ECG Database. The dataset comprises 14,552 samples, categorized into normal heartbeats and those affected by cardiac abnormalities. Utilizing Transposed Convolution has significantly boosted the model's performance. This study underscores the critical importance of early detection of cardiac abnormalities and introduces a CNN Autoencoder model designed to efficiently encode and decode ECG data, enabling the identification of irregular patterns. The process involves developing a robust Autoencoder with encoder and decoder components trained to minimize reconstruction errors. Evaluation metrics reveal the model's impressive accuracy (76.93%), precision (55.23%), recall (89.81%), and F1 score (65.40%). This research highlights the pivotal role of deep learning techniques in early-stage anomaly detection in ECG data, demonstrating significant potential for enhancing diagnostic capabilities and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: SLRMPCMC: Sign Language Recognition using Mediapipe and Cross-model Comparison
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Sign language is key for the deaf or hearing-impaired, but traditional reliance on interpreters presents limitations in both availability and precision. Historical methods for sign translation faced unique challenges from the visual-spatial aspects of sign languages, often failing to accurately recognize gestures or adapt to varying contexts and necessitating instant translation. This caused constraints in usability and hindered the application on diverse platforms such as mobile devices due to high computational requirements. This research introduces a sophisticated framework for sign language recognition, integrating the Mediapipe Landmark system with ab combination of machine learning models—Long Short-Term Memory networks, Convolutional Neural Networks, and Random Forest— to enhance the precision of detecting hand signs and movements in real-time and across different settings. The study outlines the processes for data gathering, preprocessing, and classifying gestures and static signs, advancing communication technologies for those with hearing impairments.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of CIGS Thin-Film Solar Cells via SCAPs-1D
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the ways in which the efficiency of thin film solar cells is affected by differences in the thickness of the absorber layer (CIGS). The Copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS) layer has a thickness that varies from 0.05 to 0.5 µm, which results in differences in metrics such as the open circuit voltage (Voc), the short circuit current density (Jsc), the fill factor (FF), and the power conversion efficiency (PCE). As a result of the intensification of the absorption process, the data indicated a significant rise in both Voc and Jsc. The voltage (Voc) climbed from 1.12 V to 1.62 V, while the short-circuit current density (Jsc) increased from 11.56 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 24.03 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Both of these changes occurred simultaneously. Along with this, the volume of the product increased from 89.0 % to 94.5 %, which resulted in a jump in the PCE from 13.05% to 25 %. These findings highlight the relevance of adjusting the thickness of the absorber layer in thin film solar cells based on CIGS in order to improve the performance of these cells and boost their ability to harvest renewable energy. The findings of this research provide important insights into the creation and improvement of solar panels in order to improve the efficiency of photovoltaic systems.

articleTitle: Conversion of Text-to-Image Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: With the exponential growth of data and advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the task of converting textual descriptions into visual images has gained significant traction. This research addresses the challenge by leveraging AI techniques to develop a robust Text-to-Image Generation system that translating text prompt into accurate, high-quality images. This study aims to explore and analyze cutting-edge AI techniques for text-to-image generation, with a focus on enhancing the accuracy and visual quality of generated images. Our strategy involves employing state-of-the-art neural network architectures and evaluation metrics to ensure high-quality image synthesis. The significance of this project lies in its potential to revolutionizing industries from digital art to product design. Through this endeavor, we aim to contribute to the frontier of AI-driven imaginary image generation.

articleTitle: Classification of Non-Speech Sound Signals: An Approach of Machine Learning with MFCC Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The categorization of non-speech sound signals into seven different classes—breath, cough, cry, laugh, sneeze, and yawn—is the subject of this study. The sound signals that were gathered for this research from a variety of sources make up the publicly accessible dataset. In this study, Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC) analysis is used to extract sound samples and generates feature vectors with 2 dimensions of sizes 13 x 87. We employed various machine learning (ML) techniques to complete the classification tasks, such as Decision Tree, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, K Neighbors Classifier, Ada Boost Classifier, Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Extra Trees Classifier. A dimensional CNN-based classification method is also used. Evaluating the classification performance in terms of recall, accuracy, precision, F1-Score, and losses forms the basis of the analysis. The results demonstrate that different algorithms perform to varying degrees; the methods with the greatest accuracy and precision ratings are Random Forest and Extra Trees Classifier. To enhance the classification of non-speech sound sources, MFCC feature extraction and ML techniques are using in this research, which helps in healthcare, surveillance, environmental monitoring and detecting criminal activities.

articleTitle: Enhancing UAV Detection and Tracking Range Utilizing KNN and Canny Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Object detection and tracking play an important role in autonomous vehicle systems. In the past few years, object detection using deep learning from images has become a center of attention. This paper presents a novel approach for the detection and tracking of fixed-wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) using the YOLO version 8 deep learning algorithm in BGR color space vs grey color space using Canny edge detection and KNN to see the outline. Leveraging the state-of-the-art capabilities of YOLO v8, real-time and accurate detection of UAVs from ground perspective is achieved. In this study, object detection and tracking application is performed by training the YOLO v8 algorithm, annotation tool used was CVAT, with the help of Python software language with a dataset consisting of photographs of fixed wing UAV taken from the ground. This research contributes to advancing the field of UAV detection and tracking, particularly focusing on the capabilities and advancements of the YOLO v8 algorithm in real-time object detection and tracking applications.

articleTitle: Design of novel two port Square Spiral Hexa-band MIMO Antenna for wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A compact two-element Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) antenna is designed for portable wireless multiband applications, named as Square Spiral Multiband MIMO antenna (SSMMA). It is designed on a FR4 substrate with a compact size of 56 mm × 72 mm × 1.57 mm covering hexa-band at 2.1GHz(1.95-2.3GHz), 3.6 GHz (3.57–3.62 GHz), 4.2 GHz (4.13– 4.27 GHz), 5.2 GHz (5.20–5.27 GHz), 6 GHz (5.82–6.15 GHz), and 6.9 GHz (6.81–7.07 GHz). The suggested antenna is created via a series of intermediate design stages that begin with a traditional rectangular monopole antenna and culminate with a square spiral antenna. Ansys HFSS software is utilized for modelling the antenna, with simulation results indicating diversity parameters like peak realized gain (7dBi), ECC (<0.05), MEG (around 0), TARC(<-10dB) and DG(>9.9dB). This competitor works best with wireless devices looking for a single device that combines 2.1GHz(n1, n34 5G band), 3.5-GHz (WiMAX band), 5.2 & 5.8GHz (ISM band) and 6.8GHz (satellite communication band).

articleTitle: Lowering Centre Frequency of Bandpass Filter using VCII based Capacitance Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The author hereby presents a bandpass filter circuit designed using voltage conveyors. The goal of this study is to lower center frequency obtained by bandpass filter to a very low frequency range. The study underscores the role of capacitance multipliers in achieving the intended goal. Resistors used in the capacitance multiplier allow the adjustment of the multiplication factor. The study has been implemented on 180nm technology. The outcome of this study could extend to various domains including biomedical applications requiring effective low frequency signal filtering.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Revocation Mechanisms for Shared Resources to Strengthen Data Security in Public Clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Users may quickly change and share data among themselves using cloud-based data storage and sharing services. Users in the group must calculate signatures on every block of mutually exchanged data to guarantee that its integrity can be independently validated by third parties. Due to data updates made by many users, separate blocks of shared data are typically signed by various end users. For security concerns, if a person left a group, the blocks they previously signed are no longer valid. A current user must sign again for this revoked user. The simple approach, which enables a current user to download the relevant portion of Resigning shared data after a user revokes their access is ineffective because of the amount of the shared information and data in the cloud. In this research paper, we provide a new method for public auditing that guarantees the state of information and data shared while improving the effectiveness of user revocation. Proxy re-signatures enable the cloud to relinquish data blocks on behalf of users who have had their access revoked, removing the requirement for these users to manually download and re-sign the blocks. Furthermore, a public verifier does not need to download the complete file in order to confirm data integrity, even in cases where the cloud has re-signed some of the shared data. Moreover, our approach makes batch auditing easier by allowing several auditing jobs to be validated at the same time. Experimental findings demonstrate that our technique can greatly increase the effectiveness of user revocation.

articleTitle: Impact of Temperature and Noise on Gallium Nitride Junctionless Accumulation Mode Nanowire FET (GaN-JAMNWFET)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This work analyzes the temperature and noise impact on the Gallium Nitride Junctionless Accumulation Mode Nanowire FET (GaN-JAMNWFET). The objective of this work is to examine the characteristics of the GaN-JAMNWFET, focusing on parameters such as drain current, transconductance, subthreshold swing, output conductance, cutoff frequency, Unilateral Power Gain (UPG), Maximum Transducer Power Gain (MTPG), Noise Figure (NF), and Noise Conductance (NC) at different temperatures (T=300K, 400K and 500K). GaN-based devices offer enhanced analog performance and are well-suited for high-frequency applications due to their larger bandgap and robust breakdown field, enabling them to handle higher voltages and powers. Also, the reported structure exhibits superior performance compared to GaN-based Junctionless (JL) Nanowire FET.

articleTitle: A Model for Multi-Criteria Ranking of Sub-Transmission Power Transformer Maintenance Strategies – An Application of Delphi Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the practical expertise of researchers who utilized the Delphi process technique to achieve consensus among experts on sub-transmission power transformer maintenance strategies. The study employed the average consensus approach to derive a final framework with criteria for evaluation categorized under costs, added value, reliability, quality, safety, and technical aspects. The experts from a South African power system utility reached a consensus on the selected criteria from literature and additional factors proposed during two rounds of Delphi discussions. This study will assist those interested in exploring the Delphi process for decision-making, especially for selecting maintenance strategies in the power system.

articleTitle: Examining driver sleepiness based on his visual actions with ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Driver drowsiness is a significant risk factor for road accidents. It is essential for road safety to develop efficient sleepiness detection systems. This work concentrate around analyzing driver sluggishness in view of visual activities, expecting to recognize solid marks of To determine the driver's level of alertness, the proposed strategy involves keeping an eye on the driver's visual actions, such as eye movements, eyelid closure, and head movements. Relevant features are drowsiness utilizing PC vision methods. To determine the driver's level of alertness, the proposed strategy involves keeping an eye on the driver's visual actions, such as eye movements, eyelid closure, and head movements. Relevant features are extracted from real-time video footage captured by an onboard camera using a combination of image and video processing algorithms. To prepare and assess the sluggishness location model, a different dataset of drivers in different conditions of languor is gathered, including both reproduced and genuine situations. The dataset is clarified with ground truth marks showing various degrees of languor, got through physiological estimations, driver self-reports, and master assessments.

articleTitle: 5G User Equipment (UE) Positioning and Localization Estimation using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The emergence of 5G technology has ushered in a new era of connectivity, making communications faster and cheaper. One of the main challenges of 5G networks is accuracy and efficiency, which are important for many applications such as driver less cars, smart cities and virtual reality. This research paper explores the integration of machine learning techniques to improve the accuracy and reliability of 5G infrastructure. The plan uses rich data generated by 5G networks, combining various parameters such as signal strength, flight time and angle of arrival. Machine learning algorithms are used to process this data and create good models for the correct location. The system is designed to adapt to dynamic and complex urban environments where traditional methods often encounter limitations. The main contribution of this research includes the development of a new machine learning-based distribution algorithm suitable for 5G networks, a comprehensive evaluation of performance comparison with the existing system, and evaluation of recommendations for feasibility and implementation. The results showed significant improvements in accuracy and reliability, demonstrating the potential of machine learning to revolutionize the 5G workplace.

articleTitle: Pattern Recognition and Prediction in Time Series Data Through Retrieval-Augmented Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Time series forecasting is an essential technique used in various domains, with finance being one of the primary users. There are several techniques for time series forecasting, with machine learning being one of the most common practices. Machine learning models rely on numerical input with time encoded in the input for prediction. However, visual pattern-based time series forecasting is also a popular method practiced by professionals in various fields. Traditional numerical input-based models succeed in recognizing patterns but often fail when the patterns are skewed or stretched compared to those in the training data. The aim of the work is to address this issue using a visual approach. In this work, OpenAI’s CLIP model has been used to perform a visual similarity search among visual time series patterns to achieve forecasting using the top k most similar patterns. The performance of the model shows it can be used effectively for time series analysis.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring and Control of Drones Using IoT-Blockchain Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This work presents an IoT-Blockchain integration solution to enhance the typical Drone systems to acquire optimal organizational performance. Several questions that are associated with modern drone operations are solved by the suggested system, and these questions are the following: data security, efficiency of work, and system scalability. Concerning the experimental results, the boost in the realism of the data transfer rates can also be seen - the mean rate is increased from 500 to 1200 KB/s, thus enabling real-time control. Another effect of Smart Contracts was reducing the time it took to carry out operational activities to which the contracts were applied. For instance, the time taken to route a flight to save time was brought down from 10 minutes to 2 minutes, the time to allocate resources for the flight was brought down from 15 minutes to 3 minutes, and the time to schedule maintenance of the flight was brought down from 20 minutes to 5 minutes. It also presented the framework’s performance metrics, such as a 0% data breach incidence rate different from the annual average of 12 in centralized traditional systems. This goes well with Blockchain’s ability to house information in a record that can never be altered, providing data security and credibility. However, the system also proved scalability as the number of drones changed from 10 to 100, and the throughput changed from 100 to 920 TPS. Also, the system latency remained below 70 ms during this process, which is critical for responsive trading applications.

articleTitle: Recognition of Facial Emotions Using CNN Architecture and FER2013
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Humans are social and emotional beings. With the rapid normalization of work-from-home and hybrid work environments, most people are having a difficult time truly expressing their emotions, which when not addressed inevitably leads to drastic mental problems. In order to address or prevent these mental problems, detection and recognition of facial emotions serve as an initial step. This paper presents a facial emotion recognition model working on the CNN (convolutional neural network) architecture, trained and tested using the FER2013 dataset, achieving an accuracy of 74% of detecting seven emotions - Happy, Neutral, Fear, Sadness, Anger, Disgust, and Surprise.

articleTitle: Optimizing Spacer Width in N-Type Lateral Hetero-Structure Junctionless TFETs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this article, to further the design of semiconductor devices, this work investigates the effects of spacer width modification on the functional features of junctionless tunnel field-effect transistors (JLTFETs). Comprehensive simulations and an examination of critical factors at spacer widths of 2, 3, and 4 nm were conducted using a 2-D Silvaco TCAD Simulator. After a thorough analysis, it has been observed that the spacer width had a strong effect on several number of device performance parameters, including the transconductance (g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>), drain current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf>), ratio of on/off current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ON</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">OFF</inf>), threshold voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>), and parasitic capacitances (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gs</inf>, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gd</inf>, and C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">gg</inf>). Interestingly, 2 nm spacer width was the best value for RF performance, as seen by greater transconductance and decreased parasitic capacitance. Furthermore, unusual threshold voltage behavior was noted at 3 nm spacer width, which calls for more investigation. These results provide insightful information on JLTFET optimization for various electronic applications, directing future studies and development initiatives in the field of semiconductor device design.

articleTitle: A Study of Operational Amplifiers in Low Power Nodes in Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Operational amplifiers (Op-Amps) are critical components in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits, where low power consumption and high performance are essential. With the continuous scaling of semiconductor technology, FinFET devices have emerged as promising candidates for achieving high-performance and low-power operation. This review paper provides an overview of recent advancements in the design and implementation of low-power operational amplifiers based on 18nm FinFET technology. It covers the key design considerations, challenges, and prospects of FinFET-based Op-Amps for low-power applications.

articleTitle: Implementation of DC-DC Step-up Converter for Renewable Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The utilization of carbon-based fuels has driven up considerably over the past ten years, boosting system costs and harming the environment. These problems compel researchers to concentrate on sustainable energy sources, such as fuel cells, solar panels, and air-powered turbines that produce electricity. PV is becoming a more prominent and well-liked renewable energysource because of its many advantages, which include being free to use, abundant in nature, and environmentally benign.However, the voltage produced by solar panels is quite low and environment-dependent. A Step up DC converter is essential for converting energy into useful sources. With the use of MATLAB simulation software, high gain step up converters are simulated in this study, and prototype results are verified

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection using Optimized Stochastic Gradient Descent Function
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The learning rate of a CNN determines the efficiency of the neural network. In brain tumor detection, the learning rate and the optimization function plays a key role in deciding the final output. The Optimized Stochastic Gradient Descent (OSGD) optimizer giver better result in terms of Accuracy, Recall and other determining factors. We have also compared the results obtained with other optimizers and it could be clearly stated that our proposed model. The OSGD optimizer controls the maxima and minima, and move the near optimum solution buy controlling the learning rate. So via this method we can control our right momentum .and we detect our object in les error.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Model for Heart Disease Detection: A Comparative Analysis of SVM vs KNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Out of many critical medical issues, heart disease is one that primarily impacts the cardiovascular system, including the heart and its associated organs. Individuals who smoke, suffer from high blood pressure, have elevated cholesterol levels, maintain poor dietary habits, lack physical activity, or are overweight or obese face a greater risk of developing heart disease. The most frequently diagnosed cardiovascular condition is coronary artery disease (CAD), although other forms of heart disease include congestive heart failure, arrhythmias, and congenital heart defects. This condition is often referred to as cardiovascular disease. Timely and precise diagnosis is essential for saving lives and preventing further complications. Recent advancements in machine learning diagnostic techniques have demonstrated enhanced reliability and effectiveness in detecting heart disease. In this work, we have implemented a SVM algorithm followed by a KNN algorithm to accurately identify the early stages of heart disease within a specific dataset. The algorithms consider various factors, including age, gender, resting blood pressure, cholesterol levels, blood sugar levels, and ECG results when making predictions. The experimental findings reveal that the SVM model outperforms the others, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 89% on the UCI dataset.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Methods for Tomato Leaf Disease Detection: A Convolutional Neural
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) establishes an ongoing, Cutting-edge method in image processing with significant potential and encouraging outcomes. Having demonstrated its effectiveness across diverse applications, Convolutional Neural Network has now made significant inroads into the agricultural domain as well. We conducted a survey of 38 research studies that employed Convolutional Neural Network techniques to address a range of research challenges related to tomato plants.We explored the realms of tomato plant research where Convolutional Neural Networks were implemented, delving into the employed data preprocessing techniques, as well as the utilization of transfer learning and augmentation techniques.We analyzed dataset details such as the sources utilized, the total number of images, the number of classes, and the train-test-validation ratio employed. Furthermore, we conducted comparisons across different Convolutional Neural Network architectures and discussed the resulting outcomes.The findings indicated that Convolutional Neural Networks consistently outperformed other image processing techniques. However, it was noted that the performance of Convolutional Neural Networks is heavily influenced by the quality and characteristics of the dataset used.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of ML and DL Approaches for Twitter Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research made use of various machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) methods — such as support vector machines, random forests, logistic regression, naive Bayes, and XGBoost, convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and feedforward neural networks (FNNs) — for tweet analysis to investigate public sentiment towards Ola and Uber. The objective is to determine the most effective method for distinguishing between good and negative tweets. Feature engineering techniques improve the algorithms interpretation of tweet content. To balance out the disparity between positive and negative tweets. The project aims to uncover customer wants and concerns on Twitter to help Ola and Uber, in addition to improving Algorithms Accuracy. The study intends to help these ride-hailing businesses make educated modifications to boost customer happiness by closely examining tweets. Essentially, the study assesses how well various ML and DL algorithms comprehend user feedback on Uber and Ola. The overarching goal is to not only enhance computational methods but also contribute to the improvement of these ride-hailing services, ultimately fostering a more positive online environment for Ola and Uber enthusiasts. In summary, the study investigates sentiment analysis techniques on Twitter to optimize understanding of Ola and Uber-related tweets, aiming to facilitate positive changes for the ride-hailing services and their customers, promoting a friendlier Twitter community.

articleTitle: Third Eye – A Compact Wearable Device and Dedicated Android App for Disabled Senior Citizens and Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Falls constitute a prevalent cause of hospitalization and injury among the elderly population, often resulting in severe debilitation and ranking as the primary contributor to unintentional injuries in this demographic. Given the impracticality of constant manual monitoring, a pressing need arises to enhance response times following a fall incident. To address this imperative, we present a wearable device to gather data from an integrated accelerometer within the user’s body, enabling highly precise automated fall detection. The envisaged device can be comfortably worn on either the wrist or arm, affording users a discreet and less stigmatizing option while necessitating the implementation of an efficient fall detection algorithm to ensure optimal performance. To promptly signal the occurrence of falls, a dedicated alarm system is seamlessly integrated into the patient’s environment. At the same time, a user-friendly application stands ready to deliver swift assistance, thus mitigating the potential for severe consequences. By deploying this wearable technology, we aim to preemptively avert adverse scenarios and expedite assistance in the event of a fall. In summary, the proposed wearable device emerges as a promising fall detection and prevention solution, underscoring the significance of continuous monitoring and rapid response times in mitigating fall-related injuries among elderly individuals.

articleTitle: Aqua Foresight Logistics Regression Based Rainfall Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The goal of meteorological science is to better comprehend Earth's atmosphere and create reliable weather prediction models. For weather forecasting, several techniques have been employed. In place of old-fashioned methods, machine learning techniques for weather prediction are rising in popularity recently due to their apparent accuracy. Rainfall rate is one of the key components of the weather system that directly affects the biological and agricultural sectors. Weather variations can create natural disasters at any time and have a catastrophic impact on the ecosystem. To forecast these variations and anticipate the weather changes ahead of time, a variety of ML techniques and algorithms can be applied. Previous research has noted that a variety of alternate approaches exist for weather prediction. Humidity, Fahrenheit, Direction of the wind, Moisture loss and other factors are taken into factoring. It is speculative to predict how much precipitation will fall overall throughout the summer and wet seasons. Logistic Regression methodology in Machine Learning can be helpful for assessing rainfall.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology's Potential in Supply Chain management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This exploratory study examines the potential of blockchain technology to revolutionize supply chain management (SCM). By leveraging a comprehensive literature review and expert interviews, this paper identifies key benefits of blockchain integration in SCM, including increased transparency, enhanced security, and improved traceability. The study also addresses technical challenges and implementation barriers, such as scalability issues and the need for standardization across various stakeholders. Comparative analysis of current SCM systems and potential blockchain-based solutions is conducted, highlighting significant efficiency gains and cost reductions. The findings suggest that while blockchain presents a transformative potential for SCM, strategic frameworks and collaborative efforts among industry players are crucial for successful adoption. Future research directions are proposed, focusing on pilot projects and real-world application case studies to further validate the technology's practical benefits and scalability in diverse supply chain contexts.

articleTitle: Air Quality and Mango Ripening Monitoring System for Mango Units
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study addresses the complex process of mango ripening by designing a state-of-the-art facility equipped with advanced monitoring and control systems. The facility manages ethylene levels, temperature, humidity, CO2, and methane to ensure efficient and safe ripening. Ripening chambers with automated controls maintain optimal conditions, while air quality management protocols in the office area ensure safe CO2 and particulate matter (PM) levels for workers. Our findings demonstrate that the controlled environment in the ripening chambers facilitates uniform mango ripening, maintaining high safety standards. Additionally, the air quality measures effectively keep CO2 and PM levels within acceptable limits, ensuring a safe working environment for employees. This research provides a significant contribution to food production and occupational health by integrating advanced technologies to manage the ripening process while prioritizing worker safety and well-being.

articleTitle: A Combination of the SMC Controller with the PI Controller for Brushless DC Motor Speed Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The excellent speed-torque behavior of brushless DC (BLDC) motors makes them widely used in both electrical car and industrial applications. Speed regulation of the BLDC motor is required because of its extremely wide speed range. There are numerous controllers available for BLDC motor speed control. One of these, the sliding-mode controller, regulates the motor's speed while taking certain erratic circumstances into account. The disadvantage of some variation in the motor's speed behavior is limited to the SMC controller for BLDC motors. Therefore, a PI controller and SMC controller combination is suggested in this work for the BLDC motor. A simulation using MATLAB was run to look at the behaviour of the BLDC motor

articleTitle: Classification of Obstructive and Restrictive Respiratory Diseases Based on Cough Sounds
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Respiratory diseases are a leading cause of mortality, with obstructive and restrictive conditions posing significant diagnostic challenges due to overlapping symptoms. This paper explores machine learning and deep learning techniques, such as K-nearest neighbor (KNN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), long short-term memory (LSTM), support vector machine (SVM), CNN-LSTM, and ensemble methods, to differentiate between obstructive and restrictive respiratory diseases based on cough sounds. Mel frequency cepstral coefficient features are utilized across all models. Results show the ensemble model achieves the highest accuracy of 98.63%, outperforming KNN (95.89%), CNN (93.15%), LSTM (80.95%), SVM (92.68%), and CNN-LSTM (93.15%).

articleTitle: Utilizing Various Filtering Methodologies in Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The development of efficient noise reduction techniques is imperative to maintain the quality and features of digital images, as they are essential in numerous key applications. Specifically, noise from salt and pepper can severely deteriorate the quality of digital images; the impact varies depending on the size and noise ratio of the image. The problem of image smoothing with edge preservation using Gaussian, mean, and median filters is addressed in this suggested work. For applications including computer vision, surveillance, and medical imaging, it seeks to preserve image structure while lowering noise. The results show that the Mean, Median, and Gaussian filters may be effectively compared for different smoothing applications, as indicated by the desirable peak signal to noise ratios (PSNR).

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection through External Camera Sensors using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Agriculture is one of the most important aspect of a country for its economy and livelihood. A country is dependent on its farmers for livelihood and for providing raw material for food. Therefore, crop yield is extremely essential. One of things that interfere with good crop yield is diseases in plants. Diseases in plants can occur due to variety of factors like temperature, fertility of soil, type of soil, pH of the soil and moisture of the soil. Quick and accurate detection is extremely necessary for eradication of plant diseases. Traditionally, disease of the plant is identified by visually studying the leaf by the naked eye. But this process takes considerable time of the farmer and may not be the efficient method for identifying diseases. Image Processing techniques, along with a classification algorithm solves this problem by observing patterns on plant leaves. We aim to build a solution which is able to capture image through external camera sources like mobile camera, webcam and extract features with image processing techniques and classify disease with Deep Neural Network Algorithm.

articleTitle: An X-band Reflectarray Antenna with a Meander-Shaped Unit Cell Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
