abstract: The proposed paper describes a meander-shaped reflectarray antenna design for X-band applications with a single layer (no air) structure as it exhibits a small size and large electrical length. The proposed structure has six circles attached with a center at the corner of a hexagonal patch which makes a meander shape. The inter-element spacing is kept as λ/2. The reflection angle range is close to 360° for practical implementation. The aperture for the designed reflectarray is circular. The corresponding dimension of this is kept at 255 mm. It has 225 elements placed into it. This is simulated using CST software The gain of pyramidal horn is 13 dBi for excitation. The maximum Simulated gain is obtained at 21.9 dBi along the broadside at 10.3 GHz. The 3-dB gain bandwidth is 10.4% in the covering frequency band from 9.75GHz to 10.81GHz. The Maximum aperture efficiency of the proposed RA is 21.2%.

articleTitle: Design And Fabrication of Brake Fluid Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper presents the design and fabrication of Brake Fluid Monitoring System aimed at enhancing vehicle safety. The system monitors critical parameters such as brake fluid level, moisture content, and pressure drop in vehicles equipped with hydraulic braking systems. By continuously monitoring these parameters, the system helps prevent potential issues associated with low fluid levels, moisture contamination, and pressure drops, which can compromise braking performance and vehicle safety. Our prototype utilizes state-of-the-art sensors and Arduino-based control systems to provide real-time monitoring and alerts to drivers, ensuring optimal braking performance and mitigating the risk of accidents. The development of this Brake Fluid Monitoring System represents a significant step forward in automotive safety technology, contributing to the overall safety and reliability of vehicles on the road.

articleTitle: Optimization of New Radio Physical Uplink Shared Channel Resources Allocation with Efficient Demodulated Referenced Signals and PT-RE Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper explores the resource allocation optimisation of New Radio Physical Uplink Shared Channels with an emphasis on the effective implementation of Phase Tracking Reference Signals and Demodulation Reference Signals in 5G networks. Understanding how important these reference signals are to dependable communication, we created a Python framework to model and display their distribution on a time-frequency grid. By carefully modifying important factors including mapping type, PRB allocation, and symbol allocation, our method greatly increased resource efficiency, decreased overhead, and improved signal quality. The results show how sophisticated resource allocation techniques may be used to maximise system performance, providing important information for the creation of more reliable and effective 5G NR communication systems

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using Modified VGG-19 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Brain tumors are life-threatening diseases, and their early detection is crucial but difficult through manual analysis. They can be identified by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). This study presents a deep learning approach using 3D convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for brain tumor detection. The CNN architecture was based on a modified VGG19 model, which was trained on a large MRI dataset to learn about different types of tumors and identify difficult tumor patterns. Compared to existing models like VGG16 and ResNet50, which attained accuracies of 77% and 94% respectively, our proposed model achieved an accuracy of 95%. This deep learning methodology demonstrates the potential to enhance brain tumor detection, optimize diagnostic procedures, reduce human effort, and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Fogoptimize: Advancing Job Scheduling Efficiency in Fog Computing through Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Fog computing is a crucial strategy for fulfilling the computational requirements of applications that demand minimal delay and for handling data in the era of the Internet of Things (IoT). Efficient task scheduling is essential for maximizing the utilization of resources, minimizing response time, and improving the overall performance of fog computing systems. The objective of this study is to introduce FogOptimize, a comprehensive framework designed to enhance the efficiency of job scheduling in fog computing through the utilization of optimization techniques. FogOptimize employs many factors like as work priority, resource availability, energy consumption, and Quality of Service (QoS) requirements to create well-informed scheduling choices. FogOptimize employs sophisticated optimization methods like as genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization, and simulated annealing to maximize CPU efficiency, minimize response times, and optimize resource allocation. The effectiveness of the FogOptimize framework is demonstrated through extensive simulations and case studies, showcasing its improved performance in comparison to existing scheduling strategies and algorithms in fog computing environments. To summarize, FogOptimize is a significant advancement in improving the efficiency of job scheduling in fog computing, hence facilitating the building of more reliable and efficient fog-based systems.

articleTitle: Verilog based Architecture Computing Testability Measures for DFT Designers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Testability measures of any circuit quantifies the difficulty level of put any value (0 or 1) on a particular signal path of the circuit and observe the signal value effect at the output of the circuit termed as controllability and observability (CC&CO). Detectability provides a measure of any stuck at fault detection probability. The circuits designers must consider the testability measures and detectability to ensure the ease of testing. The proposed architecture allows the designer to analyze the selection of gates for implementation of various functionalities. Verilog HDL codes are written to measure CC&CO for all possible 216 designs based the proposed architecture. Simulation results indicate the variation of CC&CO for different combinations of gates. It has been observed that the designs having NAND/NOR gates only have the least value of CC&CO as well as highest detectability.

articleTitle: Software Vulnerabilities Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Software serves as a cornerstone in the functionality of devices and systems that seamlessly integrate into our daily lives. However, the complexity of these systems, often developed by multiple programmers, leaves room for inadvertent errors in the code. These errors, known as software vulnerabilities, represent flaws or defects in the software's construction that malicious actors can exploit to gain unauthorized access or privileges within the system. Despite advancements in understanding vulnerabilities, the prevalence of reported vulnerabilities continues to rise, emphasizing the critical importance of software security research. In response to this growing concern, there is a pressing need for tools to assist programmers in identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities during the code development process. As part of our ongoing research paper into detection of vulnerabilities, along with methods for their prevention and detection. Furthermore, we delve into recent advancements in utilizing machine learning techniques to enhance vulnerability detection across various types of software vulnerabilities. We have tested on real data set and the results are better than existing models.

articleTitle: Renewable Power Integrated Island Microgrid based Frequency Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Due to their tremendous financial benefits and ecofriendly features, microgrids are becoming more and more acknowledged as essential parts of the energy systems of the future. They are essential in tackling the problem of balancing the supply and demand for energy, especially in the context of integrating renewable energy sources like wind power in the remote areas. However, frequency management in microgrids faces difficulties due to the erratic and intermittent nature of renewable energy, particularly during islanded operations. Managing frequency fluctuations resulting from load disturbances and system variable changes is the main focus. Thus, an optimal frequency control is made to minimize the frequency fluctuations even in presence of load and renewable source power uncertainties. This paper investigates a linear quadratic regulator-based control method of grid frequency control for microgrids that are mostly fuel by renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Low Cost 3-Wheel Hybrid Electric Segway
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In response to the growing need for efficient and eco-friendly transportation within expansive environments like campuses, industries, and metropolises, this paper presents the design and simulation of a novel 3-wheeled hybrid Segway. This design addresses the limitations of conventional vehicles by integrating a low-power electric brushless DC (BLDC) motor for short-distance travel, seamlessly transitioning to an internal combustion engine (ICE) for higher speeds and power demands. A common throttle controls both power sources, ensuring a smooth user experience. Furthermore, a regenerative braking system captures energy during deceleration and utilizes it to recharge the batteries, enhancing overall energy efficiency. The design was verified and optimized through MATLAB simulations, focusing particularly on maximizing energy recovery during braking. The design was made in Solidworks and validated in Abaqus CAE. This research demonstrates a promising approach for developing a sustainable and efficient transportation solution, offering advantages such as reduced energy consumption, lower emissions, and maneuverability within congested spaces.

articleTitle: Navigating the Cyber Battlefield: Understanding Threats and Safeguarding Digital Frontiers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This article explores into the evolving landscape of Cybersecurity, highlighting the challenges and innovations that are defining the field. It examines various cyber threats, including malware, phishing, ransomware, DDoS attacks, and insider threats, and highlights advancements in Cybersecurity technologies such as Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions. This communication emphasizes the role of machine learning and artificial intelligence in identifying and mitigating threats, discusses the critical nature of zero-day vulnerabilities, and underscores the importance of threat intelligence and incident response planning. The study also addresses legal and ethical considerations in Cybersecurity and calls for increased collaboration and vigilance among stakeholders. This comprehensive review aims to provide valuable insights for security professionals and individuals seeking to navigate the digital age securely.

articleTitle: Securing Patient Health Records Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Traditional Electronic Health Records (EHRs) raise red flags about data privacy, security, and patient control. This research tackles these issues by proposing a new system where patients call the shots on their medical information. Our blockchain and InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) system puts patients in the driver's seat, granting them complete ownership and oversight of their health data. Patients securely submit their formatted medical history through a dedicated website, where it's stored on IPFS using a decentralized platform like Pinata. A unique code (Content Identifier or CID) acts like a key, linking the data to the patient's blockchain address via a smart contract (coded rules) for guaranteed accuracy and tracking. Our design prioritizes patient-controlled access. Healthcare providers can't access the data without the patient's explicit go-ahead. Access requests are sent directly to the patient, who has the final say on approval, ensuring their data privacy is always protected. Approved requests include the CID, allowing authorized physicians to retrieve the patient's data directly from IPFS storage. But patient control goes beyond just reacting to access requests. Our system empowers patients to be proactive. Using their unique login credentials, they can grab their CID directly from the blockchain. This retrieval process can be integrated into a secure patient portal or mobile app. With their CID in hand, patients can directly share it with chosen physicians, fostering collaboration in care without relying on intermediary platforms. This streamlined data exchange empowers patients and fosters a more collaborative healthcare environment where they actively manage their health information.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning Approaches For Cardiovascular Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease ranks among the world's top causes of death. To preserve lives, it is imperative to diagnose these diseases at an early stage. The integration of machine learning classification algorithms inside healthcare organizations yields remarkable outcomes that support medical practitioners in promptly and accurately diagnosing these illnesses. Researchers continue to underutilize the vast amounts of data generated by healthcare companies. For more accurate outcomes, machine learning tools and techniques assist in extracting useful knowledge from datasets. The aim of this research is to investigate various combinations of algorithms and identify effective strategies from the latest research articles. Utilizing optimization methods instead of previously utilized classification algorithms like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes (NB), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Random Forest (RF), Genetic Algorithm (GA) etc. is what makes our work novel. An analysis of the survey data shows that the combination of feature optimization methods Random Forest, or RF) and machine learning techniques (K- Nearest Neighbor, or KNN) and (Particle Swarm Optimization, or PSO) yields a maximum accuracy of 99.53%. Future research can focus on creating a sophisticated model that integrates several machine learning optimization techniques, assisting medical practitioners in making well-informed decisions.

articleTitle: Unlocking Talent: Exploring the Potential of AI and ML Algorithms in Recruitment Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A Recruitment process is complex and multifaceted. It requires a strategic approach to assess and select suitable candidates for the selected post while mitigating challenges along the way. This study aimed at predicting the likelihood of job candidates being hired, utilizing a diverse range of input features. Leveraging machine learning algorithms applied to a comprehensive dataset spanning over a decade and encompassing various populations, the research emphasizes the interpretability of the model’s predictions. By integrating multiple machine learning algorithms, the study achieves remarkable prediction accuracy while providing valuable insights that HR professionals can interpret. Through meticulous analysis, distinct patterns and factors influencing hiring decisions are identified, offering practical implications for recruitment processes. The findings underscore the feasibility of predicting candidate hiring ability prior to employment, thereby facilitating the development of optimized recruitment strategies. This research significantly contributes to enhancing HR decision-making by furnishing a robust framework for evaluating job candidates’ potential success.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation on Detection of Phishing Websites Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The rapid growth of the internet has revolutionized the way people communicate and conduct various online activities. However, this increased connectivity has also increased cyber threats, notably phishing assaults being among the most prevalent and damaging. By pretending to be legitimate, phishing attacks seek to deceive visitors into disclosing confidential information. Machine Learning (ML) has emerged as a pivotal tool for both attackers and defenders to enhance the sophistication of phishing websites and improve detection and prevention methods. Attackers use ML to create more convincing attacks, defenders leverage it to improve their detection and prevention capabilities. As a result, there is a critical need for effective techniques to detect and combat phishing websites. We employ methods such as 10-fold cross-validation and 75-25 splits and assess six classifiers: Naive Bayes, SMO, PART, JRIP, J48, and Random Forest. Our study investigates various feature extraction methods, classification algorithms, and evaluation metrics to identify the most effective approach. The results offer valuable insights into the strengths and limitations of each technique, guiding the development of robust cybersecurity defenses against phishing attacks.

articleTitle: Mern (Mongodb, Express-Js, React-Js, Node-Js) Stack Web-Based Streaming and Broadcasting Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, authors present a comprehensive approach to develop a web-based streaming and broadcasting application, centering on the integration of WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) and RTMP (Real-Time Messaging Protocol) technologies. Using the advantages of both traditions while addressing their unique limitations, the system aims to provide a consistent level of client involvement.The engineering comprises of a WebRTC server for real-time communication between peers, encouraging the capture and transmission of audio and video streams. In order to increase compatibility and flexibility, WebRTC streams are converted to RTMP format using the Simple RTMP Server (SRS). More widespread availability across platforms and devices that facilitate RTMP-based playback is enabled by this integration.Through integration of WebRTC and RTMP advancements within the streaming application, users can benefit from instantaneous communication features while ensuring compatibility with a wider variety of playback devices. This method provides an adaptable setup suitable for many streaming and broadcasting situations, including live events, video conferences, and online multimedia content delivery.

articleTitle: AI Bots: Navigating the Next Wave of Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The field of artificial intelligence bots, which includes ChatGPT, Brad, Google Assistant, Siri, and Amazon Alexa, is examined in this review study. The main goals are to look at advances in natural language processing, user experiences, moral issues, and possible directions for the future. From a methodological perspective, a thorough review of the literature is carried out, with studies arranged according to topics and approaches in order to summarize important discoveries. Notable developments in transformer-based models, encouraging user patterns, and moral dilemmas are emphasized. Comparing various studies, the review highlights how they all acknowledge ethical considerations and use similar evaluation methods. Research directions to improve inclusion, investigate negative user experiences, and strengthen ethical frameworks are suggested by gaps in the literature that have been identified, such as the underrepresentation of certain user categories and the emphasis on short-term assessments. In the end, this article acts as a road map for scholars and industry professionals, providing an understanding of the present situation with AI bots and suggesting paths for their appropriate integration into various social situations.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Prepaid GSM based Smart Energy Meter with Load Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research paper presents a comprehensive study on the modeling and prototyping of a prepaid GSM-based smart energy meter with load management. As the need for effective energy management systems rises, the development of intelligent meters has become imperative. This paper addresses the need for a prepaid energy metering system coupled with load control functionalities to promote energy conservation and cost-effectiveness. The proposed model integrates GSM technology for remote monitoring and control, enhancing accessibility and convenience for both consumers and utility providers. Through rigorous modeling techniques and prototyping, the paper demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed system in accurately measuring energy consumption, implementing prepaid billing mechanisms, and enabling load control features to optimize energy usage. The research findings highlight the potential of the intelligent energy metering system to revolutionize traditional energy management practices, fostering sustainability and efficiency in the power sector.

articleTitle: Integrating Artificial Intelligence and Multiple Intelligences for Advanced Educational Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The aim of educational innovation is to foster students' creative and problem-solving skills via the integration of several disciplines, including science, technology, engineering, art, and mathematics. Efficiently identifying and fostering the various abilities of pupils continues to be a crucial obstacle. This research presents a sophisticated educational approach that combines the notion of multiple intelligences with artificial intelligence (AI) technology to tackle this problem. This concept improves the teaching environment by including intelligent auxiliary services for instructors and students via the use of smart speech and picture interaction. Artificial intelligence (AI) integrated into the multiple intelligence’s framework enables the ability to observe, analyze, and implement personalized teaching tactics in real-time using machine learning. The suggested AI-assisted education paradigm aims to enhance teacher-student interactions and facilitate personalized instruction. The study provides evidence that this technique successfully facilitates personalized and captivating learning experiences, promoting students' diverse talents and augmenting their creativity and problem-solving capabilities. This approach seeks to fundamentally transform conventional educational techniques by addressing the disparity between existing educational practices and the future requirements of the workforce.

articleTitle: Individualized Mastery Quest: Crafting Customized Question Papers and Dynamic Hint Generation for Personalized Learning Journeys Using Cutting-Edge Rank-Based Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this digital era, online examination platforms are crucial for conducting virtual exams efficiently. This research introduces an individual question paper and hint generation system using React, Node.js, and MongoDB, aligning with the trend of remote assessments. Traditional question papers suffer from predictability and lack of personalization. To address these, a rank-based algorithm provides personalized hints based on individual performance. Additionally, the Fisher-Yates Shuffle Algorithm ensures unbiased shuffling of elements, maintaining exam integrity. By leveraging these technologies, the platform enhances exam security and fairness while adapting to the demands of the digital age.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Utilization of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles for Afforestation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The use of unmanned aerial vehicles into conservation of wildlife and reforestation initiatives represents a significant breakthrough in the field of environmental science. This integration facilitates the adoption of more effective, accurate, and minimally intrusive approaches for monitoring ecological systems and executing conservation measures. This research examines the diverse functions of drones in improving the efficiency of wildlife conservation and reforestation endeavors, with a specific emphasis on their utilization in monitoring habitats, safeguarding species, and facilitating reforestation activities. Aerial surveys facilitated by drones enable the acquisition of high-resolution imagery and data in expansive and frequently inaccessible regions. This facilitates precise habitat mapping, monitoring of land cover changes, and evaluation of reforestation initiatives. Drones provide a non-invasive method for observing and gathering data on species populations, behaviors, and movements within the field of wildlife conservation. This contributes to enhanced comprehension and the development of protective methods for endangered species. Moreover, drones are transforming seed dispersal procedures in reforestation, enabling the precise planting of numerous seeds across extensive regions, hence improving the effectiveness and expandability of reforestation endeavors. This review paper examines the obstacles and ethical implications linked to the utilization of drones in conservation efforts like afforestation initiatives and issues such as privacy apprehensions, disruption of wildlife, and the necessity for regulating structures. In conclusion, this study highlights the capacity of drone technology to make substantial progress in the objectives of wildlife conservation and reforestation, thereby making a valuable contribution to the wider endeavors of environmental preservation and sustainability.

articleTitle: Anxiety Monitoring and Digital Meditation Aids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Amidst a demanding world, accessible mental health support is crucial. This project proposes a portable hardware solution for anxiety reduction, integrating breathing exercises, like the physiological sigh, known for alleviating stress. The aim is to assist users in practicing these exercises during distress by leveraging wearable technology, particularly the Apple Watch. The research explores the development, design, and effectiveness of this solution, emphasizing the intersection of technology and mental health for a resilient society. This research paper explores the intricate development process, design considerations, and the overall effectiveness of this innovative solution. It emphasizes the potential of wearable technology in bridging the gap between technology and mental health, offering a personalized and adaptive approach to anxiety management. Through continuous user feedback and iterative improvements, the project aspires to contribute to a more resilient society, where individuals are empowered to manage their mental well-being through the seamless integration of technology and mindfulness practices.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Agriculture through Cyber Physical Systems: The Role of Robotics in Smart Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Increased production in agriculture is anticipated with localized management that is founded on several analyses of the crops and soil. The following issues arise with this method: it takes a long time because there are a lot of measurement locations, different sensors are needed for different measures and the sun and wind might cause inaccurate data to be produced. Our proposed method benefits from multiple measurements made possible by swappable sensor units, constant measurements made possible by shielding the crop from wind and sunlight, and precise measurements made possible by a robot. The system experimented to track the crops and soil in a cabbage field simultaneously as a pilot test for the device. With a battery life of more than 4 hours, the robot could be mobile in the field and scan crops in 100 different areas. It could also detect electrical conductivity in the soil. Whether the sensor unit’s measuring circumstances remained steady during the trial was also assessed. The illumination became 280 times more constant (standard deviation = 0.4 lx) compared to the uncovered condition, and wind-induced crop shaking reduced by 20 times (root mean square inaccuracy of the image pixels = 0.5%). High repeatability owing to the shared sensor unit and the anticipation of fresh encounters through the use of accurate internal sensors are some possible repercussions of this.

articleTitle: Enhancing Book Recommendation Systems Using Collaborative Approach: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this study, we delve into the creation of a Book Recommendation System utilizing collaborative filtering techniques to offer customized book suggestions to users. Beginning with the cleansing of a dataset encompassing book details, user information, and their ratings, we ensure data accuracy for our analysis. Within this dataset, we uncover intriguing insights such as user demographics, popular authors, and book ratings, which inform our recommendation framework. Leveraging collaborative filtering, particularly Singular Value Decomposition, in order to separate the user-item matrix to generate tailored recommendations based on users' historical interactions. To gauge the system's effectiveness, we assess its performance using metrics such as recall@5 and recall@10, demonstrating its capability to deliver pertinent book recommendations. Additionally, we explore alternative recommendation strategies including popularity-based and author-based approaches, providing a comprehensive comparative analysis. Ultimately, our Book Recommendation System aims to enhance user book selection experiences, fostering greater engagement and satisfaction within the reading community.

articleTitle: AR and VR are Transforming Video Game World: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) is a simulated experience that employs pose tracking and 3D near-eye displays to give the user an immersive feel of a virtual world. On the other hand, Augmented Reality (AR) is an interactive experience that combines the real world and computer-generated content. The content can span multiple sensory modalities, including visual, auditory, haptic, somatosensory, and olfactory. Virtual Reality relates to an experience of something without a human’s physical involvement, such as a trip to any place in the world or enjoying a favourite game as a main character. This paper explains the scope and application of AR & VR with the help of video games. Moreover, the applications and advantages of the AR and VR are also detailed in this review article.

articleTitle: Anomolous Behavioral Pattern Analysis for IoT Application Using Firewall
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: As Internet of Things (IoT) devices grow in many areas, such as smart homes, healthcare, business automation, and transportation, providing a security mechanism also becomes important. This brief presents a security solution that uses electronic technology to enhance IoT applications against various cyber threats. The solution begins by identifying the unique security challenges posed by the IoT ecosystem, including device diversity, access restrictions, and communication gaps. Recognizing the important role of firewalls in network security, our approach includes firewall resources designed for IoT environments. This article includes a behavioral analysis to identify negative behavioral patterns that indicate potential security hazards resulting in threat and response. It proposes a new concept that integrates machine learning algorithms with an electronic engine to crack code. Extensive experiments have been conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the Framework. Using IoT traffic data from various applications. The results show that it is possible to identify bad patterns, including interference of illegal equipment, unreliable information, and poor communication.

articleTitle: Identification of Allium cepa L.-Derived Flavonoids as Potential Inhibitors of Human Serum Albumin Glycation in Diabetic Nephropathy: An In-Silico Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Type 2 diabetes is a global health concern, with a significant economic impact. It consists of various complications. One of the major complications is DN (Diabetic Nephropathy). It is the leading cause of CKD (Chronic Kidney Disorder) and ESRD (End-stage renal disease). Current treatments are mostly inept; therefore, a demand is brewing regarding Natural (Bioactive) compounds as a potential therapeutic use case. One such is flavonoids which have shown combating effects against diabetic complications such as antioxidative, anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic. This review delves into the flavonoid potential which is extracted from Allium cepa L (Onion.) to inhibit human serum albumin (HSA) glycation, which plays a major role in the development of diabetic difficulties. in silico molecular docking studies and ADME analysis were used to identify flavonoids with strong pharmacokinetic profiles and binding energies to HSA. The results showed quercetin, kaempferol etc from onions have strong binding energies, showing that they can serve as effective therapeutic agents against glycation-related difficulties. These results can provide an understanding regarding the pharmacological mechanism of flavonoids derived from one leading to new routes towards natural therapies with respect to diabetic nephropathy.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Machine Learning Techniques for Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Breast cancer is a primary cause of death for women. Millions of women worldwide were suspected with breast cancer diagnosis in 2022. But early-stage breast cancer is still treatable. Patients' recoveries become better when breast cancer is discovered early and treated quickly and efficiently. Machine learning algorithms have become an effective tool for precisely and successfully diagnosing breast cancer in recent years. This research focuses on the utilization of machine learning (ML) techniques. To achieve this, we looked into a variety of machine learning methods including XGBoost, Random Forest, K Nearest Neighbours, Naïve Bayes, Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, and Neural Networks. Metrics including accuracy, precision, F1score, recall, and balanced accuracy were used as indicators of the models. The result shows that K Nearest Neighbors and Naïve Bayes has more accuracy and can be effective in early detection of cancer.

articleTitle: Enhancing 5G Efficiency: Regression Analysis for Resource Allocation Optimization in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The advent of 5G networks signifies a major breakthrough in mobile communications, providing better data rates, low latency, and improved connectivity. Efficient resource allocation within 5G networks is paramount to fully leverage these capabilities, ensuring optimal performance and user satisfaction. Traditional resource allocation methods often struggle to keep pace with the dynamic and complex nature of 5G environments. The potential benefits of machine learning (ML) is explored in this research to enhance resource allocation in 5G networks. We begin by examining the unique challenges posed by 5G networks, by ML approaches employed for resource allocation, including supervised learning such as Trees, SVM, Neural Networks. Our study we train the model using MATLAB simulator. Analysis on the response and residual plot is conducted for predicted response. Analysis and comparative study is made to find the best performance metric suitable for the predicting the model for resource allocation. The study shows the improvisation in the metrics of regression learner. Simulation results demonstrate significant improvements in network performance. Finally, we have done the comparison between the results of MATLAB simulation. This study gives better decisions to service providers to enhance the overall performance of network

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Prediction of Autism Spectrum Disorder using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder, commonly known as ASD, is a type of neurodevelopmental disorder that is typically identified during early childhood. Early parental observation is crucial in timely diagnosis, facilitating prompt interventions and therapies the diverse range of symptoms and varying severity levels of ASD present significant diagnostic challenges. While many previous studies have focused on diagnosing ASD in adults, early detection remains paramount despite the disorder's incurable nature. In this study, a predictive ASD model for toddlers' datasets was presented, utilizing ensemble learning methods such as voting. This approach complements conventional learning methods. The predictive analysis of ASD is carried out in two stages, first, ASD diagnosis is conducted utilizing a range of classification algorithms, such as Random Forest (RF), Bernoulli Naive Bayes (NB), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) with Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel on the dataset of toddlers. To improve the performance of the ASD prediction model in the final stage, the voting ensemble learning approach was used in conjunction with three classifiers from the base above learners. The findings show that the proposed ensemble-based prediction models outperform basic Machine Learning (ML) approaches regarding accuracy, recall, F1 score, and precision, making them more useful for early-stage ASD diagnosis in toddler datasets.

articleTitle: Banking Security and Customer Experience: Cloud Computing-Enabled KYC in the Digital Era using ANN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The research work investigates the innovative notion of IoT-enabled Know Your Customer (KYC) and the revolutionary possibilities of Internet of Things (IoT) in the banking sector. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) models may discover complicated data correlations, making customer verification more accurate and efficient. Banks may automate KYC processes using cloud-based ANN models to speed up client onboarding and transaction approvals in the digital age. The demand for better protection measures, quicker client onboarding, and constant compliance monitoring is rising as the banking industry moves online. Financial institutions may provide a more modern and streamlined client experience by adding IoT devices and technology into the KYC procedure. The system will look at how IoT-based biometric authentication techniques, including face recognition, voice analysis, and geolocation verification, may provide strong identity verification while protecting client data. In this article, the system explores how to give clients more agency via the IoT by integrating wearable devices for safe banking interactions and remote KYC. It also emphasizes the importance of IoT in real-time compliance monitoring, which helps financial institutions spot and stop fraudulent acts as soon as it occurs. This study foresees a future in which an IoT-driven KYC transformation improves banks security, customer experiences, and regulatory compliance efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhancing street light fault detection in Smart Cities using Machine Learning and Deep Neural Network Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In today’s smart city era, efficient management of infrastructure, including street lighting, is vital for ensuring safety, reducing energy consumption, and fostering sustainability. To improve security and safety, investing in sufficient lighting for public areas and highways encourages energy conservation and long-term environmental viability. Recent developments in the discipline are examined, along with significant obstacles and opportunities, by conducting a comprehensive analysis of the most recent scientific literature. In this paper, novel techniques have been explored to improve street light defect identification through the application of ML and DNN algorithms. In this paper, the historical data and sensor measurements are analysed using various machine learning algorithms to detect faults in street lights, including support vector machines, decision trees, and ensemble approaches. The paper highlights the merits, drawbacks, and performance metrics of various proposed models through comparative analyses. To promote sustainable urban development and enhance the general quality of life, our research aims to acquire knowledge regarding effective methodologies for enhancing the detection of street light malfunctions in smart cities.

articleTitle: Enhanced Artificial Neural Network Algorithm for Predicting Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study explores the application of deep learning models for the detection of lung cancer subtypes utilizing histopathological images. Leveraging a diverse dataset containing images of adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, normal tissue, and large cell carcinoma, our research aims to develop accurate classification models to aid in early diagnosis and treatment planning. The dataset is meticulously preprocessed, ensuring uniform image sizes and balanced class distributions. Two deep learning architectures, VGG16 and MobileNetV2, are employed and trained on the dataset. The VGG16 model is fine-tuned with additional layers for classification, while the MobileNetV2 model is utilized in its pre-trained form. Rigorous training and evaluation procedures are conducted, including stratified train-test splits and performance metric assessments. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of both models in accurately classifying lung cancer subtypes, with the VGG16 model achieving particularly high accuracy. Comparativeanalysis between the two models highlights their respective strengths and performance differences. Overall, this research contributes to the advancement of computer-aided diagnosis systems for lung cancer detection, offering potential solutions for improving patient outcomes and healthcare decision-making.

articleTitle: Ensembled PreTrained Convolutional Neural Network Techniques for Human Activity Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) plays a pivotal role across a broad spectrum of applications, ranging from healthcare monitoring to enhancing security systems and refining human-computer interaction. This research introduces an advanced ensemble approach that integrates multiple Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), each engineered to extract unique features and representations from benchmark datasets encompassing a variety of human activities. The synergy of these CNNs within our ensemble framework has led to a marked improvement in recognizing a diverse array of activities, underscoring the efficacy of CNNs in elevating HAR's capabilities. Moreover, we propose a methodological framework that harnesses the collective strength of ensemble CNNs, aiming to boost the accuracy and robustness of activity recognition. This innovative approach not only sets a new standard in achieving high precision in HAR but also opens new avenues for deploying more dependable and precise human activity recognition systems in real-life scenarios.

articleTitle: Generative AI based Interior Designing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study proposes an innovative AI-powered platform that aims to transform traditional interior design procedures. By combining user input with powerful AI algorithms, the platform improves design workflows and creative flexibility. Users start by designing a basic room layout and placing necessary things, which are then intelligently mapped onto the space’s structure using ControlNet and Hough transformation techniques. This provides accurate representation and rapid design iterations. The platform provides users with straightforward object manipulation controls, allowing for more personalized environment creation. Furthermore, the combination of AI-generated designs, object removal using ResNet architecture, and object replacement via stable diffusion generative AI improves user interaction and happiness. Additionally, customers can estimate product costs thanks to interaction with the Google Shopping API. This holistic approach reimagines interior design techniques, combining user input with AI technologies to achieve greater creativity and efficiency in creating living spaces.

articleTitle: Economic Growth, Automation and Environmental Degradation: An Empirical Evidence from Asian Countries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0 the increase in population as a result of environmental erosion is the prime concern in the global scenario, Asia as the biggest continent is very much applied to it. In this context assessment of the interrelation relationship between automation, financial development, environmental degradation, and per capita growth of 12 Asian Countries from 1995 to 2022 using the panel ARDL model, in addition to assessing the cause-effect relationship panel causality test also incorporated. As a part of ARDL PMG estimation results demonstrated that capital formation, import automation machinery, urban population growth, and ecological footprint positively impact per capita in the long term. But in this phenomenon, aggregate industrial value added negatively impacts per capita, because of automation labor displacement. Results from the causality test suggest that economic upswing, and urban population growth two-way causal relationship. However, capital formation, value-added, and ecological footprint positively impacted per capita growth. Regarding policy formulation need to formulate the necessary skill development program so that individuals can cope with the new decade of automation, in addition, ecological footprint as an indicator of environmental degradation positively impacts per capita growth, so the government needs to make a strategy at the societal level toward sustainable ecofriendly behavior.

Author Keywords: gdp per capita(gross domestic product per capita)

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving and Federated Learning-based Drowsy Driving Detection for ITS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The issue of drowsy driving is highly dangerous for road safety and lead to car accidents, injuries as well as deaths. This study examines the several technology suggestions made to address the serious issue of drowsy driving, which compromises road safety worldwide. The study looks at different sleep-related accident prevention tactics and assesses how well they work with intelligent transportation systems (ITS). Federated Learning (FL) is an intriguing method that ensures privacy while improving accuracy for identifying weariness. Furthermore, the paper offers a novel method of transparently responsible traffic control by fusing blockchain technology with convolutional neural networks (CNNs). This integrated system authenticates smart contracts, maintains stringent records, and quickly detects drowsiness to protect system integrity. Essentially, these results highlight effective learning dynamics in FL, like strong aggregation techniques. Furthermore, this fully integrated architecture is not only exceptionally good at detecting sleep, but it also boasts a safe and dependable environment that is applicable to a variety of sectors in terms of international settings and the dependability of academic discourse.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Security: The Role of Big Data in Building Resilient Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: IoT has revolutionized various industries, but it has also made them vulnerable to cyber attacks. Traditional security measures often fail to address the specific issues posed by diverse and scattered nature of IoT devices. Big data has emerged as crucial tool for improving IoT security, as it provides a vast amount of data for identifying patterns and abnormalities that could indicate potential security breaches. This data can be processed in real-time, allowing for continuous monitoring and detecting suspicious actions. AI can be used to forecast and prevent cyberattacks, reducing the risk of attacks and minimizing potential harm. By incorporating big data analytics into IoT security frameworks, organizations can better respond to incidents and increase threat intelligence. This comprehensive perspective improves situational awareness and contributes to the development of efficient security tactics. Additionally, robust IoT networks require strong architectural designs, authentication systems, secure communication protocols, zero-trust architectures, and adaptive defensive mechanisms. These methods constantly adapt to the ever-changing nature of threats, ensuring the resilience of IoT ecosystems. In conclusion, a comprehensive strategy for improving IoT security can be achieved through the combination of big data analytics and robust network architectures.

articleTitle: Enhancing Deepfake Video Detection Performance with a Hybrid CNN Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This These days, a lot of phoney photos and movies are produced using modern AI (Artificial Intelligence) technology and software, which occasionally leaves traces of manipulation. Videos may be used in numerous unethical ways to intimidate, quarrel, or incite fear in others. Making ensuring that these techniques aren't applied to produce phoney videos is crucial. Deep Fake is an AI-based method for creating synthetic photographs of people. They are made by merging and overlaying preexisting videos with the original videos. This research develops a system that extracts frame-level characteristics using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) hybrid made out of Xception and InceptionResnet v2. We do an experimental investigation with Kaggle's DFDC deep fake detecting challenge. By utilizing this dataset's for testing and training, these deep learning-based techniques are tuned to improve accuracy while cutting down on training time. Our results showed a 0.985 accuracy, 0.96 recall, 0.98 f1-score, and 0.968 support.

Author Keywords: algorithms for deep learning and deepfake video detection

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of Residential Energy Sharing Communities: A Simulation Study on Load Profile Suitability and Profitability
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The potential of residential energy sharing communities—especially those with photovoltaic and battery storage systems—to facilitate the transition to decentralised, sustainable renewable energy is explored in this study. The study simulates the profitability of 1,000 communities and looks at the relationship between household load profiles and whether or not they are suitable for energy sharing using actual load profile data from USA. To concisely define the high-dimensional load profiles, a comprehensive collection of electricity parameters was built from both a thorough analysis of the literature and new creations. The inability of Machine Learning (ML) models to predict community revenues effectively, even with efforts in hyperparameteroptimisation and different training dataset configurations, led to recommendations for future research topics. Therefore, a thorough examination of the load profiles of both low- and high-performing communities, theories about the favourable traits of residential load profiles for energy sharing were developed. These theories highlighted the intricate relationship between household energy habits and community energy dynamics.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Framework for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV)-Enabled Real-Time Human Detection System for Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Disasters pose significant challenges to emergency response efforts, often hindering timely and effective interventions. In recent years, integrating Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) has emerged as a promising approach to enhance disaster management capabilities. This paper presents a novel real-time framework leveraging UAV technology for disaster response. The framework encompasses UAV deployment strategies, real-time data acquisition through aerial imaging and remote sensing, robust data transmission using advanced communication infrastructure, automated AI and machine learning analysis, and dynamic resource coordination based on actionable insights. By integrating these elements, the proposed framework aims to improve situational awareness, optimize response efforts, and facilitate informed decision-making during disaster scenarios. This paper discusses the key components of the framework, highlighting its potential impact on enhancing disaster response capabilities in real-time scenarios.

articleTitle: Real-Time Threat Detection and Mitigation in Web API Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the intricate field of web API development, the imperative for robust security measures is more pronounced than ever. This research delves into the realm of real-time threat detection and mitigation in web API development, drawing parallels with real-time threat detection methodologies employed in JavaScript. The study underscores the pressing need for advanced security protocols in an era marked by escalating reliance on online applications. A distinguishing feature of this research is its emphasis on harnessing the power of web APIs for real-time threat detection. It provides an in-depth exploration of monitoring techniques and logging mechanisms in web APIs, and presents a comprehensive overview of real-time threat mitigation strategies. These insights are not merely theoretical but are grounded in practical application, offering a pragmatic guide for developers navigating the complex landscape of web API security. The research methodology is rigorous and multifaceted, encompassing an extensive literature review on real-time threat detection and online application security. This is supplemented with illustrative code examples and case studies, providing a tangible context for the theoretical concepts discussed. This research makes a significant contribution to the existing body of knowledge on real-time threat detection using web APIs. It offers invaluable insights for developers and security practitioners, equipping them with the knowledge and tools to safeguard web applications against emerging threats in the digital landscape.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence For Realtime Face Recognition Attendance Using College Classrooms and Buses
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Teachers take attendance by having pupils sign in or check-in classes and transportation. Student absences often result from individual mistakes. This article examines a technology that records data from classroom photographs of every student's face. This research uses an Adaptive Boost Classifier, Random Forest (RF), and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs). The model performs well on the DCNN model with 88 and 92% accuracy and on the ResNet50 pre-trained model with 97.21% accuracy. After detecting each student's face, they recorded their present status in an Excel document. It kept the best system implementation approach based on performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Channel Capacities in 6G Networks: Massive MIMO, Millimeter-wave and Terahertz Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the exploration of channel capacities within 6G networks, a comparative analysis has been conducted on Massive MIMO, Millimeter-wave, and Terahertz communication channels. The study reveals that, in terms of capacity, both Millimeter-wave and Terahertz channels demonstrate slightly elevated capacities in comparison to Massive MIMO. However, it is noteworthy that all three channels exhibit promising capabilities for facilitating high- capacity wireless communication in advanced. The research reveals that Millimeter-wave and Terahertz frequency bands exhibit slightly greater average channel capacities compared to Massive MIMO, showcasing potential for high-capacity wireless communication. Terahertz technology operates at frequencies exceeding 300 GHz, providing exceptionally wide bandwidths and rapid data transmission speeds, making it well-suited for applications demanding substantial throughput. On the other hand, Millimeter-wave technology, operating within the 30 GHz to 300 GHz range, facilitates accelerated data transfer rates due to its broader bandwidth availability, making it particularly suitable for high-capacity uses such as advanced 5G services. While Massive MIMO systems, which employ multiple antennas at the base station, enhance spectral efficiency and capacity, they achieve only a moderate data rate per unit bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Decision Support System for Extracting Artificial Intelligence Driven Insights on Natural Disasters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Natural disasters present major obstacles to global disaster management initiatives and the potential for integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques into disaster management decision-support systems in order to overcome the drawbacks of traditional methods is enormous. One of the most important approaches to overcoming the obstacles is to assess Twitter data by utilizing AI technologies. By creating an AI-based Decision Support System (DSS) especially suited for Twitter data analysis, this research aims to bridge a significant gap in existing disaster management technologies. During catastrophic events, social media platforms—especially Twitter—have proved to be essential sources of timely and precise data. But, data from networking platforms is chaotic, which presents problems for conventional decision support systems. This research aims to improve the performance of disaster response as well as post disaster recovery by utilizing cutting-edge methods like LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) networks and sentiment analysis libraries like TextBlob. The decision-makers and rescue workers can gain important insights by carefully examining the data to understand popular views and sentiments. This research intends to aid in the creation of more resilient and adaptable disaster management frameworks by utilizing AI techniques. A remarkable result of our approach using tweets data is the 97.5% of sensitivity estimation accuracy. Due to its high level of accuracy, Twitter data may provide strong and reliable insights which provide rescue executives and managers timely and accurate data during high-risk occurrences.

articleTitle: LEGAL AI: A Tool to help Lawyers Optimize their Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The modern legal environment where quick changes are happening requires integrating advanced technologies to make legal professionals more efficient and effective. The purpose of this project is to propose "LegalAI," which could solve some of the critical challenges legal software and hardware lawyers currently face, such as document analysis, language translation, and privacy. Legal AI’s primary concern is the difficulty and time- intensive nature of reviewing extensive legal documents. By synthesizing and recomposing key points, Legal AI aids the lawyer in obtaining the most important content from lengthier texts as soon as possible. This increases experts’ time and productivity. Moreover, the capabilities of legal AI include translation of the language to ensure free interaction among the lawyers from states. It will contribute to greater cohesion and collaboration within the legal cluster. There are several aspects related to the privacy of the client’s sensitive information such as redaction. All of the abovementioned aspects contribute to the considerable opportunities of legal AI to improve the performance of the professionals. In general, legal Ai involves the integration of automated document summary, language translation, and privacy protection mechanisms for better performance of the lawyers.

articleTitle: Block-Chain Enhanced Patient Triage System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In today's fast-paced healthcare environment, efficient management of patient records and seamless patient-provider communication is crucial. This study proposes a comprehensive solution integrating blockchain technology (Ethereum), frontend web interfaces, natural language processing (NLP), and adverse drug event detecting functions. Through a user-friendly React.js interface, patients input health data securely, while NLP automates medical information extraction from conversations. ADE detectors identify drug interactions and adverse events, enhancing care and safety. Ethereum integration via Metamask ensures secure record storage, with IPFS storage and CIDs enabling encrypted data sharing. A smart contract on Ethereum automates data management for transparency and accountability.

articleTitle: From Algorithms to Alpha: Exploring the Role of Machine Learning in Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper explores how machine learning is transforming the financial markets, specifically in relation to trading strategies and profit-maximizing investment choices. We examine machine learning’s influence on algorithmic trading, revealing how it shapes trading algorithms and guides investment strategies to maximize returns, commonly called "alpha." From there, we explore a wide range of financial applications of machine learning, such as fraud detection, portfolio optimization, and risk management. While highlighting the positive impacts of machine learning, we also acknowledge and address the challenges it presents in finance. Overall, this article shows how machine learning (ML) is changing the financial landscape and emphasizes the need for ethical use to maximize its advantages while minimizing its risks.

articleTitle: Exploring Machine learning applications in cyber attacks detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Attackers and hackers employ many tactic known as phishing, cyber-attacks, dos attacks DOS attacks, man in middle attacks etc to damage trustworthy URLs as well as important websites. In this research, we discussed various cyber threats, the interrelation of cyber threats, and machine learning types of phishing attacks various techniques to detect cyber phishing by using machine learning, and we have also compared various phishing attacks with a few machine learning techniques with the help of a classification technique like supervised learning in which we apply SVM, random forest and extreme learning machine, the NSL-knowledge discovery is used in the evaluation of intrusion detection method also we have compared the accuracy in which precision-recall is used to find the accuracy and to calculate the performance and we concluded that ELM method give best result in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Categorization of Textual Data: Harnessing Recurrent Neural Networks and Concept Net for Extensive Topic Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Text analysis uses machine learning (ML) and natural language processing (NLP) to find underlying patterns in text documents. These techniques include textual data categorization and topic modeling. This unsupervised technique looks at words and phrases that appear frequently in a collection of texts and arranges them to produce a useful synopsis of the material. Deep recurrent neural networks, like Long ShortTerm Memory (LSTM) and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks, are used in this method to classify documents. The models train the system using cosine similarities, which are computed using semantic networks such as ConceptNet. Two scenarios—one with and one without Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF)—are used for the analysis.Testing on the AGNews and BBC News datasets produced results showing that applying TF-IDF greatly increased both models' accuracy and other validation measures. Through the combination of ConceptNet, WordNet, TF-IDF, and recurrent neural networks (LSTM and BiLSTM), this technique improves text classification with greater accuracy and efficiency than previous methods.

articleTitle: Investigating Key Contributors to Hospital Appointment No-Shows Using Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The healthcare sector has suffered from wastage of resources and poor service delivery due to the significant impact of appointment no-shows. To address this issue, this paper uses explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) to identify major predictors of no-show behaviours among patients. Six machine learning models were developed and evaluated on this task using Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUC-PR) and F1-score as metrics. Our experiment demonstrates that Support Vector Classifier and Multilayer Perceptron perform the best, with both scoring the same AUC-PR of 0.56, but different F1-scores of 0.91 and 0.92, respectively. We analysed the interpretability of the models using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanation (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). The outcome of the analyses demonstrates that predictors such as the patients' history of missed appointments, the waiting time from scheduling time to the appointments, patients' age, and existing medical conditions such as diabetes and hypertension are essential flags for no-show behaviours. Following the insights gained from the analyses, this paper recommends interventions for addressing the issue of medical appointment no-shows.

articleTitle: English-to-Hindi Speech-to-Speech Translation of Interviews with Automatic Voice Switching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: An interview serves as an effective means of acquiring knowledge from professionals in their respective fields. These recorded interviews utilizing an online platform can benefit larger audiences seeking knowledge in a specific area. It is quite prevalent for experts to converse in English during these interviews, which might occasionally result in a loss of interest among non-English listeners or those who are not proficient in English. The existing Speech-to-Speech Translation (S2ST) models translate source speech into target speech in a single canonical voice. This study introduces a pipeline for S2ST that converts recorded interview speech from English to Hindi with an Indian accent. Within the pipeline, automatic detection of male and female speakers occurs, and subsequently, their speech is translated into male and female canonical voices. The S2ST model is composed of an automatic speech recognizer (ASR), machine translator (MT), and text-to-speech synthesis (TTS), along with gender voice recognition and voice switching.

articleTitle: An Optimized Low Power 10T SRAM using FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to create and investigate a low-power 10T Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM) cell that is optimised for usage with Fin Field-Effect Transistor (FinFET) technology. The first step in the research process involves the development of a 10T SRAM model by leveraging Metal-Oxide- Semiconductor Field- Effect Transistor (MOSFET) technology as a baseline. The HSPICE tool is utilised to gain first insights into the performance of the model. Investigating the benefits of FinFET technology in terms of boosting power efficiency, decreasing latency, and enhancing the power-delay-product (PDP) in SRAM cells is the primary purpose of this study. The research is being carried out in the 16nm technological node, and it makes use of SPICE code simulations in order to thoroughly analyse and compare the characteristics of FinFET-based circuits to those of their MOSFET counterparts, particularly in low-power applications. The Average Power Consumption, Power Dissipation, Power Dissipation Progress (PDP), and Delay are all important performance measures. The objective of this study is to bring attention to the potential advantages of introducing FinFET technology into SRAM cell designs, with a particular emphasis on striking a balance between improved performance and power efficiency. It is anticipated that the outcomes will have a considerable impact on the advances that will take place in memory architectures in the future, which will present new prospects for the growth of SRAM technology.

articleTitle: Optimizing Concrete Compressive Strength Prediction: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This study investigates the predictive capabilities of LBGM, CATB, GBR, ADAB, and XGB models for concrete compressive strength prediction. Through an evaluation of default hyperparameters and comprehensive metrics, including R2, MSE, RMSE, MAE, RMSLE, and MAPE, nuanced insights into each algorithm’s performance are obtained. ADAB emerges as a standout performer, displaying lower error rates across multiple metrics, suggesting AdaBoost’s suitability for concrete compressive strength prediction. The analysis of a self-prepared dataset reveals significant variations across different mixture combinations and curing times. This research not only establishes a benchmark for current practices but also provides avenues for future research, including hyperparameter tuning to optimize model performance further. The practical implications for concrete engineering are significant, guiding material composition decisions and contributing to the development of more durable and resilient structures. As the intersection of machine learning and concrete engineering progresses, this study lays a foundation for tailored approaches to address the specific challenges of predicting concrete compressive strength.

articleTitle: Analysis of Comparative Methods for Machine Learning-Based Lung Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The older tiers and led expert documents are used to detect cancer; this could be useful. There has to be room for human mistake. It results in the possibility of inaccuracy in the identification of lung cancer; hence an automatic process is required. In order to reduce human error and improve the accuracy and error-free nature of the system, the report then aims to detect lung cancer early through an automated procedure. To achieve this, machine learning algorithms like naive bayes, KNN, Ridge Classifier, Multilayered Perception, and support vector machine algorithms are used to detect lung cancer. Using a dataset of lung cancer cases, we have developed five algorithms to assess performance according to four parameters: accuracy, recall, f1 score, and precision. Comparative research has been conducted on these parameters, and an AUC-ROC curve has been created to demonstrate how well machine learning models perform.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis for Stocks and Cryptocurrencies using Python
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The complexity, intricacy and volatility of vast financial systems across the world make quantitative research of equities and cryptocurrencies a very challenging undertaking. Because of this, our research project uses Python and other financial APIs to study the application of quantitative techniques in stock and cryptocurrency trading and investment systems in a detailed manner. In the domain of Quantitative analysis, there were several attempts made by Mathematical finance and econometrics scientists and other experts inorder to provide the theoretical foundation for the quantitative analysis.Their main focus was efficient portfolio optimization, asset pricing and risk management. This study looks at how to integrate technical analysis libraries like Pandas TA with Alpha Vantage API, Twelve Data APIs, and Polygon.io to access the historical and real-time market data and to facilitate the development of sophisticated trading strategies. This research work also emphasizes the significance of optimization approaches and works to enhance the robustness and performance of trading models, ensuring steady profitability while successfully managing risks on different circumstances. The research conclusions provide important new information for traders and investors who want to use technical indicators, quantitative analysis, and backtesting techniques to make well-informed decisions on trading strategies in turbulent financial markets.

articleTitle: Ranking Schools with Multiple Features: An Integrated Approach using Data Analytics and Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This paper develops a method to rate schools by using an algorithm which measures their impact and attention devoted to them in their respective field. We use the school network we built for a particular area for linking schools with similar features as a metric for our calculation because the number of schools involved with a particular requirement helps us to effectively count and predict the importance of the school. We modify the simple iterative PageRank algorithm to count the number of importance related to the school effectively to approximate the relative probability of a user selecting a particular school for admission. We introduced a multiplication factor which takes care of the time factor involved with the foundation year of school. We introduced the concept of importance and link vector to effectively connect the nodes in a school network in the form of one-to-one relation. We implemented our algorithm on a processed dataset and calculated the normalized scores involved with each node of the school network which is representing a school and using these scores we ranked the schools in a particular area concerned. For quantitative values of various theoretical features, we processed the data to obtain further relation involved with the school and various factors in the school network.

articleTitle: Advancements in Cybersecurity Using Deep Learning Techniques Attack Detection for Trojan Horses
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Today's computer networks are threatened by Trojan horse assaults and other cybersecurity dangers. We propose and evaluate deep learning methods using the Kaggle-hosted Trojan Detection dataset to detect Trojan horse assaults. This project uses these approaches. Our malware detection technology uses CNN classification for accuracy. We clean and enhance the dataset to make the model more versatile. Due to extensive testing and optimization, Trojan horse detection rates reach 98.47%. We found that the deep learning architecture accurately identifies malware. We also discuss CNN model features that illuminate Trojan horse attacks. The technique offers complete cyber security and expands our knowledge of harmful software. Deep learning may boost cybersecurity defenses against emerging attacks like Trojan horses, according to our study.

articleTitle: A Novel Shuffle Encode Distil Model for Suicide Risk Detection in Social Media
