publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Depression leading to suicidal tendency has become an important issue worldwide. However, a large number of people generally, lose their life undiagnosed and untreated. Here a social media platform with machine learning provides the vital solution to this issue. Many studies have shown that men with depressive disorder tend to post depressive messages on these platforms. This paper proposes a machine learning Shuffle Encode Distil model which can identify and classify the messages and posts as suicidal and non-suicidal. The proposed model was also tested against a few state-of-the art machine learning models like XGBoost, Random Forest, CatBoost, Support Vector Machine Classifier, etc and other proposed models. The Shuffle-Encode Distil-Model was able to classify the messages successfully with accuracy of .999, precision of 0.998, recall of 0.999 and F1 score of 0.999.

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Classification using CNN: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This review paper has examined the field of foggy image detection and defogging algorithms using convolutional neural networks to handle the challenges and limitations of poor visibility during harsh weather conditions such as fog. A detailed comparison of three of the most successful fog detection algorithms—FogNet, FogCNN, and DeepFog—based on a set of performance indicators including precision, recall, F1 score, false positive rate (FPR), false negative rate (FNR), and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) has been conducted. From the performance evaluation, it is clear that DeepFog offers the best performance in distinguishing between foggy and non-foggy images with higher levels of accuracy. In addition, we have surveyed various imaging techniques with several methodologies that outperformed previously published defogging algorithms based on metrics such as Structural Similarity Index and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio. Moreover, we also consider the future development of such technology through multi-modality fusion strategies, real-time optimization, adversarial training, and human-centric applications to give an impression of the advancement of robust systems for these real-world use scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhancing Data Privacy and Accountability in Smart Grids with Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Smart grids offer promising opportunities for energy efficiency but raise concerns about data privacy and transparency. This paper presents a new framework for Secure and Auditable Private Data Sharing designed specifically for smart grids, with a focus on its functionality as a password manager. By utilizing smart contracts and blockchain technology, the framework creates explicit guidelines for data usage that guarantee clear oversight of data access and intended uses. In addition to managing smart grid data, the framework securely stores passwords and credentials, providing users with a comprehensive solution for data security and access management. The use of off-chain smart contract execution and trusted execution environments maximizes performance. To further assure transactional reliability during the result dissemination and payment procedures, the framework employs a two-phase atomic delivery mechanism. Energy service providers gain from optimum contracts because they encourage high-quality data exchange and customer participation through the use of contract theory. Extensive simulations validate the efficacy of the proposed approach, enabling users to securely access their data remotely through a cloud platform integrated with open-source services.

articleTitle: Investigating EEG Biomarker Profiles Across Neurodegenerative Disease States
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The study aims to apply and analyze significant EEG biomarkers that can differentiate between healthy controls, AD (Alzheimer's), and FTD (front temporal dementia). Spectrogram analysis and frequency peak detection reveal distinctive patterns. In AD, decreased alpha power and increased theta power are noted, alongside altered peak frequencies. FTD exhibits aberrations in alpha, theta, and beta powers, coupled with disruptions in Katz fractal dimension norms. Healthy controls display normative EEG patterns. Additionally, Phase Lag Index (PLI) matrices unveil connectivity differences. These findings highlight EEG's potential in diagnosing and differentiating neurodegenerative disorders. EEG biomarkers offer insights into disease mechanisms and could aid in early detection and personalized management strategies.

articleTitle: Empowering Learning: An Integrated Approach to Enhance Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Programming has become one of the most essential skills in virtually every industry. However, we have access to numerous resources and platforms for learning and development, but may still find ourselves inadequately prepared in this field, not reaching the level of proficiency as aspire to achieve. This has increased the demand for a dedicated phase that is allotted uncommonly for the students to support a coding society among them, right from the beginning. The initiative that is planned to settle this specific issue will also help students to overcome their limitations through continuous data-driven learning. The inevitable outcome will be a platform ALGAR which can be utilized by the students and faculty members to do any kind of code and estimation by using different programming languages like C, C++, Java, Python, etc. Moreover, they can also run their code independently inside an integrated compiler, eliminating the need for an external compiler. Along with this, the comparison of the suggested platform features with the various other existing education platforms like GitHub, Leet Code, Code Chef etc., is also discussed to empower the learning.

articleTitle: Exploring Generative Adversarial Network for Image Synthesis: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In recent years, computer vision and machine learning have turned their attention to the research of using deep neural networks to produce realistic images. By using a sizable image collection to train the model, images can be produced at the pixel level. Creating anime images from a basic drawing presents an interesting research challenge. The domain of anime picture generation is studied in this article using the Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) model. Unsupervised machine learning algorithms use a subset of artificial intelligence called GAN. Using a discriminator and generator, the model can create realistic anime faces. While the Generator is a network that produces images, the Discriminator determines if the image is produced or real. To produce anime faces of the finest quality, it places the highest priority on the thorough selection of superior datasets. Strict training is carried out using sophisticated methods and optimized hyper-parameters. Additionally, a comparative analysis with other generative picture creation methods is provided by the research.

articleTitle: Exploring Technological Interventions for Dyslexia Across Multilingual Contexts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Dyslexia is a developmental disorder that significantly impacts language skills, particularly reading and writing, while individuals often excel in other cognitive areas such as memory and problem-solving. This paper systematically reviews the latest assistive technologies designed to enhance language skills in dyslexic students. The review highlights technological interventions across diverse linguistic and cultural contexts, emphasizing visually engaging and gamified environments that have shown promise in mitigating dyslexic challenges. A notable gap in the literature is the lack of comparative studies examining the effectiveness of these technologies in English versus nonEnglish language interventions. This paper aims to address this gap by providing a comprehensive analysis of the existing technological solutions tailored to dyslexic learners, focusing on their effectiveness in overcoming common dyslexic difficulties such as phonetic challenges, mirror writing, and dyscalculia.

articleTitle: MXene: A 2-Dimensional Material for Wearable and Flexible Electronics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The unique properties of hydrogels, including their capacity to stretch, adhere to themselves, be transparent, and be compatible with living organisms, have attracted significant attention in recent times. Flexible electronics, human-machine interfaces, sensors, actuators, and other similar technologies can all derive advantages from their capacity to transmit electrical signals. MXene is a newly found two-dimensional nanomaterial that exhibits potential as a wearable sensor because of its negative charge, ability to attract water molecules, compatibility with living organisms, large surface area per unit mass, ease of modifying its properties, and excellent ability to conduct electricity like a metal. Despite the fragility of MXene-based applications, the manufacturing process of MXene into hydrogels has demonstrated a significant enhancement in their endurance. Although there has been a lot of research into using MXene-based composites in sensors, research into using MXene-based hydrogels in wearable electronics and how to prepare them is still in its infancy. Condensed and reviewed below are the many applications, manufacturing processes, and design considerations for MXene hydrogels in wearable and flexible electronics. Its goal is to support the advancement of MXene hydrogel sensors.

articleTitle: Netrasparsh- An Innovative Ardino Based Smart Shoe for Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Individuals with visual impairments encounter substantial difficulties in navigating, recognizing objects, and engaging in physical activities, which have a profound influence on their autonomy and overall well-being. NetraSparsh tackles these difficulties by incorporating cutting-edge technologies into a holistic solution. The main element is a technologically advanced shoe fitted with ultrasonic sensors based on Arduino, which enables immediate identification of obstacles and provides feedback to ensure safe navigation. In addition to this, a web application utilizes artificial intelligence-based object detection using a camera, providing instant visual information through a smartphone. In addition, an Android application tracks daily steps and promotes physical activity by incorporating gamification and individualized challenges. Initial testing suggests that the intelligent footwear consistently identifies barriers, hence improving the user's ability to move around and boosting their self-assurance. The AI-driven program demonstrates exceptional precision in identifying objects in diverse settings. Users have reported heightened engagement with their environment and enhanced ability to navigate. The Android application efficiently encourages users to participate in physical exercise, fostering a more active way of life. NetraSparsh's design is both accessible and user-friendly, specifically designed to meet the varied requirements of visually impaired individuals. It empowers them to explore their surroundings with independence and confidence. This cutting-edge system utilizes artificial intelligence, mobile computing, and sensor technologies to overcome physical obstacles and promote a healthy and active lifestyle. It represents a major breakthrough in assistive technology and has the potential to have a beneficial influence on millions of people worldwide.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis for Speech Recognition Using DeepSpeech
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The presented work aims to implement speech recognition systems for Hindi and English using advanced deep learning. Enhancing ASR technologies is crucial for improving digital communication's accessibility and efficiency across different linguistic contexts, which is pivotal for fostering broader adoption of technology in multilingual environments. The experiments were conducted using speech corpora such as LJSpeech(English Language) and OpenSLR(Hindi Language). The novelty of this research lies in the tailored adaptation of hybrid deep learning architectures, combining the strengths of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for feature extraction and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) for sequence learning, specifically configured for the acoustic properties of English and Hindi. These architectures are integrated using connectionist temporal classification to enhance transcription precision without the need for linguistic pre-segmentation. The research findings provide evidence that the implemented hybrid deep learning architectures significantly enhance the performance of ASR systems. By specifically addressing the unique challenges posed by Hindi languages, the models demonstrate improved accuracy in transcription, particularly in environments with varied acoustic properties. The system obtained a minimum WER of 21.89. This approach showcases how advanced neural network configurations can adapt to complex linguistic features, thus reducing the Word Error Rate and improving the overall reliability of speech recognition systems in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Automated Safety Compliance Monitoring in Industrial Environments with Autonomous Rover
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In today's industrial sector, the efficient monitoring of safety compliance is essential. The number of industrial accidents has been on the rise and this study proposes an alternate approach to traditional monitoring systems, designed to enhance safety by integrating NVIDIA’s Jetson Nano for data processing and computer vision supported by NVIDIA's DeepStream SDK pipeline for real-time video analytics. Equipped with IR and ultrasonic sensors, the rover autonomously navigates and detects obstacles while seamlessly sending over data from the edge device to the cloud through the integration of Azure IoT resources, it achieves efficient data communication, enabling real-time safety management and analysis.

articleTitle: Testing Strategies for Software Systems using Cognitive Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The rapid evolution of software systems, driven by the relentless demand for more sophisticated, user-centric applications, has needed the development of advanced testing strategies. Cognitive computing, with its ability to mimic human thought processes and decision-making, offers a promising avenue for enhancing software testing methodologies. This paper explores the application of cognitive computing in developing testing strategies for software systems, focusing on how these technologies can address the complexities of modern software requirements and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of testing processes.

articleTitle: Exploring Strategies and Motivational Tools for Female Employee Job Satisfaction and Longevity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the context of the workplace, employee engagement and job satisfaction are critical to the success of an organization, especially as they pertain to female employees who frequently encounter distinct obstacles. The present study investigates the complex interplay that exists among motivational tools, organizational strategies, and job satisfaction in the context of female employees. By employing quantitative analysis and interpreting information, our objective is to identify the determinants that impact employee engagement and tenure. We aim to offer organizations practical insights into cultivating a supportive and inclusive work environment by examining the distinct requirements and inclinations of female employees. The research places significant emphasis on the value of work-life balance initiatives, flexible work arrangements, career development programs, recognition, and inclusive organizational culture as a means to augment job satisfaction among female personnel. Our objective is to ascertain significant predictors of job satisfaction and engagement via rigorous statistical analysis. By doing so, we hope to enable organizations to customize their strategies to effectively address the varied requirements of their female workforce. In essence, this study makes a valuable contribution to the current corpus of knowledge regarding approaches to employee engagement and retention. It provides organizations that aspire to foster an environment that is supportive and empowering for female staff with actionable suggestions.

articleTitle: Techniques for Protecting Privacy in Big Data Security: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The rapid growth of big data and advanced analytics has unlocked immense value for organizations but has also created significant privacy risks. As companies collect and analyze ever-larger volumes of personal data, it is critical to employ privacy preserving techniques to safeguard sensitive information while still enabling big data innovation. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the latest privacy preserving methods for securing big data, including data anonymization, encryption, federated learning, differential privacy, and secure multi-party computation. We discuss the strengths and limitations of each approach and provide recommendations for their practical application based on different data security and analytics scenarios. By adopting these state-of-the-art privacy protection strategies, companies can realize the benefits of big data while preserving individual privacy and engendering trust.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Enabled System Architecture for Automatic Grading and Sorting of Walnut Fruits: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: India is the eighth largest walnut producer worldwide and exports walnuts to 70 countries worth 10 million USD (778 million INR) annually. The grading of walnut ripeness is the main concern of worry for customers and the fruit business. The efficacy and fast classification of a walnut’s ripeness stage are crucial in judging the quality. Walnut maturity classification mainly influences walnut fruit quality and later marketing. Our approach to the automatic sorting and grading of walnut ripeness focuses on the identification of marks that appear on the outer surface of walnut fruits. The image dataset for the identification of marks or patches is divided into four different classes unripe, mid-ripe, ripe, and overripe acquired through high-quality cameras used in the proposed architecture, performing feature engineering and classification using ANN, SVM, and CNN techniques. The Raspberry Pi function counts fruits in a fruit box, using a conveyor belt to detect marks and patches for grading and sorting of walnut fruit based on texture, size, and color features. A motor powers the belt, moving walnuts from the fruit placer to the mechanical part. This architecture automates the fruit grading process, significantly reducing labor costs and time compared to manual sorting. This improves productivity and allows for faster processing of large quantities of fruits and is capable of quality control, increased efficiency, reduced errors, and improved market access.

articleTitle: Optimization of YOLOv8 for Defect Detection and Inspection in Aircraft Surface Maintenance using Enhanced Hyper Parameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Aviation repair is governed by strict standards, because maintaining the integrity of aircraft surfaces is essential. Conventional inspection techniques, which frequently rely on manual examinations, are time-consuming and prone to human mistake. Through a SEM model picture collection of aircraft surface flaws, this study investigates the improved use of YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8) for diagnosing and identifying surface concerns in aviation maintenance. In order to precisely identify, locate, and classify different defect kinds, such as aggressive pitches and thin resists, it presents a revolutionary ensemble deep learning approach. In order to particularly assess SEM pictures with defects including gaps, potential gaps, line collapses, bridges, and micro bridges, the research entails training MobileNet backbone models. To further enhance detection and classification performance, the suggested approach combines predictions from several models using a Weighted Box Fusion (WBF) ensembling strategy. According to experimental findings, the optimized YOLOv8 model outperforms conventional YOLOv8 models in terms of accuracy and speed thanks to its WBF ensembling and MobileNet backbone. This sophisticated model is excellent at spotting a variety of surface flaws, such as corrosion, fractures, and other irregularities. Aircraft surface restoration has advanced significantly with the integration of MobileNet and WBF into the improved YOLOv8 model, improving Mean Average Precision (mAP) for difficult defect categories. Metrics like the F1-score, accuracy, precision, recall, specificity, and confidence score are used to assess how well this method is at reliably detecting and localizing different types of defects in SEM pictures by utilizing deep learning.

articleTitle: Image Dehazing in Low-Quality Surveillance Footage with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Images clicked in bad weather conditions can be genuinely debased by diffusing of barometrical particles, which decreases the quality, changes the colour, and makes the question highlights troublesome to recognize by human vision and by a few open-air computer vision frameworks. Subsequently picture dehazing is an imperative problem and has been broadly investigated in this virtual intelligent world. The part of picture dehazing is to expel the impact of climate variables to increase the clarity impacts of the picture and give advantage to the output. This research paper audits the most procedures of picture dehazing which has been generated in the last few decades. We imaginatively isolate several methods into different categories: picture upgrade-based strategies, picture combination-based strategies and picture rebuilding-based strategies. All the approaches are compared for standard by comparing sub- categories are presented concurring to standards and characteristics. Different quality assessment strategies are point portrayed, sorted, and examined in detail. At long last, investigate advance is summarized and future investigate bearings are recommended.

articleTitle: Exploring the Techniques for Option Pricing: An Empirical Study and Performance Assessment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The accurate pricing of financial options is crucial for effective risk management and decision-making in financial markets. Traditional option pricing models, such as the Black-Scholes model, rely on simplifying assumptions that may not fully capture the complexities of real-world market dynamics. This study aims at exploring machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models in different scenarios and evaluating their performances against the conventional methods. The methodology harnesses the power of neural networks within deep learning models to discern and learn intricate patterns and relationships inherent in historical market data. By training on a diverse dataset comprising stock prices, strike prices, time to expiration, and volatility, DL models aim to capture the nuanced interactions among these variables, thus enabling more accurate and robust option pricing compared to traditional methods. Moreover, the analysis is extended to incorporate ML models, which complement DL techniques by leveraging a variety of algorithms to discern patterns and make predictions based on historical data. Through the evaluation and comparison of both DL and ML models, we aim to ascertain the efficacy and suitability of each approach for option pricing tasks. Among the models evaluated, the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) demonstrated superior performance in option pricing tasks, achieving high accuracy and robustness across synthetic and real-world datasets. Additionally, ensemble learning techniques such as XGBoost and Gradient Boosting Tree Regression (GBTR) exhibited strong predictive capabilities, offering valuable insights into option pricing dynamics with R2 values of 0.9694 and 0.9474 in S&P 500 dataset respectively. Overall, the comparative analysis highlights the efficacy of machine learning and deep learning models in option pricing, with MLP emerging as a standout performer.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Smart Cities: A Systematic Review on Emerging Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The smart city infrastructure faces new challenges in improving the reliability and sustainability of amenities for residents. They also include extra features that enable the urban sector to adapt and configure itself based on acquired knowledge, which may not be considered advertisements. The Internet of Things (IoT) serves to links multiple things, enabling them to communicate with each other and reduce the energy required for manual labor. This technology allows machines to perform muscle work with greater precision than humans. However, a significant challenge that the world currently confronts is sustainability, which can have catastrophic consequences. It is essential to ascertain that sustainability involves more than the mere prudent use of natural resources; it includes a broader range of social, economic, and environmental considerations. In the pursuit of urban development and improved living circumstances, there is a tendency to overlook the significance of human beings and the potential depletion of resources. This paper’s purpose is to provide surveys and Studies of smart city initiatives, with a focus on their sustainability along with the need to achieve a balance between the environment, human well-being, and financial gains. Furthermore, proposing novel technical applications that are not only attractive to us but also effectively address tangible challenges in developing nations such as India.

articleTitle: Synthesizing Visual Narratives: Exploring AI- Driven Text-to-Video Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The increase in demand for dynamic multimedia content has boosted the development of an AI-based Text-to- Video Synthesis system. Addressing current challenges in manual content creation, the proposed system provides a comprehensive solution by utilizing technologies such as Natural Language Processing (NLP) for text analysis, the use of Gemini API for text summarization, gTTS for natural-sounding audio, and MoviePy for video synthesis. By leveraging advanced NLP techniques, the system analyzes and transforms textual input into visually captivating videos. With the ability to dynamically retrieve multimedia assets through web scraping, the system offers a versatile solution for content creators, educators, and multimedia enthusiasts. The suggested system responds to the increasing need for automated and adaptable text-to-video synthesis tools in various applications.

articleTitle: Attention-based Improved YOLOv5 for Effective Waste Detection and Classification System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Deep learning architectures are now prevalent among several application domains due to their better performance. Waste detection and classification are two applications that can be enhanced using deep learning. This work focuses on vision-based analysis using only camera sensors; other sensors are not included due to cost optimization. Different waste detection approaches were earlier designed based on computer vision and image processing, but there is a scope for improvement in detection accuracy. With this aim, this work proposes an improved YOLOv5 architecture. This architecture makes use of both spatial and channel attention to enhance the performance of the suggested model and extract more pertinent information during feature learning. The waste recycling plant dataset (WaRP-D) is used to analyze the performance of the improved architecture. This dataset contains image data of different waste objects such as bottles, containers, cans, cardboard, etc.; their annotations are also publicly available. The performance of our proposed model is measured considering various parameters in terms of precision, recall, and mean average precision with different thresholds (mAP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5</sup> and mAP<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5-0.95</sup>). A comparison of the proposed architecture is carried out using simple YOLOv5 architecture, which shows the effectiveness of the proposed approach. This work also compares the classification performance of this improved YOLOv5 architecture with gated recurrent units (GRU) and an optimized GRU using grey wolf optimization (GWO-GRU) on the Waste Segregation Image dataset.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Non-Pharmacological Pain Management: Integrating Mobile Applications and Wearable Devices for Chronic Pain Relief Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Physical pain can be an overwhelming experience that affects one’s physical, emotional, and social well-being. It can cause immense personal, societal, and financial strain, making it difficult to carry out daily activities. Traditional pain management options often focus on managing symptoms rather than addressing the underlying causes. Additionally, pharmaceutical treatments for pain often come with harmful side effects that may further complicate an individual’s situation. Virtual reality therapies and digital approaches are available to therapists, however we have to admit that it can only act as a distraction rather than as a approach for permanent cure. Our proposed technology for non-pharmacological pain management aims to provide an accessible and effective solution for people living with chronic pain through user-friendly mobile applications and wearable devices. We believe that our solution can help reduce the challenges the people with physical pain experience in their daily lives.

articleTitle: Bayesian Filtering-Based Internet of Drone Things for Precision Drone Delivery: Challenges, Unravelling, and Future Research Scope
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed abundant growth in the Internet of Drone Things (IoDTs) in the field of communication, supervising drones, and several severe environmental situations, etc., and the last decade beheld the application of unmanned aircraft systems, called delivery drones, in performing logistics operations such as the delivery of pharmaceutical products, groceries, and other essential daily products. This article accounts for the apotheosis of IoDTs in precision drone delivery using the Bayesian filtering methods. We also discuss the challenges associated with the real-time scenario. Finally, it also includes research opportunities and the future scope of IoDTs based on Bayesian filtering for drone delivery applications.

articleTitle: MAS for Autonomous Vehicle Coordination in Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The combination of multi-agent systems (MAS) into autonomous vehicle coordination offers a promising means for increasing the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of transportation systems. The purpose of this article is to explore an area of MAS application, namely autonomous vehicle coordination, within the domain of mechanical engineering. Using MAS, autonomous vehicles demonstrate cooperative mechanisms, allowing them to go through difficult roads while observing safety rules and improving traffic flow. The research commences with a discussion of the current literature on autonomous vehicles and MAS, drawing attention to their tight cooperation. We suggest a MAS structure constructed specifically for the specific challenges of vehicle coordination, which subsumes the agent architecture, communication protocols, decision-making algorithms, and coordination strategies. Using real-time data from case studies and simulated experiments, we analyse how MAS framework performs in a heterogeneous environment such as urban traffic control and highway merging. For instance, travel time, congestion reduction, and energy efficiency are the metrics used to evaluate the proposed approach. Issues like scaling up, real-time decision-making, and the inclusion of transportation systems in place are considered, along with possible suggestions for future research. The implications of our research indicate the integrity of MAS in the field of autonomous vehicle coordination engineering at the level of designing, implementing, and optimizing intelligent transportation systems. This research is still an important part of the ongoing conversation on autonomous vehicle technology, and it is still significant in order to help engineers, policymakers, and researchers uncover the potential of MAS for enhancing the safety and efficiency of future transportation networks.

articleTitle: Segmenting Image and Removing Obtrusive Elements
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This Model offers a novel method for processing images that highlights the main subject and removes unnecessary features using YOLO, Darknet, picture segmentation, and Mask R-CNN." The approach accomplishes accurate object detection by using procedures like segmentation using Mask R-CNN, YOLO and Darknet object identification, and backdrop blackening. It is highly skilled at identifying primary items and has been trained on a large photo dataset. Its uses include autonomous driving, object detection, and image retrieval. By drastically lowering background noise, the detection component improves the accuracy of photo object detection. Essentially, this technique is critical to improving object detection accuracy through the reduction of background noise, which is an essential component of image processing. Finding and keeping important components while eliminating unnecessary ones from test cases or camera feeds is the main goal of the Model.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Twitter Dataset using Voting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Social media platforms like Twitter is now widely used by everyone, where everyone post their opinions regarding products, ongoing trends, politics etc. Sentiment analysis helps to identify the emotional tone of texts. Sentiment analysis of twitter can help to plays an important role to determine and understanding the sentiments, towards various topics, events and trends. This work performs the sentiment analysis on twitter dataset "Sentiment140", a widely used benchmark dataset. Additionally, we explore various techniques for data preprocessing, including text cleaning, tokenization, and feature extraction done by TF-IDF using various techniques such as TF-IDF. Machine Learning models include Multinomial Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression and Gradient Boosting classifier are used for prediction and then these models passed to an Ensemble methodology technique. Voting Classifier is used as an ensemble technique which gives the optimal output than the baseline models.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for Stroke Risk Prediction Leveraging on Explainable Artificial Intelligence Techniques (XAI)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Stroke poses a significant global health challenge, contributing to widespread mortality and disability. Identifying predictors of stroke risk is crucial for enabling timely interventions, thereby reducing the increasing impact of strokes. This research addresses this imperative by employing Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques to pinpoint stroke risk predictors. To bridge existing gaps, six machine learning models were assessed using key performance metrics. Utilising the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) to minimize the impact of the imbalanced nature of the dataset used in this research, the Random Forest algorithm emerged as the most effective among the algorithms with an accuracy of 94.5%, AUC-ROC of 0.95, recall of 0.96, precision of 0.93, and an F1 score of 0.95. This study explored the interpretation of these algorithms and results using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and Explain Like I’m Five (ELI5). With the interpretations, healthcare providers can gain insight into patients’ stroke risk predictions. Key stroke risk factors highlighted by the study include Age, Marital Status, Glucose Level, Body Mass Index, Work Type, Heart Disease, and Gender. This research significantly contributes to healthcare and healthcare informatics by providing insights that can enhance strategies for stroke prevention and management, ultimately leading to improved patient care. The identified predictors offer valuable information for healthcare professionals to develop targeted interventions, fostering a proactive approach to mitigating the impact of strokes on individuals and the healthcare system.

articleTitle: An Automated Deep Learning Model for Detecting Image Forgeries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Fake image detection has emerged as a critical research area in response to the widespread dissemination of manipulated visual content across various online platforms. This paper introduces a novel approach for detecting fake images, utilizing a combination of Error-Level Analysis (ELA) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) based on deep learning techniques. ELA, a forensic methodology, identifies potential areas of digital alteration within an image by assessing the error levels introduced during compression. We exploit ELA to preprocess images, extracting informative features that are subsequently utilized in a CNN architecture for classification purposes. The model is extensively trained and evaluated using a dataset that includes a wide range of authentic and altered photos. It achieves an accuracy of 95.15% after undergoing 30 epochs of training. Empirical results underscore the efficacy of our approach in accurately discerning between authentic and fake images.

articleTitle: Crypto currency-bitcoin Price Predictor using Linear Regression and random forest
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: As a vital resource, Bitcoin has a substantial influence on economic marketplaces. This work accentuates the status of precisely estimating Bitcoin prices by seeing numerous aspects that stimulate its worth. Our goal is to recognize the most pertinent reasons and to forecast Bitcoin prices daily, showcasing outlines in Bitcoin pricing. The dataset embraces regular remarks over a year, covering the preliminary price, peak price, last price, concluding price, Bitcoin trading volume, volumes of other financial gauges, and biased values. These aspects are measured in forecasting the subsequent day's concluding price. The research employments machine learning techniques, precisely linear regression and random forest algorithms, to estimate Bitcoin prices. Exploiting an inclusive dataset from Y-Finance and Wiki, spanning five years of market data, the work accentuates the status of data preprocessing to sustain data eminence and significance. The random forest model is optimized using a grid search for hyperparameters, and performance is evaluated using Root Mean Squared Error and Pearson’s correlation coefficient. This paper highlights how these machine learning methods can improve Bitcoin price predictions, providing practical insights into model development and evaluation within volatile financial markets.

articleTitle: Continuous Health Monitoring for Early Stroke Prediction at Home
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Appropriate identification is crucial in a time when cardiovascular events -heart attacks remain the primary cause of death. Nonetheless, obtaining thorough medical evaluations frequently requires lengthy hospital trips that include tests like electrocardiograms (ECGs). What if people could take proactive control of their health from the comforts of their homes with a single, seamless device? This problem is addressed by the user-friendly and practical interface of "Continuous Health Monitoring for Early Stroke Prediction at Home." Utilizing health and lifestyle data entered by the user, this system uses machine learning algorithms that have been trained on large-scale datasets to predict the risk of stroke. Preemptive health management is made possible for users by an easy-to-use web platform that allows them to easily monitor their stroke risk. This creative approach could greatly reduce the likelihood of disease by supporting early detection programs.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Non-Invasive Diagnosis of Androgenetic Alopecia using Dermoscopic Hair Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Androgenetic alopecia, a common form of hair loss affecting both men and women, poses significant psychosocial and quality-of-life impacts. Current diagnostic methods, such as trichoscopy and biopsy, are often invasive, time-consuming, and subject to inter-observer variability. This research proposes a non-invasive approach to alopecia diagnosis using deep learning techniques applied to dermoscopic hair images. We develop a convolutional neural network (CNN) model tailored for automated detection and classification of androgenetic alopecia patterns from scalp image data. Through extensive experimentation on a curated dataset of dermoscopic hair images, we evaluate the performance of our CNN model against existing methods and explore interpretability techniques to enhance model transparency and trust. Saliency maps and feature attribution methods are employed to provide localized explanations and identify influential image regions for model predictions. Our findings demonstrate the potential of deep learning for accurate and scalable alopecia diagnosis, while emphasizing the importance of interpretability in clinical decision support. We discuss the implications, limitations, and future directions for integrating our approach into dermatological practice and telehealth applications.

articleTitle: A Review of Blockchain Technology: Its Benefits, Challenges, and Functionalities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: With the use of blockchain technology, users can synchronize, secure, and validate data throughout a duplicate transaction ledger that is shared by several parties. It has improved service capacities by giving numerous industries major benefits and incentives. Thus, this paper analyzes and explores the features, obstacles, and advantages of blockchain implementations in a variety of industries. Examining 20 papers, the study was carried out as a comprehensive evaluation of the literature. These were arranged into four sectors: government, finance, manufacturing, and healthcare, according to three main dimensions: advantages, obstacles, and functionality. Benefits (informational, economic, technological, organizational, and strategical), challenges (technological, organizational, adoption, environmental operational, usability, environmental, and sustainable) and functionalities like point-to-point transmission, data protection, security, data ownership, and transaction processing are the categories into which the findings, which are derived from the comparison of results based on factors in these dimensions, are categorized. The goal of this analysis is to give professionals, practitioners, and stakeholders who are handling blockchain-related transformation projects in their industries useful insights. Moreover, it aims to help prospective blockchain users understand the fundamental elements of blockchain, enabling informed decision-making processes inside the businesses.

articleTitle: Cyberbullying Detection in Hinglish Language
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Cyberbullying represents one of the most recent challenges stemming from the widespread adoption of social media platforms. With the surge in social media usage, the right to express oneself is being misused. Statistics reveal that approximately 36.7% of individuals believe that they have encountered cyberbullying at some point in their lives. These figures have more than doubled since 2007, and a noticeable increase occurred from 2018 to 2019, indicating an unfavorable trend. While there are existing solutions in the market aimed at mitigating this issue, many of them come with usage limitations or employ fewer effective algorithms. The primary objective of this work is to explore innovative methods for comprehending and automatically identifying instances of cyberbullying across online text messages and comments on different social media platforms. For achieving this goal, real-time data are gathered, including comments, headlines and text messages from trending posts on twitter, and devised a labelling study for categorizing cyberbullying. An analysis is presented of this labelled data, which includes an examination of the relationships between various features and both cyberbullying and cyberaggression. The core focus of this work is the early detection of cyberbullying as it originates, while being drafted in real-time. The aim of this work is to enhance the efficiency of cyberbullying detection by using various machine learning techniques and natural language processing.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Deep Image Retrieval Models Leveraging Deep Features
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This review investigates how deep learning methods can be utilized for efficient image retrieval based on content. Obtaining accurate images from vast digital collections poses significant challenges, motivating research in CBIR. The effectiveness of these methods varies depending on the dataset’s type and size, with certain algorithms excelling with specific dataset characteristics. An extensive and well-structured review of successful image retrieval techniques is given in this paper. Our primary objective is to evaluate various deep learning models applied by researchers and compare their performance based on the outcome of evaluation matrices. These models encompass CNNs, DBNs, and other deep architectures tailored for image retrieval tasks. By synthesizing insights from this review, researchers can make informed decisions regarding model selection and potentially enhance retrieval performance by leveraging advanced deep learning features. The importance of deep features in image retrieval is the ability to capture complex visual patterns and semantic information that cannot be easily extracted by traditional handcrafted features. With the increasing volume of online images, Image retrieval using deep learning has become crucial for applications like object recognition, image retrieval, and image search engines.

articleTitle: Challenges and opportunities to Enhance Buffer Management for Disaster Area in Delay Tolerant Network: A Review with Performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: A form of network called a delay-tolerant network (DTN) enables wireless nodes to communicate in settings where constant end-to-end connectivity is not ensured. In-depth discussion of buffer management inside DTNs is provided in this abstract, with an emphasis on how it might be used in disaster-prone areas. The study examines the difficulties and possibilities of enhancing buffer management techniques, particularly by adding location awareness. This research provides important insights into the performance of buffer management strategies within DTNs, particularly in disaster scenarios, by a thorough analysis of the available literature. This analysis clarifies the complex buffer management environment in DTNs by combining the results of several studies, highlighting its critical function in guaranteeing successful communication in emergency situations. The abstract emphasizes how crucial it is to use location-based information to enhance buffer management strategies. This study offers a performance analysis that aids in the creation of more reliable and effective DTN protocols for disaster management in addition to giving an overview of the present status of the field.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Biometric Authentication Systems for Facial Recognition and Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Biometric authentication methods are the focus of this study, which also delves into the topic of facial recognition technology. The study aims to address existing issues in face recognition systems, such as accuracy, robustness, and user-friendliness, by recognising the significant impact of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning, specifically convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The study used the Olivetti Dataset obtained from Kaggle, which consists of 400 facial photos belonging to 40 people. The research follows a methodical approach that includes data collecting, preparation, and the partitioning of the dataset into training and testing sets. A main goal is to combine hybrid CNN models—LR-XGB-CNN, LR-LGBM-CNN, and LR-CBC-CNN—in order to improve accuracy and resilience. The comparative research demonstrates that the LR-LGBM-CNN model surpasses its predecessors, attaining higher levels of precision, accuracy, recall, and F1-score. Notably, it achieves an amazing accuracy rate of 87%. This study makes a noteworthy addition to the advancement of biometric identification technology by overcoming the limits of existing face recognition systems. It also promotes enhancements in confidentiality and user experience in various situations.

articleTitle: FDI in Developing Nations: Unveiling Trends, Determinants and Best Practices for India
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the recent UNCTAD World Investment Report 2023, China has the highest FDI inflows among the developing countries, following Brazil, India, Mexico, and Indonesia. These five developing countries attracted more FDI inflows in the year 2022. However, among these five countries, China and the other four countries have a lot of differences in FDI inflows. So, this study investigates the factors helping China get more FDI inflows by analyzing the trends and determinants of FDI inflows. The study also compares all the selected countries to suggest the best practices India can adopt to enhance its FDI attractiveness. So, the study considered economic indicators like GDP, infrastructure, trade openness, and natural resources. Further, panel data analysis was used to investigate the determinants influencing FDI inflows, utilizing the Panel Autoregressive Distributed Lag (P-ARDL) model for the data from 1990 to 2022. The findings showed that trade openness, market size, and quality of infrastructure explain the attraction of FDI inflows in selected countries in the long run. Thus, it is important to implement policies that encourage international collaboration by raising trade, lowering corporate expenses, and making infrastructural investments. India’s availability of a large consumer market, developed infrastructure, and government initiatives like ‘Make in India,’ and "Skill India" have pulled major FDI inflows. India should prioritize manufacturing, IT, and healthcare while improving infrastructure and streamlining regulations.

articleTitle: Enhanced Hepatitis B Diagnosis: Analysis of Intelligent Systems Utilizing Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Hepatitis B is a prevalent viral infection that affects millions of people globally. It presents substantial health hazards and necessitates precise diagnostic techniques for successful treatment. This research provides a detailed investigation into the creation and application of intelligent hybrid systems to improve the diagnosis of hepatitis B. These systems incorporate fuzzy logic as a crucial element. By utilizing a wide range of data sources and implementing advanced algorithms, our technique strives to enhance the precision and effectiveness of diagnostic processes. By conducting rigorous experimentation and analysis on an extensive dataset, our proposed technique attains a remarkable accuracy rate of 94.35%. This accomplishment signifies a significant progress in the diagnosis of hepatitis B, surpassing current diagnostic methods. Our methodology exceeds the accuracy reported in the recent and highly regarded article by Dalwinder Singh et al., which reached an accuracy of 94%. In addition, our work explores the complexities of incorporating fuzzy logic into intelligent systems, clarifying its function in improving diagnostic accuracy. Our solution utilizes fuzzy logic to effectively handle the ambiguity and unpredictability in hepatitis B diagnostic data by using its inherent flexibility and adaptability. The ramifications of our findings go beyond only diagnosis accuracy, potentially transforming hepatitis B management techniques. Our methodology enables the early and accurate detection of conditions, which can result in prompt interventions, enhanced patient outcomes, and more efficient public health initiatives.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approaches for Stocks Price Prediction: A New Institutive Way of Neural Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Stock price prediction is a critical aspect of financial decision-making for both individual investors and institutions. Traditional methods such as ARIMA and deep learning techniques like ANNs, LSTM, and GRU have demonstrated effectiveness in forecasting stock prices but suffer from inherent limitations. In recent years, hybrid models have emerged as a promising approach to address these shortcomings. This research paper introduces and evaluates three novel hybrid models for stock price prediction. First model integrates GRU, LSTM, and attention mechanisms to leverage the strengths of each component. By employing attention mechanisms, the model can focus on relevant information, thereby enhancing prediction accuracy. The second model combines GRU and LSTM networks with attention mechanisms, incorporating additional architectural elements to further refine predictive capabilities. The third proposed model is a fusion of the first two, augmented with additional features and enhancements to achieve superior performance in stock price prediction tasks. Evaluation of these proposed models utilizes commonly used metrics to assess predictive accuracy and generalizability. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed hybrid approaches in improving stock price prediction performance. This research contributes to the advancement of stock price prediction methodologies by proposing innovative hybrid models, offering valuable tools for researchers and practitioners in the finance industry seeking enhanced forecasting accuracy and decision-making capabilities.

articleTitle: Identification of Plant Disease Stage Through Leaf Analysis using Potato Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Plant ailments can threaten farmers' livelihoods and their ability to produce enough food. Early detection and diagnosis are crucial for effective management and control of plant diseases. As leaf is one of the essential part of plants, its analysis can lead to detection of any problem on the plant, its analysis is a promising approach for disease stage prediction, as it can be used to spot minute changes in leaf physiology and appearance that might happen even before the start of obvious symptoms. In this research a machine learning system is introduced that can accurately determine the stage of potato leaf diseases automatically. The model involves steps such, as gathering images preparing them for analysis identifying features combining them and making predictions. By blending features from established models using the suggested Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) the models’ capabilities are enhanced. The utilization of vision transformers aids in making predictions. The model has been tested using a dataset containing images of early blight, late blight and healthy leaves. Through the integration of segmentation and feature fusion techniques this method achieves an accuracy rate of 95.28%. These results validate that the combined framework significantly improves the detection and prediction accuracy of potato plant diseases showing promise, for real world applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Generation by fusing Auto Encoder & Transformative Generation Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) models have showcased outstanding ability in language understanding and generation, yet they confront inherent limitations in directly generating high-accuracy images due to their text-based nature. To address this, a novel approach by fusing GPT with Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders (VQ-VAE) is proposed to overcome the constraints of GPT in image synthesis. This approach helps in using the strengths of VQ-VAE in processing visual data by utilizing it as an encoder to derive discrete latent representations from input images. These latent representations, incorporating essential visual details, are subsequently fed into the GPT decoder. This approach facilitates GPT's interpretation and generation of high-coherence images based on the latent space representations obtained from VQ-VAE. This work acknowledges GPT's limitations as a text-based model and seeks to overcome them by utilizing VQ-VAE's ability to process image data and generate discrete latent codes. By integrating these models, this approach helps in producing images that are both contextually coherent and visually realistic, surpassing the boundaries of GPT's inherent text-centric framework. The proposed generative approach yielded FID scores of 23.35, 28.6 and 21.45 for the MNIST digit classification dataset, CIFAR-10 dataset, and MNIST fashion dataset, respectively

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-based Optimized Driving Behaviour Framework for Autonomous Vehicles in Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial method for training autonomous vehicles that can navigate complex and changing environments. However, calculating effective reward functions for RL agents in autonomous vehicles remains difficult. The reward function shall capture the desired driving behaviours while also being robust to different road conditions and traffic densities. This study proposes an innovative approach to designing a reward function for RL agents in autonomous driving. The proposed approach involves a variety of high-level and low-level actions to measure the effectiveness of an agent. The agent is evaluated on a variety of randomly generated driving scenarios, which include different traffic intensities, lane keeping, overspeeding, and collision avoidance. The outcomes show that the proposed approach is highly effective in training RL agents to drive safely and efficiently in numerous environments.

articleTitle: Hermit Crab Optimization to Overcome Coverage Hole Issue for Efficient Hole Issue in WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Wireless sensor network plays a major role in prediction and surveillance-based applications, it is necessary to keep all the nodes in the transmission range to have efficient coverage to monitor and instantly access data from the deployed area during the event. When nodes are randomly deployed in the field, some nodes get placed far away from the transmission range of the main set of nodes. To get them back, Delaunay triangulation, and received signal strength indicator (RSSI) methods are used to find whether they are in the transmission range or not. To improve the coverage efficiency during the deployment, the hermit crab algorithm is proposed to find the optimized location to deploy and to keep the nodes in transmission range and how it is different from previous meta- heuristic algorithms is analyzed. This method gives efficient coverage and reduces energy consumption increasing network lifetime by keeping nodes in the transmission range.

articleTitle: Seamless Subaquatic Connectivity: Harnessing Li-Fi for Underwater Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This project investigates underwater communication utilizing Li-Fi technology. Two Arduino Nano microcontrollers orchestrate communication, employing Li-Fi modules for data transfer. Comprehensive environmental monitoring is achieved by integrating heart rate, temperature, and humidity sensors on both sides. Real-time notifications are provided through buzzer alerts and LED indicators, while four switches enable users to transmit specific messages. The report delves into the system design, software development, and testing procedures, presenting the achieved data transfer rate and analyzing factors influencing communication performance. Additionally, it showcases the successful integration of sensor data, demonstrating the potential of Li-Fi for underwater communication due to its high bandwidth and immunity to electromagnetic interference. However, the project acknowledges limitations such as water absorption and reduced range. Finally, the report concludes by suggesting future research directions to further develop and optimize this promising technology for diverse underwater applications.

articleTitle: Implementation of Adaptive Tunicate Swarm Algorithm for Congestion Control and Link Failure Avoidance in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: -Recently, there has been an increased focus on mobile Ad Hoc networks, or MANETs, and their infrastructure-less plug-and-play model. A MANET is made up of randomly distributed nodes with wireless connections. In a MANET, packet loss may result from node or link failure. As a result, strategies for selecting an alternate route or relieving traffic through diversion routes receive minimal thought. In order to reduce congestion and route faults caused by skipped routes in MANETs, a congestion control routing approach was developed. To transport data effectively, a lot of roads are constructed, and the shortest pathways are discovered. Here, a traffic-distribution method called the adaptive tunicate swarm approach (adaptive TSA) is created to prevent congestion by spreading traffic along many channels. Additionally, a newly developed fitness function that takes throughput, latency, and distance into account. Whenever a source node detects congestion along a path, it uses its neighbor’s congestion indicator bit to disperse traffic over other pathways. Through simulation-based experiments, it is shown that the suggested paradigm is workable and achieves higher throughput with lower overhead and packet losses. Packet delivery ratio (PDR), throughput, and latency measurements are used in this investigation.

articleTitle: Exploring the Predictors of Intention to Purchase Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles have several advantages over traditional vehicles, but there are many psychological and technical barriers leading to a slower-than-expected rate of their adoption by consumers. This study attempts to identify the predictors of consumer’s intention to purchase electric vehicles. Analysis reveals that the awareness of consequences affects the consumers' green self-identity and ascription of responsibility. The ascription of responsibility impacts the green self-identity, and green self-identity, product knowledge, and driving range directly influence the consumers' intention to purchase EVs. Overall, there are three categories of factors influencing the purchase intention of consumers-environmental factors, product-related factors, and individual factors. The findings reinforce that the consumer perception of their ability to adopt EVs will act as a catalyst to transform green self-identity into EV purchase intentions.

articleTitle: Automated Generation and Evaluation of MultipleChoice Quizzes using Langchain and Gemini LLM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The research study investigates the use of cutting-edge technologies like Langchain and Gemini AI for the automated creation and assessment of multiple-choice questions (MCQs). Although producing multiple-choice questions (MCQs) has traditionally been done by hand and required a lot of work, advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) have opened up new possibilities. The creation and implementation of an MCQ generator—which uses Gemini AI to generate MCQs and Langchain for rapid engineering are covered in this paper. Customizing prompts for prompt engineering, chaining prompts with the Gemini AI model, and utilizing OpenAI's GPT-3.5 and multiple Language Learning Models (LLMs) to assess the created MCQs are the steps in the process. The study intends to assess these models' efficiency in handling intricate queries, producing appropriate answers, and examining the caliber of the MCQs that are produced.

articleTitle: Improving Heart Disease Monitoring Through Intelligent Hybrid Inference Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: To detect early indications and control heart disease, appropriate monitoring methods are needed. This research introduces clever hybrid inference systems to improve heart disease monitoring. These technologies make precise, timely predictions using machine learning algorithms and expert knowledge, enabling early intervention and personalized treatment strategies. Intelligent hybrid inference systems use patient records, physiological measures, and medical literature to find patterns and insights. Deep learning and ensemble approaches are used to analyze data and identify complex heart disease risk factors. Clinical guidelines, medical protocols, and subject expertise are also integrated. This combination of data-driven algorithms and expert knowledge improves the inference process's interpretability and reliability, allowing healthcare practitioners to make informed predictions. Extensive tests and evaluations on real-world cardiac disease datasets test the proposed approach. Intelligent hybrid inference systems exceed standard methods in accuracy and prediction. The systems also adapt to varied patient populations and data characteristics. This research could change heart disease monitoring and management. Healthcare professionals can improve patient outcomes by using intelligent hybrid inference systems to diagnose cardiac disease early, estimate risk, and customize treatment approaches. This effort improves the lives of heart disease patients by using artificial intelligence and expert knowledge.

articleTitle: Mental Health Stigma: Strategies for Destigmatization in Healthcare Settings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Mental illness is one of the most common disabilities in the world. The term "mental illness stigma" describes harmful practices and misconceptions that lead to a detrimental effect on the mental health, motivation, and self-worth of those who suffer from mental illnesses. Health care services are important for treating and reducing the negative stigma of mental health, as they are areas where patients seek relief and support. The study aims to investigate the causes and how to reduce them. Explores ways to disrupt the health care environment, specifically the RESHAPE program, which focuses on the concept of "critical". This review paper looks at 8-10 papers on mental health and stigma and how stigma will be reduced. The results show that a large number of doctors and students are stigmatized, negatively affecting the lives of people affected by mental illness. RESHAPE, KAP, and IBH therapies are also effective ways to minimize mental health stigma. This intervention aims to educate public health workers, promote social cohesion, and integrate treatment into primary health care, improving treatment into primary health care, improving treatment quality and patient outcomes. The study draws attention to the importance of stigma reduction efforts in the long term in health education and practice emphasis.

articleTitle: Existing Techniques For Fundamental, Technical And Sentimental Analysis For Stock Investement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In today's complex financial world, where things like global economics, company strategies, and how people feel about things can all affect the stock market, buying and selling stocks has become really popular. People are attracted to it because they think they can make a lot of money quickly. But there's a big problem: while making money is exciting, there's also a big chance of losing money because the stock market can be very unpredictable. Trying to figure out what the stock market will do next is super important, but also really hard. There are lots of different things that can affect it, like what's happening in the world, how well companies are doing, and even how people are feeling about investing. So, our paper is all about using existing Techniques (like AI and machine learning) to try to predict what the stock market might do. This paper explores three main ways of doing this .i.e, Fundamental, Technical and Sentimental Analysis: looking at basic stuff about companies, studying the patterns of stock prices, and analyzing how people feel about investing. This paper will take in account what other researchers have already found out about these things, our main goal is to help other researchers to understand more about predicting the stock market. The aim of this paper is to initiate a comprehensive discourse on this subject, inviting widespread participation to equip individuals with the knowledge and confidence needed to make informed investment decisions, even among the unpredictable fluctuations of the stock market.

articleTitle: Mixed FSO/RF based HAPS Relaying Communication Network for Ground Users
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the past several years, there has been a significant rise and advancement in information and communication technologies. However, the necessity to switch from radio frequency (RF) carriers to optical carriers has arisen due to congestion in the traditionally employed RF spectrum caused by the ever-inflating demand for data and multiple media services. Wide-bandwidth broadband availability, low power consumption, and inexpensive implementation have made Free Space Optical (FSO) communication systems a viable option for numerous applications. Furthermore, data transmission between the transmitter and receiver enables strong link security. Operating at a height of 20 km in the stratosphere, a High Altitude Platform Station (HAPS) maintains a quasi-stationary location and can make a substantial contribution to the idea of a 6G network. This study considers a mixed FSO/RF-based HAPS-assisted communication network, wherein HAPS is a relay of type decode-and-forward (DF). Source Ground Station (SGS) to HAPS link is assumed to be an FSO link, and since FSO follows line of sight (LOS) communication therefore, HAPS to Destination Ground Station (DGS) is considered to be an RF link so that it can cater to multiple ground destinations. For the uplink, atmospheric turbulence is modeled using the Gamma-Gamma fading model, and path loss is modeled using Beers Lambert's law. As the HAPS is quasi-stationary, a pointing error has been considered, keeping nonzero boresight error and identical jitters parameters. The RF link is deemed to be nakagami-m distributed. The performance of the model is investigated by deriving the analytical expression of outage probability and bit error rate (BER) by considering all the conditions stated above.

articleTitle: Classification of melanoma skin cancer using convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: One of the deadliest illnesses in the world is skin cancer. Accurately diagnosing skin lesions in their early stages might help clinicians make better decisions by raising the likelihood of a cure before cancer develops. However, due to the imbalance and scarcity of most skin illness photos utilized for training, obtaining automated skin cancer classification is challenging. The categorization of skin cancer has recently made extensive use of a variety of deep learning-based techniques to address the aforementioned problems and provide positive outcomes. The topic of skin cancer categorization is examined in this study. The suggested study uses CNN learning models to classify skin cancer to overcome this issue. Our research has led us to the conclusion that 82% accuracy is being used.

articleTitle: A Planning Model for Battery-Operated Local Bus Transit System Considering Day Depot Charging Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Battery electric buses (BEBs) are a better alternative to diesel buses for local transportation to cope with air pollution and the harmful effects of carbon emissions. However, the transition to electrification is associated with huge capital investment in BEBs, charging infrastructure based on the charging strategy used, and running charges other than the existing system, such as demand charges. In addition, these extra investments and charges impact the fare charges imposed on passengers. Therefore, concerning bus operators, investors, and grid operators, a planning framework model for BEBs is required that provides the technical and economic attributes. In this regard, this paper proposed a planning framework model opting for a day depot charging strategy. The proposed model is categorised into three parts: first, BEBs fleet size and trip frequency over a day based on route-specific requirements; second, technical assessment of the proposed charging strategy; and last, financial modelling. The insight results present detailed information on the above-mentioned categories that gives a strategic planning view to the bus operator and investors considering utility grid limitations. Furthermore, a case study on one existing bus route in Jaipur is performed to validate and test the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Progressive Approach of an Augmented Steganography for Network Peers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In order to interface and exchange data with various devices and frameworks via the internet, real objects or things implanted with sensors, programming, and other advancements are referred to as the Internet of Things (IoT). While there are IoT devices [13] that are publicly accessible to everyone in the company, it is still important to understand the risks associated with digital attacks and security threats. Before a message is sent, it is entirely converted from plain to encoded in cryptography. The reverse also applies to plaining messages received following exchanges of letters. One method of hiding sensitive data is to embed it within a text, image, video, or sound file via a technique called steganography. Information can be hidden using bits that address comparable variety pixels that are repeatedly rehashed in an image record.
