A picture record that seems identical to the original image but contains “commotion” samples of typical, decoded information will be produced by subtly applying the encoded information to this repeating information. The goal of this project is to jumble up the information on IoT networks by using an image information concealing technique to hide the message inside a picture record. We plan to integrate the use of convolutional neural networks with standard image information hiding techniques in order to significantly increase the amount of data that can be transmitted through an image. We will investigate various convolutional bounds in order to achieve the highest payload. The information will be encrypted and unscrambled using the recently developed profound learning computation. As a result, the convolutional organizations involved in this project will be set up to increase the payload of the data that needs to be encrypted and safely decoded in order to view the initial message.

articleTitle: Understanding Sign Language Recognition: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Communication is only the way which is used by human to express their needs, feelings and thoughts to people mostly by speech. But this world also has the people with some disability like deaf and dumb people. For these people communication is not possible by speech. The only language which is used by deaf and dumb people to communicate with each other is Sign Language. Sign Language is completely different from generally spoken languages, it has its own grammar. Different body parts are involved in sign language but the important parameters are hand gestures, body movement and also facial expression. Many researches have been done in sign language recognition. But still Sign Language Recognition (SLR) is the most challenging area for practitioners and researchers, because sign language is not an international language. For e.g., Indian Sign Language is differed from Ethiopian Sign Language, Chinese Sign Language, American Sign Language and other country’s sign language. The SLR is mostly required because of its ability to remove the communication barrier for deaf and dumb people. This review paper contains various techniques of AI (Artificial Intelligence) used for SLR for human understanding that have employed in recent past. The main approaches are i) Vision based ii) Glove based. In vision-based approach one or more camera is used to capture the image sequence, and then image processing is used to recognize the signs. In glove-based approach instrumental gloves with sensor is used to track the hand movement

articleTitle: FPGA-based Automatic Pill Dispenser using Decision Tree Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Accurate pill dispensing is crucial for ensuring effective medication management, particularly for elderly individuals and patients with chronic conditions. In this research, we propose an FPGA-based automatic pill dispenser utilizing a decision tree classifier. The decision tree algorithm classifies pills based on their shape and size features, facilitating precise dispensing at designated times. Our methodology involves training the decision tree classifier using a sample dataset of pill characteristics. Through entropy calculations and information gain analysis, we derive a decision tree tailored to the dataset. The FPGA implementation enables real-time pill dispensing, offering advantages such as low power consumption and parallel processing. Our findings demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in accurately dispensing pills, addressing the critical need for reliable medication administration systems.

articleTitle: Evaluating Domain Coverage in Low-Resource Generative Chatbots: A Comparative Study of Open-Domain and Closed-Domain Approaches Using BLEU Scores
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Chatbots employ Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to conduct automated chats and provide online assistance to users. Chatbots fall into two categories—generative models and retrieval models. E-commerce is the main application for retrieval-based chatbots—which provide pre-programmed responses and are easy to use with controlled interactions. While generative-based chatbots are more appropriate for research applications—they are more difficult to train and maintain. This is because they produce unique responses based on large conversational datasets. Therefore, in order to establish whether open-domain or closed-domain techniques work better—this study examines the domain coverage of low-resource generative chatbots. We compare their performance using Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) scores in different domains to determine which method performs better.

articleTitle: Generative AI and deep fakes in Media Industry - An Innovation Resistance Theory Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This empirical study intends to study users resistance towards emerging technologies like generative artificial intelligence (AI) and deep fakes affecting the media industry. The research's basic framework, the Innovation Resistance Theory, aids in making sense of the challenges and obstacles associated with adopting new technology. This theory can be used in research on generative AI and deepfakes to empirically analyze resistance variables and provide mitigation strategies for unfavorable impacts. A structured questionnaire was administered to gather information from media industry users (N= 283). Data analysis was performed using Smart-PLS 4.0 software, and the technique used was partial least square-structural equation modeling. Findings indicate that consumers’ functional barrier like value barrier and risk barrier, along with psychological barriers like traditional barriers, and image barrier were significantly impacting generative AI and deepfakes usage intentions. However, usage barrier did not have significant influence on deepfake usage. sThis paper adds to the ongoing discourse on responsible innovation in media. As deepfake technology becomes more widespread, it's relevant for policymakers, media professionals, and the public to know about associated risks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Solution For Crop Health Monitoring using CNN in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The agricultural Sector has witnessed a transformative shift towards smart agriculture, with a significant emphasis on leveraging advanced technologies for efficient crop disease detection with context to this the paper explores the potential of modern technologies, particularly computer vision and machine learning, for the early detection and management of crop diseases .This report explores the integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in smart agriculture to address the escalating challenges of crop protection. Focusing on the significant threat of crop disease faced during cultivation of different crops, the study emphasizes early detection using advanced technologies. A literature survey showcases successful disease identification models, and the proposed methodology outlines data collection, preprocessing, and CNN implementation. Results demonstrate CNN’s effectiveness in Greencare with an accuracy of up to 95.71%, offering a robust framework for further advancements in agricultural image analysis. This research contributes to sustainable practices, promoting global food security through innovative crop disease detection systems.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture: Deep and Machine Learning Approaches for Crop Disease Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Agriculture, a vital sector shaping India's economy, serves as the cornerstone of food production. This study focuses on estimating crop yield by integrating environmental, soil, water, and crop factors. Despite significant efforts in yield prediction, challenges persist, including the effective mapping of raw data to crop yield values and the reliance on feature quality for model performance. To address these challenges, we employ deep learning models for meaningful crop feature extraction. The system utilizes a dataset repository and incorporates diverse classification algorithms such as random forest and convolutional neural networks. Our experimental results highlight the system's accuracy, precision, recall, and scores, providing valuable insights into the agricultural forecasting domain. Through the integration of deep learning techniques and diverse classification algorithms, we successfully estimate crop yield and identify factors impacting agricultural productivity. The findings underscore the importance of leveraging advanced computational methods for crop yield estimation and disease diagnosis, facilitating informed decision-making in agriculture and contributing to sustainable food production and economic growth.

articleTitle: IoT based Smart wheelchair For Disabled Person
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Smart wheelchairs are revolutionizing mobility for disabled individuals, offering enhanced independence and improved quality of life. These advanced devices incorporate cutting-edge technologies like obstacle avoidance systems, voice control, and self-navigation capabilities, transforming the traditional wheelchair into an intelligent mobility solution. Obstacle avoidance systems utilize sensors to detect and avoid obstacles, ensuring safe navigation in complex environments. Voice control enables users to operate the wheelchair hands-free, providing greater convenience and control. Self-navigation capabilities allow the wheelchair to autonomously navigate to pre-programmed destinations, reducing user burden and enhancing independence. Smart wheelchairs also offer connectivity features, enabling remote monitoring and control by caregivers. This provides an added layer of safety and support for users, ensuring timely assistance when needed. The integration of these advanced technologies into smart wheelchairs is transforming mobility for disabled individuals, empowering them with greater independence, safety, and control over their movement. As smart wheelchair technology continues to evolve, the possibilities for enhanced mobility and improved quality of life for disabled individuals are limitless.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Emergency Medical Services: A Review of Ambulance Technology Advancements and Service Enhancement Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This review paper addresses the challenges faced by current emergency ambulance systems, focusing on improving service efficiency and patient outcomes. Analyzing various studies, we explore the demand for emergency services, including factors such as traffic congestion and inappropriate use of ambulances. Additionally, queuing theory models are examined to determine optimal fleet sizes for meeting service standards. The review also highlights advancements in ambulance technologies, emphasizing the potential for enhancing emergency medical services (EMS) effectiveness and efficiency. Through a systematic analysis of ambulance technologies from the past decade, this paper identifies trends, growth patterns, and future directions for EMS technology. The findings underscore the importance of investing in innovative ambulance technologies to improve patient care and survival rates. Recommendations for developing an app-based, 24/7 emergency service connected to hospitals are proposed to address current EMS challenges effectively.

articleTitle: High Isolation and High Gain Graphene Based THz MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this paper, we have a simple design for a terahertz graphene patch metasurface absorber (MSA) for RCS reduction as well as high isolation in a 2-elements MIMO antenna which is composed of "S" shaped structure. We have designed a metasurface absorber (MSA) which is polarization insensitive for both transverse magnetic and transverse electric waves. For high-speed terahertz (THz) applications, a graphene hexagonal microstrip feed MIMO antenna is proposed in this study. The antenna is designed with a closely coupled patch with a size of 1550 × 1000 × 150µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> using RT5880 as a dielectric substrate having relative permittivity of 2.2. MIMO antenna contains 2 elements which are orthogonally oriented with a 180° angle between them. The ground of the antenna has a C looped shaped decoupling structure, which provides high isolation. The patch is of Graphene which provides high thermal conductivity. The antenna provides a wide impedance bandwidth of 1.75 THz (0.25–2 THz) with an isolation more than 20dB and reaching maximum peak gain over 12.5dBi by superstrate metasurface (MS). The improved isolation and the low RCS of the MIMO antenna make it suitable for Terahertz wave Radar, Health care, Cancer detection, Aerospace applications, Military application in radiolocation and 6G services.

articleTitle: IoT-based Transportation System: An Enabler for the Sustainable Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: To aim for sustainability on their operations is a strategic requirement for organizations who are looking to prosper in a complex and interconnected global economy. This is because societies are now increasingly acknowledging the pressing need to address environmental degradation, resource scarcity, and social inequity. The Internet of Things (IoT) is a revolutionary tool which is capable of enabling any organization's operations towards achieving sustainability. For any business organization, transportation is one of the biggest sources of environmental degradation. By IoT technology integration throughout the transportation fleet, organizations can gain unprecedented visibility, control, and optimization capabilities. This results in enhance efficiency, reduced waste, and mitigation of environmental degradation. The present study aims to investigate the ways in which IoT facilitates a sustainable supply chain with reference to transportation. The study provides a thorough understanding of the opportunities and challenges associated with integrating IoT into transportation. By looking at the important areas where IoT technology intersects with sustainability, such as supplier sustainability assessment, energy efficiency, tracking and traceability, and circular economy initiatives, this study will provide enterprises and stakeholders with the knowledge and resources needed to fully utilize IoT technology in achieving sustainable supply chain management goals with respect to transportation. In the end, organizations may improve their operational resilience and competitive edge by using IoT as a sustainability enabler.

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis: A GRU Approach for Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the real world, data often comes in different forms, such as text, audio, and video, making it multi-modal. This poses a challenge for machine learning models, which need to be able to process and understand this type of data. One way to address this challenge is to use models that can handle multiple data types in a single model. This enables the model to learn from the diverse information offered by the various data types. This research explores various methods for sentiment analysis in a multi-modal context, incorporating text, images, and potentially audio data. The methods evaluated include lexicon-based methods, machine learning with text features, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for text, and a proposed multi-modal GRU model. The objective of the multi-modal GRU model is to surpass existing methods by efficiently capturing and integrating sentiment information from various modalities. The evaluation of the model's capabilities and constraints encompasses multiple performance indicators, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. Our Multi-modal GRUs model achieved an accuracy rate of 85%, precision of 82%, recall of 80%, and an F1-score of 81%. These metrics indicate that the model adeptly captures the underlying patterns within the multimodal data.

articleTitle: BlockFin: AI and Blockchain Synergy for Secure Digital Financial Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The ever-growing technology has set a new record for digital transactions taking place all over the world. The forging of digital transactions has paved the way for a new medium of interconnected transactions. However, the inclusion of digital transactions has led to the need to combat the various security issues that occur parallel to it. The limitations of digital transactions include its dependence on technology and various technological gaps between people, which may lead to privacy concerns. Money laundering is one of the main types of fraud in transactional data. It is the process of converting money obtained from criminal illicit activities such as break-ins and drug trafficking and converting into such that it is legally obtained. The dataset used in this paper follows the rules related to all processes of cashing in and transferring. Money laundering hurts both people and the economy, which results in loss of investor confidence and reduced tax revenues. The leveraging of the combined power of machine learning (ML) and blockchain technology has proved to be a promising strategy for combating fraudulent activities. The fusion of blockchain and ML techniques not only provides security but also reduces the risk of fraud and increases transparency in comparison to the previous state-of-the-art techniques and experimentation. It is observed that a maximum accuracy of 91% is attained using the K-nearest neighbor algorithm (KNN). Furthermore, the integration of blockchain ensures security through the use of Smart contracts, providing an additional layer of security.

articleTitle: DocBot Connect: A Conversational Search System Powered by Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: DocBot Connect revolutionizes document retrieval by enabling users to have a natural conversation to search through multiple PDFs. This user-centric system leverages the power of large language models (LLMs) and cutting-edge information retrieval techniques.DocBot Connect boasts a user-friendly interface where users can upload their PDFs and ask questions in plain English. To unlock the deeper meaning within these documents, the system utilizes Google PaLM embeddings. These embeddings capture the essence of the text, allowing for a richer understanding. A critical step involves text segmentation, which meticulously divides the document content into manageable chunks. These segmented portions are then processed by Google PaLM, resulting in a robust embedded representation. This embedded representation forms the foundation for efficient retrieval using a FAISS vector store, enabling lightning-fast information retrieval. To ensure a seamless and contextually aware conversation, DocBot Connect incorporates a ConversationBufferMemory component. This component meticulously stores the conversation history, allowing the system to maintain a coherent dialogue flow. Finally, a ConversationalRetrievalChain, powered by the formidable capabilities of Google PaLM, retrieves relevant information from the vector store. This retrieval process is not solely driven by the user's query but also meticulously considers the established conversational context. DocBot Connect transcends traditional document retrieval systems, offering an intuitive and efficient gateway to access and comprehend information within a multitude of PDFs. This user-friendly approach fosters a more interactive and engaging experience for those navigating the ever-expanding world of document exploration.

articleTitle: Air Pollution Prediction Systems in City Highways using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The danger to the human’s health in metropolitan environments usually city highways happen due to air pollution. By the use of Artificial intelligence (AI) system has been designed in this paper so as to reduce air pollution on city roads. Our examination merges data analysis and modelling for reduction of air pollution. Data acquisition, data pre-processing, data analysis and model development are various steps which are included in the methodology. Training of different machine learning models is done in model development. The capabilities of AI for air quality index (AQI) in a particular region is showcased through user-interactive model. Perceptive data on air pollution patterns on city roads along with framework which rely on AI for handling and forecasting air quality is illustrated in result section. Environmental health and traffic management in city areas are few of the implications.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Deep Learning for Accurate Knee Joint Segmentation and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Knee joint segmentation and classification are critical tasks in medical imaging, having applications in diagnosis, treatment planning, and surgical navigation. The intricate architecture of the knee joint and the variation in knee joint imaging, however, can make these tasks difficult. Deep learning has become a viable method for classifying and segmenting knee joints. From massive knee joint picture datasets, deep learning models may be trained to recognize intricate patterns, and they can produce state-of-the-art performance on certain tasks. In order to divide and classify knee joints, this paper discusses current developments in deep learning. The paper talks about the various training approaches and deep learning architectures applied to these challenges. Furthermore, the paper provides an extensive summary of the cutting-edge functionality of deep learning.

articleTitle: Machine Learning driven Personality Prediction System using the concept of CV Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In contemporary corporate settings, a candidate's personality is as crucial as their skill set. Achieving success, whether in personal or professional realms, heavily relies on one's personality traits. Therefore, the recruiter needs to be aware of the candidate's personality. Given the exponential rise in job seekers and the decline in available employment, it is challenging to manually choose the most qualified applicant for a position just by glancing at their resume. This research analyses different machine learning algorithm such as logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, k nearest neighbor and naive Bayes for effectively predicting personality through CV (Curriculum Vitae) analysis. Big five personality model is used to analyzed the personality. The logistic regression approach outperformed other algorithms in terms of accuracy and precision, according to the results.

articleTitle: Dual Active Bridge as a High-Frequency Converter Link for Active Power Flow Control in Clustered DC Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Developing an electric grid which is sustainable and secure requires harvesting as much renewable energy as possible. As sources powered by DC, ESS (energy storage systems) and devices acting as load incorporated in electric power systems grow in popularity, Microgrids based on direct current are becoming increasingly popular. Even so, clustered DC Microgrids are being considered as a cost-effective solution to cope with widespread distributed generation, ESS and loads that can be controlled. The effective clustering of DC Microgrids has also been made possible by the use of Interconnecting Converters (ICs) which function as energy routers, connecting and managing interconnections between clustered DC Microgrids. Dual Active Bridge (DAB), a Bidirectional Isolated DC-DC Converter (BIDC) is considered as most often utilized topology as a High Frequency Converter Link (HFL) for regulating active power flow in the clustered DC Microgrids. DAB gives advantages of electrical isolation, bi-directional flow of power, high power density and straightforward soft-switching management. DAB based Power Flow Converter (PFC) regulates the power flow by incorporating and regulating voltage at the interface of the two clustered DC Microgrids. The PFC constitutes a cascaded connection of DAB and full-bridge DC-DC converter, which inserts in series a dynamic voltage within the power transmission line used in clustering DC Microgrids in order to attain the regulation of the flow of active power. The performance characteristics of a high frequency DAB DC-DC converter and its involvement as a core component (of PFC) for controlling the active power flowing in the DC MG cluster is presented in this paper. Simulation results showcased in this paper are obtained in Matlab

articleTitle: Psychological Mental Health Analysis using NLP and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research explores real-time psychological analysis using pre-store information and Natural Language Processing (NLP). It aims to enhance the precision of psychological evaluation by analyzing language patterns in live conversation, utilizing NLP and machine learning techniques. The study addresses mental health challenges, focusing on stress prediction among university students, workers and introverted individuals. Additionally, it delves into depression identification through version NLP techniques and machine learning algorithms. The comparative analysis evaluates the effectiveness of approaches for discerning depression for discerning depressive states from textual data. The research contributes to understanding live text patterns and has implications for personalized mental health interventions, considering ethical considerations in technological advancements.

articleTitle: Minimizing Air pollution using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Air pollution in urban environments, particularly on city highways, poses a significant threat to public health and the environment. Traffic congestion is the leading cause to air pollution in today's world. This study investigates the potential of machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI) for improving traffic management and reducing Air Pollution. This research paper investigates the traffic volumes in the city highways and introduces a system which will adjust the traffic signal timing based on traffic predictions and Air Quality Index (AQI) data. The results provide insights into the potential of machine learning for traffic prediction and the use of AI for optimizing green light control. With the help of these techniques traffic management systems could potentially improve traffic flow reducing congestion, and enhancing urban air.

articleTitle: Empowering Skin Cancer Diagnosis: Integrating Advanced Deep Learning Models with Explainable AI for Lesion Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Skin cancer poses a significant global health challenge, demanding precise and timely diagnosis to enhance patient outcomes and tailor treatment effectively. This study addresses the complexity of skin cancer detection by employing cutting-edge deep learning algorithms alongside explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methodologies. Utilizing recent pre-trained models such as XceptionNet, EfficientNetV2S, InceptionResNetV2, and EfficientNetV2M, we aim to classify skin lesions accurately. Additionally, we employ image augmentation strategies to improve model generalization and mitigate class imbalances. Through XAI, we elucidate the decision-making processes of our models, a critical step in establishing trust and facilitating the integration of AI-powered diagnostic tools into clinical workflows. Our findings highlight the superiority of the XceptionNet architecture, achieving an accuracy of 88.72%. By demonstrating the potential of deep learning and XAI in refining skin cancer diagnosis, this study lays the foundation for further advancements in medical image analysis. The adoption of these technologies holds promise in expediting accurate identification, thereby enhancing patient care, reducing healthcare costs, and bolstering survival rates among individuals affected by skin cancer.

articleTitle: Scaling Up the Transformers: A Survey of Training and Inference Optimization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Transformer models have shown great success in Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but they come with unique challenges such as the vanishing gradient, unbalanced gradient, and computational costs. To overcome these challenges, various optimization techniques have been developed including regularization, parallelism, and hybrid architectures. In this survey paper, we review the recent advances in optimizing transformers for NLP tasks and highlight their applications on weakly labelled data and low-resource settings. We discuss how to improve the performance of Transformers on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-Transformer models, which leverage both CNN and Transformer architectures. Furthermore, we explore techniques specifically designed for weak supervision and low-resource scenarios such as Segment-wise training, Cluster-based attention mechanism, and Transfer learning from a teacher model to a student model. We also highlight some recent works on Sound Event Detection using CNN-Transformer, which leverages the strength of CNNs for feature extraction and Transformers for long range dependencies. Overall, this paper provides an overview of the challenges faced during optimization of transformers in NLP tasks and offers insights into the state-of-the-art techniques to overcome these challenges.

articleTitle: KIA: Know It All - An All-Inclusive OSINT Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) involves gathering, analyzing, and utilizing publicly available information from diverse sources, such as the Internet, social media, public records, and more. It is crucial for various purposes, including enhancing security by monitoring potential threats, investigating individuals or events, and aiding decision-making by providing valuable insights and trends. OSINT tool is a sophisticated software that centralizes the collection, analysis, and visualization of OSINT data. It streamlines the process, making it efficient and user-friendly. It also empowers users to extract actionable insights from various public sources, facilitating informed decision-making and strategic planning across different domains. Different OSINT tools give information based on multiple inputs and domains such as IP address, phone number, and username. We aimed to expedite the process by creating an all-inclusive OSINT tool, KIA-Know It All, which performs the task of multiple OSINT tools in one.

articleTitle: The Role of AI Counselling in Journaling for Mental Health Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This research paper investigates the effectiveness of integrating an AI counselling system, utilizing a Large Language Model (LLM), within a journaling application aimed at enhancing mental well-being. Employing a descriptive quantitative methodology, the study examines the subjective experiences of individuals engaging with the application. Through a purposive sampling approach, data was collected from 50 participants, focusing on their perceptions of benefits and challenges associated with the AI counselling system. The analysis reveals significant positive correlations between users' experiences and the app's ability to enhance counselling skills, behaviors, and learning related to mental health topics. Findings indicate that the AI-driven counselling system facilitates deep introspection, empathy, and emotional resilience among users, providing structured support tailored to individual needs. The research underscores the transformative potential of integrating AI counselling within digital platforms to foster mental well-being and recommends further refinement to enhance user experiences.

articleTitle: Individualized Guidance in Yoga Practice: A Comparative Analysis of Technology Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The most recent developments in yoga pose identification and correction systems are discussed in depth throughout this in-depth assessment. In it, the benefits and drawbacks of these systems are analysed, with particular emphasis placed on the requirement for enhanced real-time feedback and precision in pose identification. The report also draws attention to the possibility of providing individualised advice for yoga practice. By contrasting these technologies with well-known fitness applications, it highlights some of the apps' and technologies' shared flaws. The analysis provides suggestions for holistic approaches that can make yoga practice more efficient. These approaches take into account sophisticated pose identification algorithms, adaptive learning, and personalised recommendations. This paper aims to improve vulnerability identification and advance yoga improvement technologies that increase yoga practitioners' well-being worldwide. This effort aspires to inspire future advances in the discipline, with the end goal of improving the experience of yoga for all who practice it.

articleTitle: Advances in Medical Image Processing: Enhancing Diagnostics and Treatment Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Recent advancements in medical image processing have significantly enhanced the capabilities of diagnostic imaging and treatment planning. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of the latest methodologies and technologies in image processing that contribute to more precise diagnoses and improved treatment strategies. We explore several key areas including deep learning algorithms for image segmentation, enhancement techniques for improving image clarity and detail, and innovative approaches for 3D visualization. Furthermore, we discuss the integration of artificial intelligence with traditional imaging techniques to accelerate decision-making processes and personalize patient care. The impact of these advancements is evaluated through case studies and clinical feedback, which demonstrate improved outcomes in patient diagnosis and treatment planning. Our findings suggest that the integration of advanced image processing techniques can transform medical imaging into a more dynamic tool for healthcare professionals, ultimately leading to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Classification of Skin Cancer Detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Using convolutional neural networks (CNN) for skin cancer classification has emerged as a promising method that outperforms traditional methods in terms of accuracy and efficiency. Despite significant advances, the field faces ongoing challenges in ensuring the stability and reliability of these structures. Therefore, a comprehensive review of existing research is urgently needed to address these issues. This review is devoted to an in-depth study of the evolution of CNNs in the classification of skin cancer, showing the progression process and their impact on the accuracy of diagnosis. By adopting a method to select relevant search terms from popular databases, this research aims to better understand CNN-based methods and methods. From our study, we propose to analyze the current state of CNNs in the classification of skin tumors, identifying their strengths and weaknesses while addressing the important issue identified. Our study will reveal the opportunities offered by deep learning in improving diagnostic accuracy, as well as discuss limitations and areas for further research.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Three-Axis Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The Solar energy is one of the sustainable renewable energies and a green energy which is ultimately harnessed through a solar photovoltaic system and solar cell surfaces. It is growing continuously, green sustainable technologies with increasing rate of global growth figures, due to its accessibility, and vast availability on our Earth. But the drawback is to capture the maximum sun rays for the generation of power, to overcome the above issue, this paper proposed the implementation of THREE AXIS SOLAR TRACKING SYSTEM. The normal (fixed) solar tracking system is not be able to track the sun’s continuous revolution and this limits the amount of sun radiation and the absorption. Three axis tracking system is the practical solution to these drawbacks. In the development of hardware, two geared DC stepper motors which are adjusted by Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) that the drive unit operates the panel by utilizing four Light-Dependent Resistors (LDRs) to generate analog signals. These signals are subsequently processed by a low-energy ATMEGA328P microcontroller equipped with Arduino.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Analysis Of Local Mechanic Support For Immediately Apparent Repairs And Scheduled Maintenance Services
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: This As technology advances, innovative systems are emerging to address the need for rapid auto repairs, especially in cases of unexpected vehicle breakdowns. This analysis delves into a sophisticated system designed to provide immediate on- site assistance by connecting vehicle owners with skilled mechanics. The system, developed using cutting-edge technologies such as Figma, React JS, Tailwindcss, Nodejs, Express JS and MongoDB, offers a seamless experience by incorporating features like real-time location tracking and efficient job assignment. These features significantly reduce wait times and alleviate the stress associated with roadside assistance. The article highlights the development and architecture of the application, focusing on its user-friendly interface and the strong technological framework that ensures its reliability and quick response to contemporary automotive challenges.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring of Atmospheric Air Pollutants using Sensor Integrated UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In this work, we proposed an unmanned aerial drone-based air quality monitoring system. This system includes an integrated sensor unit of PMS5003, DHT22 and MG811 interfaced with Wi-Fi enable microcontroller board. It is no worthy to inform that the drone and multi sensor unit are assemble after taking consecutive literature. This multi sensor unit interfaced board are re-programmable using the Arduino integrated development environment (IDE) platform. The assembled quadcopter is hovered for 5 min at a particular location with altitude of ~ 50 m from the GCS. Further, the collected data are sent to the IoT cloud via internet in the real time scenario. The measurement and data acquisition are performed for 30 days to get the reliable result. This data acquired shows good quality of air in this particular location with references to air quality index (AQI). Overall, this portable sensor integrated UAV system can be used for accurate data collection for analysing the environment pollution.

articleTitle: Rating-Based Cyberbullying Detection with Text, Emojis on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of online interactions, cyberbullying has become pervasive, profoundly impacting user's digital well-being. Public figures, especially celebrities and influencers, face heightened vulnerability to online harassment, exacerbated by the post-pandemic surge in social media usage. To address this challenge, our research adopts a holistic approach to detect cyberbullying in text, considering both textual content and the nuanced expressions conveyed through emojis on social media platforms. We employed a diverse set of machine learning and deep learning models, including Support Vector Classifier, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, LSTM, Bi-LSTM, GRU, and Bi-GRU, to accurately classify non cyberbullying or cyberbullying text. Beyond classification, our study introduces an offensive rating system, assigning severity ratings on a 1-5 scale to identify cyberbullying instances. A critical aspect is the establishment of a threshold value which depends on user security and safety ethics of different social media platforms; texts surpassing this trigger an automatic recommendation to block the user, ensuring a proactive response to minimize harm. This recent contribution not only comprehensively addresses cyberbullying but also empowers society.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Potato (Solanum Tuberosum) Leaf Diseases Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Development in agriculture must be given top priority in a nation like India, where the bulk of the population makes their living from it. A significant financial loss in crop production occurs every season due to maladies and pests. One of the biggest problems that farmers deal with is diseases that infect plant leaves, especially those of potatoes. A popular crop in agriculture, potatoes are grown in more than 150 countries and will produce 376 million tons globally in 2021. Even with this exposure, the output of potatoes is greatly decreased by potato leaf diseases. Delivering the amount of food required to feed the world's expanding population is therefore quite difficult. In the agriculture industry, potato diseases have resulted in production losses and financial losses. It will also have an impact on farmers' incomes, as many farmers now take their own lives due to misfortunes they encounter in the field. Planned disease control measures can be aided by the identification of specific plant diseases. In potato crops, leaf disease detection and classification are also mitigated by computer technologies. To ensure food security for the world's growing population, this study offers a comprehensive overview of the many leaf diseases that affect potato crops. It also highlights the use of scientific and computation methods in the identification and categorization of potato leaf disease, as well as the ongoing challenges associated with it.

articleTitle: The Impact of 5G on Real-Time IoT Data Processing: Exploring Challenges and Innovative Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The introduction of 5G technology is a significant advancement in the processing of real-time data from IoT, offering speed, connection, and unprecedented data management capabilities. This study explores the impact of 5G on real-time IoT data processing, focusing on its potential and challenges. The ultra-low latency and high bandwidth characteristics of 5G enable real-time applications to handle data with great efficiency, improving fields like smart cities, healthcare, industrial automation, and autonomous cars. This improved connection allows for more complex data analytics and informed decisions, driving innovation across various industries. However, the integration of 5G into IoT systems presents several challenges, including increasing cybersecurity risks due to the growing network of connected devices, the need for strong privacy controls and compliance with regulations like GDPR and CCPA, significant network changes for 5G infrastructure implementation, and the difficulty in establishing constant real-time performance due to network conditions and device capabilities. Interoperability issues across various IoT devices further complicate the integration process, necessitating the introduction of defined protocols for smooth functioning. As the number of connected devices increases, managing network congestion and resource allocation becomes increasingly difficult, necessitating more sophisticated resource management solutions. This study aims to provide methods for maximizing the adoption of 5G in real-time IoT applications by investigating security technologies, infrastructure development, and standardization initiatives. Ultimately, 5G technology will revolutionize IoT data processing, but it is crucial to overcome these obstacles to fully realize its potential.

articleTitle: Smart Crop Recommendation System with Plant Disease Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Agriculture is the backbone of many countries, including India, and provides livelihoods to millions of people facing challenges such as climate change and plant disease outbreaks. Through research, a web application has been developed that provides real-time recommendations for crop selection based on various factors such as soil nutrients, temperature, humidity, pH levels, and rainfall. Recent advances in machine learning and artificial intelligence offer promising solutions to these problems, enabling accurate, data-driven decision-making in agriculture. These technologies have the potential to transform how we predict crop yields and detect plant diseases, thus improving agricultural practices. To achieve this, we trained and examined seven machine learning models, Decision tree, Naive Bayes, SVM, Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and KNN. Among these, Random forest gives the highest accuracy, making it the best choice for crop forecasting. In addition to crop recommendation, the web application also integrates a Plant Disease Identification system using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). By analyzing leaf images, CNN detects and accurately classifies plant diseases, allowing farmers to intervene early to prevent crop losses. This study aims to empower farmers with accessible technology to make informed decisions, improve crop selection, and effectively cure plant diseases. Combining crop recommendation with disease detection, intelligent crop recommendation systems with plant disease detection contribute to sustainable agriculture, economic stability, and food security in India and beyond.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technology Used High Dynamic Range Image Reconstruction And Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The suggested remedy for saturated pixels in digital camera photos introduces a brand-new learning-based method for reconstructing images with high dynamic range (HDR). While current techniques concentrate on increasing brightness range, they frequently fall short in producing realistic textures, leading to errors in places that are too saturated. Our method reconstructs an HDR image by using aesthetically beautiful saturated pixels from a low dynamic range (LDR) image. We provide a feature masking strategy to address problems discovered during training, when saturated and well-exposed pixels got comparable convolutional filters, resulting in uncertainty and checkerboard and halo aberrations. This method improves the overall quality of the reconstruction by reducing the contribution of features from saturated regions. Furthermore, in order to guarantee visually pleasing textures in the reconstructed HDR photos, we adjust the perceptual loss function based on VGG.We use a two-step procedure in order to properly train our system. We first train the system for picture in painting on a sizable dataset, and then we modify it for HDR reconstruction. Our method performs exceptionally well even with a small number of HDR photos because it uses an advanced sampling strategy to choose hard training patches from a wide range of settings. Convolutional neural networks, feature masking, perceptual loss, and high dynamic range imagery are important components of our methodology.

articleTitle: Deploying and Assessing the Efficiency of Ethereum Blockchain for Ensuring the Security of Web of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: The characteristics of blockchain technology, which is a decentralised database or "distributed ledger," include independence, lack of central authority, and a trustless setting. Because of these characteristics, blockchain technology is well-suited for use in many IoT applications. This article details a real-world use of the Proof of Authority (PoA) Ethereum blockchain on an web of Things (IoT) system. In order to study and highlight potential challenges that might impact the integration of blockchain with IoT, and to set the stage for future research and potential solutions to these concerns, this implementation was carried out in a practical sense.

articleTitle: AI-Based Methods to Detect and Counter Cyber Threats in Cloud Environments to Strengthen Cloud Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Traditional cloud security solutions often employ outdated techniques and find it difficult to stay up to date with the ever-evolving cyber threat scenario. Complex attacks may be made against cloud systems since static signatures and rule-based methods have their limits. To address these problems, the study proposes a novel AI-based approach to enhance cyber threat detection and mitigation in cloud settings. By use of sophisticated anomaly detection and machine learning (ML) methods, the proposed system continuously analyzes large amounts of data to dynamically identify and eliminate new threats. Some of the key components include robust preprocessing, a variety of ML model selections, repetitive model training, real-time threat detection, and automated response mechanisms. Compared to the current system, the results demonstrate notable increases in detection accuracy, false positive and false negative rates, and area under the curve (AUC) values across many test datasets. Specifically, the proposed system reduces the false negative and false positive rates to 2.0% and 1.2%, respectively, and achieves 98.5% detection accuracy as compared to 89.7% for the existing system. Moreover, on several test datasets, the proposed system routinely produces higher AUC values than the existing system, proving its efficiency in improving the accuracy of cyber threat identification in cloud systems.

articleTitle: Optimizing Window Overlapping Size for Unsupervised Voice Activity Detection: A Comprehensive Review and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Voice Activity Detection (VAD) is a critical task in audio signal processing that is required in many different applications to separate speech parts from background noise. An in-depth evaluation of techniques for maximizing window overlapping size for unsupervised VAD systems is provided in the present study. The difficulties in choosing the most suitable and acceptable window configurations are covered in this study, which also includes balancing frequency and temporal resolutions and taking application-specific needs into consideration. This provides an approach that was suggested in the literature study and includes defined constants, audio segmentation, pre-processing methods, Mel filter bank feature extraction, signal smoothing, and thresholding. The combination of the Teager-Kaiser Energy Operator (TKEO) for improved signal analysis is being investigated. The study summarizes research findings from the literature and emphasizes how visualization and iterative experimentation may improve VAD performance and refine the approach. The development of unsupervised VAD systems for practical applications is simplified by an understanding of signal processing methods, difficulties, and possible areas for future research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cybersecurity: Machine Learning Techniques for Phishing URL Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Phishing attacks exploit user vulnerabilities in cybersecurity awareness by tricking them to fake websites designed to steal confidential data. This study proposes a method for detecting phishing URLs using machine learning. The proposed method analyzes various URL characteristics, such as length, subdomain levels, and the presence of suspicious patterns, which are key indicators of phishing attempts. Gradient Boosting was selected due to its robustness in handling complex, non-linear relationships between features, making it particularly effective in distinguishing between legitimate and phishing URLs, by evaluating the Gradient Boosting classifier on a dataset with 10,000 entries and 50 features, the method achieves an accuracy of 99%.This approach has the potential to enhance web browsers with add-ons or middleware that alert users from potential phishing sites which will be based solely on URL.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Content Development: The Impact of AI Augmentation Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: In the era of information abundance, navigating through extensive content within files presents a significant challenge for various users seeking specific information. This paper minimizes the difficulties a user faces in efficiently extracting relevant information from voluminous documents. Harnessing the capabilities of powerful generative AI models, particularly those developed by OpenAI, our research formulates intuitive methods to alleviate the burden of exhaustive document perusal. By leveraging state-of-the-art generative AI, this research presents innovative approaches that allow users to streamline their information retrieval processes. Our methods aim to enhance a user’s productivity by minimizing the need for strenuous manual reading, ultimately enabling a more efficient and targeted exploration of document content along with its inherent capabilities. Through the integration of OpenAI’s advancements in natural language processing, our proposed techniques pave the way for a user-friendly and efficient means of accessing crucial information within documents. This research contributes to the evolving landscape of informationprocessing, dedicating practical solutions to optimize a user’s interactions with extensive textual data.

articleTitle: Harmonics and Voltage flicker investigation of different Electric Arc Furnace models on Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Power quality disturbances, such as voltage flicker and harmonic distortions, are introduced to the utility power system due to the stochastic and nonlinear operation of an electric arc furnace. In order to analyze the voltage flicker and harmonic distortions produced by furnace operation, precise models of electric arc furnaces are necessary. In this paper, the PQ issues in utility power systems that supply an arc furnace load are examined using a variety of arc furnace models, limit curves, and manual calculation techniques. Classification of models typically relies on the time domain and frequency domain methods. For the purpose of analyzing flicker and harmonic content, ten models of an arc furnace selected using the time domain method are analyzed. Simulations are conducted, and the results obtained are utilized to compare the various arc furnace models in terms of voltage flicker and harmonic content. Recommendations pertaining to the practical implementation of these models are also provided.

articleTitle: Smart Commerce: Unleashing Machine Learning for Optimal Customer Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Electrical Electronics and Computing Technologies (ICEECT)
abstract: Machine learning is a branch of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and computer technology which address on the usage or application of data and Algorithms to emulate the style that humans learn, gradually improving its accuracy. By understanding this statement humans are not associated with machine learning, once the system is deployed by them. Once the whole system is installed in the software through algorithm or coding, the machine adapts the order and continues accordingly without hindering little things like Sleeping, fatigue like humans and can work for long time and can operate it 24/7, with repetition.
